tei:div.tei:p: ga/ doX / ༷ngashe/sa/ rtoX///sheshe/ /༷༷/༷༷/ sgroX ༷ /

༄༅//'bring rim skad yig gi gshar sbyang kun 'dus me long /'bring rim slob 'bring gi nyer mkho'i rgyu chaljongs zhing lnga'i mnyam sgrig slob gzhi/nyin hril bo'i lam lugs kyi 'bring rim slob 'bring gi bslab gzhi/gan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
nghrurte rteX stoX1 ༅ ༷ ༷ ni༅ /shiXsheX/༷ ༷ ༷ shi ༷ ༷

gleng gzhi/ljongs zhing lnga'i mnyam sgrig slob gzhi nyin hril po'i lam lugs kyi dma' rim slob 'bring bod skad yig gi spyi'i bskyar sbyong — 〈 kun 'dub me long / 〉 zhes pa 'di ni rgyal khab slob gso pu'u yis spel ba'i dma' rim slob 'bring bod skad yig slob khrid rtsa 'dzin dang dma' rim slob 'bring dus rim gyi skad yig slob deb drug gzhir bzung nas rtsom sgrig byas pa yin/spyi'i bskyar sbyong 'de rtsom sgrig byed skabs slob khrid rtsa 'dzin mdzub khrid bsam blor brten pa dang / slob ma'i skad yig gi rmang gzhi'i shes bya dang rmang gzhi'i nus rtsal gong 'phel gtong rgyu rtsa bar bzung thog slob deb khag gi bshad khrid slob tshan so so'i sbyang gzhir dpyad gzhi'i dris lan 'debs pa dang sbrags slob tshan de'i rtsom khungs dang rtsom pa po/ rtsom stangs rigs gang gtogs pa/nang don gtso bo gang brjod pa sogs zhib cing gsal bar bkod yod la/ skad yig gi rmang gzhi'i shes bya'i slob tshan khag las nges par khong du chud dgos pa'i shes bya dag dri ba dris lan gyi thog nas bkod yod/mdor na skad yig gi spyi'i bskyar sbyong 'des slob ma'i skad yig gi rmang gzhi sra brtan du gtong ba dang / dge rgan gyis slob khrid bya rgyur dpyad gzhi'i rin thang che ba ma zad gnas skabs slob khrid dpyad gzhi cha tshang mkho 'don byed ma thub pa'i stong cha skong thub pa/ lhag par du skad yig gi shes bya phyogs bsdus kyis bskyar sbyong byas te bde blag ngang dma' 'bring dus rim gyi slob stong las 'gan legs sgrub bya rgyur dpyad gzhi'i rin thang che tsam ldan pa zhig yin/deb 'di rtsom sgrig byed pa'i dus tshod shin tu thung ba dang / shes bya'i khyab khongs rgya che ba/ rtsom sgrig pa'i chu tshad dma' ba bcas kyi rkyen pas skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig yod nges pas/rgya che'i dge slob rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char ci yod lhug stsol gnang rogs mkhyen/

dkar chagale'u dang po/ rtsa tshig gnad bsdus 'ga'/legs bshad ljon pa'i dbang bo/ (1)dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long (3)dag par byed pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen rgya mtsho/ (8)mngon brjod btus bsgrigs thor bu/ (16)tshig rgyan rig pa'i sdom gnad btus/ (22)mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra/ (29)le'u gnyis pa/ sum cu ba'i skor/ yi ge'i thob thang gi rnam bzhag (30)slar bsdu bshad pa/ (32)rnam dbye dang bo ngo tsam brjod pa/ (32)rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra bshad pa/ (33)rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra bshad pa/ (34)la don bshad pa/ (35)na la'i 'jug tshul gzhan bshad pa/ (37)'byung khungs bshad pa/ (38)rnam dbye'i go don bshad pa/ (39)'bod sgra/ (40)rgyan sdud/ (41)lhag bcas/ (42)'byed sdud/ (43)ni sgra/ (44)dang sgra/ (45)spyi sgra/ (46)bdag sgra/ (47)dgag sgra/ (48)de sgra/ (49)tshig phrad cing sogs bshad pa/ (49)tshig phrad spyi'i go don/ (51)le'u gsum pa/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i skor/tshigs bcad rtsom yig 'bri tshul/ (52)rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ (53)1

dpe rgyan bshad pa/ (55)gzugs rgyan bshad pa/ (60)le'u bzhi ba/ nyer spyod yig rigs/brda tho/ (66)ngo sprod yi ge (66)'phrin yig (67)re 'dun zhu yig (67)kros tshogs zin bris/ (68)gan rgya/ (69)'tshams 'dri'i yi ge ༷ (70)thugs/ rje che zhu ba'i yi ge (71)gsar 'gyur stabs bde 'bri tshul/ (72)brda khyab 'bri tshul/ (74)'char gzhi/ (75)spyi sdom/ (76)le'u lnga ba/ bod rtsom gyi sgor/rtswa thang dran glu/ (78)yid du 'ong ba'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho/ (78)slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya/ (79)slob ma sgod rung du bya ba'i gdam ngag (80)chu'i bstan bcos/ (81)legs bshad kyi gtam rgyud tshan pa gsum/ (82)a chung gi rta nyos pa/ (83)srong btsan sgam po/ (85)slob dpon thon mi/ (86)phyag 'jus gnang ba/ (89)shing gi bstan bcos/ (90)zhu 'phrin bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ (90)sa spyug gi rang gshis/ (91)skyed pa'i lha sras/ (91)nga rang byis pa yin dus/ (93)byes bu rnam 'byed gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan/ (96)2

bhe rdobye hūṃ rdo hūṃbye rte ༷ rdoXrgya ༷ ༷ ra gle nga ba ༷/༷rteX/rdoX ༷ nibhe/ bhesdesto sdi shi ༷ nga rdo hūm̐ shi ༵ / ga 'a dzu gas srol / ༷/༷//byesdi ༷ / bye snye rto bye sdi ༷༷/ ༷ ༷༷/ rdo ༷ rapa rtso/ ma gyi skor / ༷༷༷/༷hūṃ sdebye / /༷ṭwā nghru/rdob ba rdo na ba ༷ ci ༷ to ga ༷/༷༷༷nghru/snye hūm̐hūm̐ nghru ༷༷ ༷ zhu da byi ba sa ca na ༷/༷rtesheX/rdo nghrurdo sde sdenghru sde/༵ shi / nga ba yi na ༷༷༷༷༷
nghrurdo sdinihūṃhāX/ ༷/ ༷༷ ༷'i/ ༷༷ ༷ rmang ga zhi 'i shes bya 'i sko ra / ༷༷/༷rdo

le'u dang po/ rtsa tshig gnad bsdus 'ga'/legs bshad ljon pa'i dbang bo/༄༅// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ / bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus btud nas/ /thon mi'i legs bshad sum cu ba'i/ / snying bo mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal bo ru/ / byed pa i u e o bzhi/ / gsal byed ga sogs sum cu yin/ / ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ /ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug bcu/ / da dang sa gnyis yang 'jug ste/ / da ni na ra la gsum dang / / sa bee ga nga ba mar 'thob/ /ga da ba ma 'a sngon 'jug / go ngo do no bo mo 'o/ / ro lo so to slar bsdu ste/ / rdzogs tshig zla sdud ces kyang bya/ / drag yod to dang mtha' med 'o/ / gzhan rnams ming mtha'i rjes mthun sbyar/ / su ra ru du na la tu/ / la don rnam pa bdun yin te/ / rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang / / de nyid tshe skabs rnams la 'jug / sa su ga ba da drag tu/ / nga da na ma ra la du/ / 'a dang mtha' med ra dang ru/ / gi gyi kyi 'i yi lnga bo/ / rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra dang / /de rnams sa mtha' can lnga bee/ / rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra ste/ / sbyor tshul na ma ra la gyi/ / da ba sa kyi ga nga gi/ / 'a dang mtha' med 'i dang yi/ / kyang yang 'ang gsum rgyan sdud de/ / ga da ba sa drag mthar kyang / / nga na ma ra la mthar yang / / 'a dang mtha' med 'ang dang yang / / te de ste gsum lhag bcas te/ / na ra la sa drag mthar te/ / da de ga nga ba ma 'a/ / mtha' med rnams la sa ste 'thob/ / gam ngam dam nam bam 'am mam/ / ram lam sam tam 'byed sdud de/ / sbyor tshul slar bsdu'i skabs dang mtshungs/ / ra ru 'i yi 'ang yang rnams/ / rkang ba mi skong skong ba'i khyad/ / 'o 'u 'am gyi gong du tsheg / med dang yod pa'ang de bzhin yin/ / nas las 'byung khungs dgar sdud de/ /'byung khungs dngos la gang sbyar thus/ / rigs mthun dgar nas mi mthun las/ / sdud la nas sgra kho na 'jug / kye dang kwa ye 'bod sgra ste/ / phal cher ming gi thog mar sbyor/ / ni ni dgar dang brnan

pa'i sgra/ / dang bee sdud 'byed rgyu ma tshan dang / / tshe ska bas gdams ngag lnga la 'jug / ming gi thog ma'i de sgra bee/ / tha snyad 'das ma thag pa dang / / rnam grangs gzhan can gnyis la 'jug / ci ji su gang spyi sgra ste/ / zhig ste slad 'dra phyir la ci/ / snyed srid ltar bzhin skad la ji/ / su ni gang zag kun la'o/ / na ro yod med pa ba ma/ / bdab ngo/'i sgra ste ga da na/ / ba ma sa dang drag mthar pa/ / nga 'a ra la mtha' med la/ / bdag sgra yar gyur ba dang bee/ / cha la pa nyid sbyor ba legs/ / ming mtha'i pa ba'ang phal cher 'dra/ / ma ni nges med skabs dang sbyar/ / ma mi min med dgag sgra ste/ / ma mi thog ma min med mjug / ma ni bar gyi gsal byed la'ang / / tshig phrad zheng sogs nga na ma/ / 'a dang ra la mtha' med mthar/ / zhing zhes zhe 'o zhe na zhig / ga da ba dang da drag mthar/ / cing ces ce 'o ce na cig / sa mthar dmigs bsal zhes ma gtogs/ / shing shig she 'o she na 'thob/ /'on kyang kha cig lhan cig sogs/ / ming gi cha da nga ma nor gces/ / rkyang ba 'phul la 'a mtha' dgos/ / gug byed brtsegs 'dogs can la spang / / lhug pa'i don mang ming mtshamab/ dang / / don 'bring 'byed dang don nyung rdzogs/ / tshigs bcad / ma thar chig bshad bya/ / rdzogs/ tshig mtha' can lhug pa dang / /tshigs bcad rkang mthar nyis shad 'thob/ / don tshan chen mo rdzogs pa dang / / le'u mtshams su bzhi shad dgos/ / nga yig ma gtogs yig shad dbar/ / tsheg meng de sogs zhib tu 'bad/ / tshig gi lo mas ma bsgribs shing / / don gyi 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ / legs bshad ljon pa'i dbang bo 'di/ /dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes spel/ /(bhe/ /

dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long /༄༅//na mo mañdza shri ye// rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes dpyid/ / gzhon nu'i gzugs kyes rnam rol ba// rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo dang / / dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ / mkhas mchog thon mi'i thugs mtsho las/ / byung ba'i brda sprod phyi mo mchog / rtags kyi 'jug pa'i snyeng bo'i don/ /mdor bsdus tshig gis gsal bar bya// spyir na dbyangs mo gsal byed pho/ / de phyir sha li sum cu bo/ /pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig la/ / nang gses sde tshan lngar dbye ste/ / yi ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ / kha cha tha pha tsha ma dang / / ga ja da ba dza wa zha/ / za 'a ya sha sa rnams mo/ / nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ / ra la ha a mo gsham ste/ / a ni mtshan med ces kyang bya/ / sngon 'jug lnga yi ba yig pho/ / ga da ma ning 'a mo yig /ma ni shin tu mo yin no/ / de rnams gang la gang 'jug na/ / pho yig ba ni ga ca ta/ / tsa ga nga ja nya da na/ / dza zha za ra sha sar 'jug / ma ning ga ni ca ta tsa/ / nya da na zha za ya sha/ / sar 'jug ma ning da yig ni/ / ga pa ga ba nga mar 'jug / mo yig 'a ni ga ja da/ / ba dza kha cha tha pha tshar/ / shin tu mo yi ma yig ni/ / kha cha tha tsha ga ja da/ / dza nga nya na rnams la 'jug / ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ / pho ni sgra rtsol drag par 'jug / ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin/ / mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis te/ / shin tu mo ni mnyam pas so/ / ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ / thog mar 'di ltar shes dgos te/ / las gang zhig la byed pa po/ / gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba yi/ / dbang du byas nas byed po dang / / de yi byed po gnyis po ni/ / dngos po bdag yin bya yul du/ / bya ba gnyis po dngos po gzhan/ / de bzhin byed pa po gzhan dang / / dngos su 'brel min ji ltar yang / / bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang / / bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs dang / / byed bzhin pa ni da lta ba/ / de phyir dus gsum dbye bas ni/ / byed las dang 'brel ngag gi ni/ / sbyor ba kun la khyab pa yin/ / bdag gzhan dbye bas de tsam du/ / khyab pa min yang byed po dang / / bya yul bsdu phyir dbye ba de/ / mdzad nas bdag gzhan dang 'brel ba'i// bya byed rnams 3

kyang de khongs bsdus/ / des na dus gsum du dbye ba/ / bdag gzhan dbye bas ma khyab pa/ / bsdu ba'i don tu shes dgos par/ / gsungs kyang sngon 'jug 'a yig skabs/ / byed las tsam dang 'brel ba yi/ / dngos po bdag la'ang 'jug pa mthong / / de ltar nges nas pho yig ba/ / bsgrubs so lta bu 'das pa dang / / bsgrub bya'i lha dang bsgrub par bya/ / zhes sogs dngos po gzhan la 'jug / ma ning ga da gnyis po ni/ / gcod pa po dang gcod par byed/ / gcod par 'gyur dang dkri ba po/ /dkri bar byed dang dkri bar 'gyur/ / zhes sogs dngos po bdag don dang / / gcad bya'i shing dang gcad par bya/ / dkri bya'i snal ma dkri bar bya/ / zhes sogs dngos po gzhan don dang / / gcod bzhin pa dang dkri bzhin pa/ / zhes sogs da lta bsgrub ched 'jug / mo yig 'a ni 'chad pa po/ /'chad par byed dang 'chad par 'gyur/ / zhes sogs dngos po bdag dngos dang / / 'gro ba po dang 'gro bar byed/ / ces sogs bdag don phal ba dang / / 'khyil lo zhes sogs da lta dang / / 'khyil bar 'gyur sogs ma 'ongs 'jug / shin tu mo yi ma yig ni/ / bdag gzhan dus gsum mnyam par 'jug / 'on kyang byed po gzhan dngos dang / / 'brel ba'i 'das la 'a'i sngon 'jug / med par nges shing ga da nyung / / da lta ba la ba'i sngon 'jug / nyung zhing mgo can da lta bar/ / bas 'phul med pa nges par tsam/ / gzhan yang bas 'phul can phal cher/ / byed pa po ni da lta dang / / bya yul ma 'ongs par bsdus nas/ / 'das la bas 'phul yang 'jug yod/ / da lta ba la gnyis ga med/ / ma 'ongs 'phul yod yang 'jug med/ / bskul tshig 'phul med yang 'jug yod/ / skabs 'gar 'das dang skul tshig la/ / sa rkyang sbyar bas thus pa'ang yod/ / rjes 'jug yi ge bcu bo yi/ / ga da ba sa bzhi rnams pho/ / nga ma 'a gsum mo yin zhing / / na ra la gsum ma dang ste/ / ming gzhi'i yi ge kun la 'jug / ji ltar 'jug tshul gnyis yin te/ / dang po sgra yi 'jug tshul ni/ / pho yi ga yig yang 'jug can/ / skyes bu rab dang pho yig ba/ / yang 'jug can ni skyes bu 'bring // ga ba yang 'jug med 4

na gnyis pa ste/ / dper na shar tu 'gro lta bu/ / phan thogs med kyang bya yul dang / / bya ba ngo bo gcig yin na/ / gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid de/ / dpen na lha ru gsal lta bu/ / gang zhig gang la brten pa'am/ / gnas dang yod pa'i don tsam las/ / bya ba gtan nas mi byed na/ / rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi ste/ / dper na steng du mi yod ltar/ / tshe skabs gnyis dang don 'dra na/ /bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs te/ / dper na chu zla shar ba na/ / cho 'phrul dus chen tshugs lta bu/ /rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang / / de nyid tshe skabs gsal byed sgra/ / su ra ru du na la tu/ / yin zhing phal cher la sgra dang / / mthun pas la don rnam dbye'ang zer/ / rnam dbye gang la sbyor yul des/ / nye 'gyangs gang du bya ba zhig / byas na gsum pa byed sgra ste/ / dper na bdag gis bshad lta bu/ / bya ba gtan nas mi byed par/ / snga phyi 'brel byed tsam ston na/ / rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste/ /sa mtha' yod dang med pa yi/ / gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga yin/ / gang zhig gang las byung ba'am/ / bye dang lhung ba'i don ldan na/ / rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs te/ / dper na zhal nas thos lta bu/ / gsal byed sgra ni nas las te/ / dgar dang sdud pa'ang lnga bar gtogs/ / gzhan yang tshigs don gong 'og tu/ / bsdu rgyu yod na sdud pa'i sgra/ / dang dang kyang 'ang yang sogs sbyor/ / rnam grangs du mas don bskyar na/ / 'byed sdud sgra 'jug dgag pa dang / / bdag don yod na thog mtha' ru/ / pa sde'i rtags rnams ci rigs 'jug / rgyan du gyur ba'i tshig phrad kyang / / don la bsnyegs pa yod na sbyor/ /de bzhin bstan bya lhag yod na/ / lhag bcas sgra sbyor tshig don ni/ / rdzogs na slar bsdu'i sgra rnams spyor/ / dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na/ / mo yig dbyangs dang mi ldan na/ / pho yig gsal byed brjod mi nus/ / de phyir dbyangs lngar bzhed pa bde/ / pho yig dbyangs ldan de dag la'ang / / rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ / don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i/ / ming dang don gyi khyad par rnams/ / ston pa'i tshig dang don ldan pa'i/ / ngag gi brjod pa yod min te/ / yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung zhing / /6

ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung nas/ / tshig gis don rnams ston nga/sa so/ / ming tshig brjod pa med par 'gyur/ / de phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams kyi/ / rjes su 'brangs nas gsung pa 'di/ / skye bo kun gyis rtogs gyur cig / tshig gi sgra tsam 'dra na yang / / don la khyad par shin tu che/ / de phyir brda dag la brten nas/ / ma nor don rnams 'tshol ba gces/ / don la mi rmongs rmongs pa yang / /lugs 'dir mkhas min gyis byed de/ / sgra shes don la mi rmongs zhes/ / mkhas pa'i gsung la yongs su grags/ / 'di la ma sbyangs rmongs tshod kyis/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grwar 'jug pa/ / wa skyes seng lpags gyon pa bzhin/ / nam zhig rjes ngan gsal bar 'gyur/ / de phyir blo gsal don gnyer rnams/ / rtags 'jug dka' gnad gzugs brnyan kun/ / gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'dir/ / la 'ur gzugs mor spyon ngang kye/ / 'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ / gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags/ / cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dges/ / kun gyis 'di don rtogs par shog / /

dag par bye da pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen rgya mtsho/shes paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/o bde legs su gyur cig / ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ /spyir ni bod kyi yi ge la/ / ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug go /dbyangs dang gsal byed gnyis su dbye/ / da sa gnyis ni yang 'jug ste/ /dbyangs yig i u e o bzhi/ / da ni na ra la gsum dang / /gsal byed ga sogs sum cu yin/ / sa ni ga nga ba mar 'thob/ /gsal byed yi ge sum cu las/ / su ru ra du na la tu/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu dbyung la/ / la don rnam pa bdun du 'dod/ /de las sngon 'jug lnga dbyung bya/ / sa su ga ba da drag tu/ /ga da ba ma 'a sngon 'jug / nga da na ma ra la du/ /'a dang mtha' med ra dang ru/ / 'a dang mtha' med 'i dang yi/ /gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga bo/ / kyang yang 'ang gsum rgyan sdud de/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra dang / / ga da ba sa drag mthar kyang / /de rnams sa mtha' can lnga ni/ / nga na ma ra la mthar yang / /rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa'i sgra/ / 'a dang mtha' rten med pa'i mthar/ /sbyor tshul na ma ra la gyi/ / 'ang dang yang gnyis skabs bstun sbyor/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi / de te ste gsum lhag bcas te/ /8

na ra la sa drag mthar te// thugs la mnga' ba ma mnga' yin/ /da de ga nga ba ma 'a// brdung bya'i rnga ni ra rnga la/ /mtha' med rnams la sa ste 'thob// grangs kyi lnga ni la lnga yin/ /phrad dang rnam dbye la rmongs na/ / gong mas mngags pa ma mngags la/ /sdeb legs tshig phreng spel nus min/ / sngags 'dren pa dang sngags pa sogs/ /de phyir brda sprod gzhung don la/ / sa sngags yin pas shes bar bya/ /brtson pa drag pos bslab par 'tshal/ / gong ma'i drung ni da drung la/ /yi ra ku sha'i zhal zas dang / / spyang grung 'dzoms pa ga grung yin/ /ga ba ko ba ga rkyang yin/ / drung du mjal ba ma mjal la /skor ba skor dang skor mdzod dang / / bu lon 'jal ba 'a 'jal yin/ /sa mtha' skor ba sa skor yin/ / 'bru yi gro ni ga gro la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni sa sku la/ / me dang nyi ma da dro yin/ /rkun ma dag ni ra rku yin/ / shing gi 'khan pa 'a 'khan la/ /ku co byed pa ku rkyang la/ / mkhan po mkhas ba'i dbang bo dang / /lkugs pa dag ni la lkugs yin/ / mkhar gyang la sogs ma yis 'phul/ /bkra shis tshon bkra bas 'phul bkra/ / dus las 'da' ba 'a 'da' la/ /mgo bo'i skra ni sa skra yin/ / lung ba'i mda' dang 'phen pa'i mda'/ /mgo mjug mgo ni ma mgo yin/ / ma mda' yin pas shes par bya/ / nad sogs 'go ba 'a 'go yin/ / gnam gyi zla ba grogs kyi zla/ /dus tshod snga ba sa snga la/ / zlog pa blum po slo ba dang / /9

lcags rigs zha nye zha rkyang la/ / khungs su gtogs pa ga gtogs yin/ /'phur ba'i bya ni ba bya yin/ / bor ba'i stor ba sa stor la/ /'thung ba'i ja ni ja rkyang la/ / gtor ma gtor ba ga gtor yin/ /ljon shing ljang gu la ljang yin/ / sde ba dag ni sa sde la/ /gyen la 'dren pa da 'dren la/ / sku khams bde ba ba bde yin/ /dngos rdzas 'grem pa ga 'grem yin/ / dbang du sdud pa sa sdud la/ /rnam pa mang bo ra rnam la/ / bar chad bdud ni ba bdud yin/ /sna tshogs dag ni sa sna yin/ / nang du gshegs pa ga gshegs la/ /dus kyi dbyar ni da dbyar la/ / sdog pa bshags pa ba bshags yin/ /g.yar dam g.yor ba ga g.yor yin/ / mtho ba'i sgang ni sa sgang la/ / khog pa'i snying ni sa snying la/ / sgye sdod dgang ba da dgang yin/ /gsar rnying rnying ni ra rnyeng yin/ / gnas nas spor pa sa spor la/ /gcod pa'i gri ni ga gri la/ / dpag tu med pa da dpag yin/ /mnan pa'i dri ni da dri yin/ / pags pa 'bri tshe pags rkyang la/ /gzhan la ster ba sa ster la/ / stag lpags sogs la la lpags 'bri/ /mdzod kyi gter ni ga gter yin/ / dpal 'byor dpe cha la sogs pa/ /dngos po 'dzad pa 'a 'dzad la/ / da yis 'phul bas shes par bya/ /bya ba mdzad dang khang ba'i mdzod/ / ljon shing stag pa dud 'akro'i stag /mdzes ma la sogs ma yis 'phul// sa stag yin pas shes par bya /sems kyi rtog pa ra rtog la/ / dmigs yul dmigs bsal da dmigs la/ /

byed nges sreg tsha gdung can/ / sos ga'i ming dang char 'bab dus// sprin 'byung char ldan dbyar gyi ming // 'bras ldan dus kyi lnga ba dang / / mda' sbyin ston gyi ming du grags// 'gro 'ong 'dor byed zla ba'i 'phreng // bgrang gzhi bgrang bya lo yi ming //lnga/ chu'i skor/chu spel chu gter zla bas 'phel/ / rin chen 'byung gnas si rdzu'i bdag / zla ba'i ma ma rgya mtsho'i ming / / dag byed ngan sel 'bru phan dang / / sprin gyi myu gu chu yi ming / / 'dzum dkar chu sbur wu ba'i ming // chu 'khyags chab rom 'khyag pa'i ming / / 'khyog 'grog zhol 'gro gyu gyu 'phros/ / nyal 'gro 'jig rten shing rta ma// dpa' rlabs can ma 'bab chu'i ming / /drug srog chags kyi skor/gser mig can dang mig mi 'dzum/ / chur nyal rgyab ring nya yi ming / / 'gram skyong bul 'akro ngan shubs can/ / yan lag lnga ba rus sbal ming / / skye ba lnga ba g.yas 'khyil ming / / na kra 'dzin khri chu srin ming / / lce med 'phar 'gro sbal ba ste/ / 'ug pa mchod byed sram gyi ming / / lce gnyis brang 'akro rlung zas can// dug 'dzin 'khyog 'gro sbrul gyi ming //bdun/ ri dwags sogs kyi skor/'phrog byed gdong lnga ral ba can/ / sder chags rgyal bo seng ge'i ming // lus bkra dri snom ngar skad can/ / nags kyi shā na stag gi ming / / pags bkra khyi gshed thig le'i lus/ / gzig gi ming du grags pa yin/ / slu byed sgyu mang ngan g.yo ma/ / gcan gzan khram pa wa yi ming / / gcig pur gnas dang rwa gcig pa// bse ru'i ming ste spre'u la// gnyer ma'i gdong dang bzhin ngan zer/ /brgyad/ 'dab chags kyi skor/sgong skyes tshangs skyes gnyis skyes dang / / mkha' 'gro 'dab chags bya spyi'i ming / / mig mdzes /8

bcu gnyis/ me sogs kyi skor/'khyog 'bar bi shā na ra'i bu/ / rlung gi krogs po lam nag zhugs/ / nor las rgyal rnams me yi ming / / dri bzhon rtag 'akro ma mos 'phel/ / rdul gyi 'khor lo rlung spyi'i ming / / khyim gyi nor bu snum za dang / / snang gsal sgron me mar me'i ming /bcu gsum/ rin po che'i skor/sa zla mdog bzang sa le sbram/ / rin chen dang bo gser gyi ming / / rin chen gnyis pa dngul ming ste/ / rdo yi rgyal bo g.yu yi ming / / krol ba can ni mu tig ste/ / lus dmar 'dab dang dpal me tog / rin chen sdong bo byu ru'i ming / /bcu bzhi/ phyugs rigs kyi skor/lag ldan gnyis 'thung myos bum can/ / so ldan nyi bu so gnyis pa/ / dbyug pa'i sna can glang bo'i ming / / mgyogs 'gro rgyab 'dzin rtag tu za/ / bang ldan rnga g.yab rngog ma can/ / rlung gi shing rta rta spyi'i ming / / cang shes legs 'akro rlung gshog can/ / rigs ldan gyi ling rta mchog ming / / bzang bo khyu mchog glang la ste/ / skog shal nog can ba lang ming / / rtsid pa can dang ngur sgra can/ / nor bcos 'bri g.yag ming du grags/ / grong gi gcan gzan rdzi gsang pa/ / mchu ring spu rengs rdo rje'i mchu/ / 'khor lo'i gdong ni phag gi ming / /bco lnga/ mi'i skor/gang zag shed bu ma nu'i bu/ / rkang gnyis shes ldan mi spyi'i ming / / sa skyong mi rje skye dgu'i bdag / sa bdag mi dbang rgyal bo'i ming / / bka' dbang gros sdod mdun na 'don/ / phying sa sna chen blon po'i ming / / brtul phod stobs chen g.yul ngor brtan/ / pha rol gzhon pa dpa' bo'i ming / / dpung gi khyu mchog ral gri'i gnyen/ / dmag gi 'dren pa dmag dpon ming / / blo ldan 20

sems shes dus yig can/ / dpyod ldan rnam gsal dran pa'i dbang / / gsal sgo kun rig grangs can mdzangs// rig pa'i dpa' bo mkhas pa'i ming // lam ston bla ma slob dpon ming // grwa ba nye gnas slob ma'i ming / / phyugs skyong phyugs ldan 'brog pa'i ming / / 'tsho tshis so nam zhing ba'i ming / / yan lag mchog ma glang chen 'gros/ / lus phra sgeg mo sked med ma/ / ri dwags mig can mdzes ma'i ming / / zho 'thung bus pa byis pa'i ming / / thong bu lang tsho gzhon nu'i ming / / smin dang lo mang khur ldan dang / / bzhi ba'i gnas skabs rgan po'i ming / / gtam skyel nyan rna bya ma rta/ /'phrin skyel bang chen pho nya'i ming //bcu drug / dbang bo lnga'i skor/zag phung nyer len phung bo gzugs/ / tshogs pa sku ni lus spyi'i ming / / lta byed 'dren byed lha'i sgrol ma/ / snang byed tsakṣa spyan mig ming / / sgra 'dzin thos 'dzin nyan byed snyan/ / rna ba'i ming ste sdom byed shangs/ / dri 'dzin dri len sna yi ming / / bcud ma ro 'dzin ngag gi 'dab/ / smra ba'i 'bab stegs ljags lce'i ming / / mig 'dzin dbu dang yan lag mchog / mgo bo'i ming ste skra la ni/ / ral ba thor tshugs slar skyes dang / /gtsug phud mgo nyal lan pu zer/ / yal ga lnga ba dpung pa'i 'dab/ /sug pa 'dzin byed lag pa'i ming / / lag pa'i yal ga sor mo'i ming / / sha mchog srog gnas tsitta thugs/ / sems kyi khang ba snying gi ming / / smra byed za byed smra ba'i sgo/ / gtam gyi 'byung gnas kha yi ming / /bcu bdun/ zas dang ca lag gi skor/mda' rten mda' za mda' snun byed/ / mda' byed gnam ru gzhu yi ming / / nyag phran 'bigs byed rtse mo can/ / sgro ldan drang 'akro mda' yi ming // shang lang rdeg cha rjes su gcod/ / dpal gyi snying bo ral gri'i ming // gcod byed rnga byed zor pa'i ming // rmo byed sa 'joms thol gshol ming // myos 21

byed myos 'gyur ca co byed/ / lha min nying khu chang gi ming / / mngar ldan spra chil sbral rtsi'i ming rtsi bcud bsrubs skyes mar gyi ming / /tshig rgyan rig pa'i sdom gnad btus/lus dang rgyan dang skyon sel gsum/ / snyan ngag gzhung gi brjod bya ste/ / lus ni re zhig 'dod pa yi/ / don gyi rnam bcad tshig gi phreng / / der yang bcad lhug spel ma gsum/ / bod skad tshigs bcad rkang bzhir/ / tsheg bar grangs ni cha mnyam zhing / / tshig rkang re re'i tsheg bar grangs/ lnga nas so gsum bar du bshad/ / sngon byung gtam dang sde bzhi sogs/ / brjod bya'i don ni srog yin la/ / snyan ngag mdzes par byed pa yi/ / chos la rgyan zhes bya bar brjod/ / sgra don sdeb sbyor nyams pa dang / / yul dus 'gal sogs skyon bcu bo/ / ma lus sel la skyon sel bya/ / lho shar thun mong rgyan de la/ / dbye na don rgyan sgra rgyan dang / / gab tshig rgyan te rnam pa gsum/ / brjod bya'i don gyi nyams gtso bor/ / 'don pa don rgyan so lnga ste/ / rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ / gzuṭa can gsal byed bskor ba dang / / 'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / / ldog pa can dang srid pa can/ /bsdus dang phul byung rab rtog dang / / rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ / dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid can/ / rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan/ / rgya che bsnyon dor sbyar ba dang / / khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang / / 'gal dang skabs min bstod dang / / zol bstod nges bstan lhan cig brjod/ / yongs brjes shis brjod rab spel dang / / dgongs ba can te so lnga'o/ / dngos po'i rang bzhin brjod skabs sogs/ / gang yin de las gzhan du ni/ / sgro 'dogs med par drang bo ru/ /brjod pa rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/ /dbye ba rigs dang bya ba dang / / yon tan rdzas dang bzhi ru —2

'dod/ / rigs spyi'i chos rnams drang por brjod/ / rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod par 'dod/ /bya ba gtsor ston drang po'i ngag / bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod par 'dod/ / yon tan gtsor ston drang po'i ngag / yon tan rang bzhin brjod ces bya/ / rdzas kyi dngos po drang por brjod/ / rdzas brjod rang bzhin rgyan zhes bya/ / dpe don tha dad bkod pa las/ / mtshungs par rtogs byed dpe rgyan yin/ / dpe don sbyor tshul so gnyis te/ / chos dpe dngos dpe zlog pa dang / / phan tshun nges dang nges med bsdus/ / phul byung rab btags rmad byung rmongs/ / the tshom gtan 'bebs sbyar mnyam nyid/ / smad dang bsngags dang brjod 'dod dang / 'gal dang dgag pa ngo bstod dang / / de nyid brjod dang thun mong min/ / byung min srid min mang ba dang / / rnam 'gyur phreng ba ngag don gnyis/ /zla bo'i dngos dang mtshungs sbyor rgyu/ / dpe dang dpe can mtshungs pa'i chos/ / mjug tu bkod pa chos dper 'dod/ / dpe dang dpe tsam zhig nas/ / mtshungs chos mi ston dngos po'i dpe/ /dpe dang dpe can go ldog nas/ / de gnyis mtshungs ston bzlog pa'i dpe/ /dpe dang dpe can phan tshun du/ / 'jal res byed pa phan tshun dpe/ / dper bkod de las gzhan mtshungs dpe/ / yod pa 'gog byed nges pa'i dpe/ / dper bkod de mtshungs min gzhan gyis kyang / / yod na dper 'os nges med dpe/ / phyogs res mtshungs min gzhan gyis kyang / / mtshungs par ston pa bsdus pa'i dpe/ / 'dra min khyad par gnyis las gzhan/ / med par brjod pa phul byung dpe/ / dpe der ma snyegs gzhan la yang / / 'dra chos yod ces rab btags dpe/ / dpe der khyad chos de ldan na/ /dper 'os zhes brjod rmad byung dpe/ / dpe dang dpe can phan tshun du/ / 'khrul bar ston pa'i rmongs pa'i dpe/ / chos mtshungs dpe dang dpe can gnyis/ / dbye ba 'byed min the tshom dpe/ / 'dra dang 'dra min chos gzhan gyis/ / dpe dang dbye 'byed gtan 'bebs dpe/ /23

gnyis las mi nyung don sbyar zhing / / mtshungs sgra ldan pa sbyar ba'i dpe/ / sgra gcig gcod mtshams ming gcig la/ / don gnyis mtshungs sbyar mnyam nyid dpe/ / mtshungs dpe 'ga' yi skyon brjod de/ / dpe la smod pa smad pa'i dpe/ / chos mtshungs dpe dga' sngon bkod nas/ / de dang mtshungs zhes bsngags pa'i dpe/ / skyon yon ji ltar ldan gyur kyang / / dpe don mtshungs zhes brjod 'dod dpe/ / chos mtshungs dpe dang dpe can gnyis/ / 'gal bar brjod pa 'gal pa'i dpe/ / dpe yi skyon 'gas mtshungs pa'i dper/ / mi 'os zhes 'gog dgag pa'i dpe/ /mtshungs chos cha tshang mi ldan yang / /dpe don mtshungs zhes ngo bstod dpe/ / mtshungs chos ldan 'di dpe min zhing / / dpe can yin zhes de nyid dpe/ / chos mtshungs dpe 'gas mtshungs min pas/ / rang nyid dper ston thun mong min/ / dpe yi khyad chos kun bsdus pa/ / khyod la ldan zhes byung min dpe/ / dpe la skyon de med pa ltar/ / dpe can mtshungs zhes srid min dpe/ / chos mthun dpe 'ga'i khyad chos gcig / don la ldan zhes mang ba'i dpe/ / chos mtshungs dpe can dpe'i nang nas/ / phyung ba ltar brjod rnam gyur dpe/ / 'brel mtshungs dpe 'ga' snga phyi ru/ /dpe can ltar brjod phreng ba'i dpe/ / snga phyi don dman bya ba gcig / dpe don mtshungs ston mtshungs spyor dpe/ / dpe lhag don dman bya ba gcig / mnyam rtogs zla bo dngos po'i dpe/ /mtshungs chos de nyid rgyu mtshan du/ / bkod nas mtshungs ston rgyu yi dpe/ / rtags tshig tha dad dpe dman lhag / sbyor mkhas skyon ni med pa'ang yod/ / brjod 'dod don nyid dpe de yi/ /gzugs su bkod pa gzugs can rgyan/ / dpe dang dpe can gnyis bar gyi/ / 'brel sgra bsdus pa bsdus pa'i gzugs/ / bar gyi 'brel sgra ma bsdus pa/ / ma bsdus pa yi gzugs can no/ / dpe dang dpe can gnyis po yi/ / bar du 'brel sgra 'ga' zhig ni/ / bsdus shing 'ga' zhig ma bsdus pa/ /24

bsdus shing ma bsdus gzugs can no/ / cha dang cha can thams cad kun/ / gzugs byas mtha' dag gzugs can no/ / yan lag can ni gzugs byas la/ / yan lag gzugs su byas ma byas/ / ci ltar rigs pa 'theng 'gros ltar/ / spel mar spyor ba mi mnyam gzugs/ / rgyu mtshan gang gis dpe dngos su/ / rtogs byed rgyu yi gzugs can no/ / dpe can de nyid gzugs gcig tu/ /bkod rjes de yang gzhan zhig gi / gzugs su bkod pa 'phar ma ste/ / gzugs can gyi ni gzugs can no/ / dngos su dpe can de yi chos/ / gang zhig bkod pa'i rjes su slar/ / gzugs de min zhes 'gog byed pa/ / bsnyon dor gzugs can zhes bya brjod/ / rigs dang bya ba yon tan sogs/ / brjod tshig thog mtha' bar gang na/ / gnas des tshig kun gsal byed pa/ / gsal byed rgyu ru 'dod pa yin/ / dbye na rigs dang bya ba sogs/ / dbye ba rnam pa bcu gnyis so/ / rigs ston thog ma'i tshig gis gzhan/ / gsal byed rigs brjodathog ma'i gsal/ / bya tshig thog ma bkod des tshig / gzhan gsal bya brjod thog ma'i gsal/ / yon tan thog ma bkod des tshig / gzhan gsal yon tan thog ma'i gsal/ / tshig don gang rung gnas gsum du/ / yang yang bzlas pa bskor ba'i rgyan/ / don bskor tshig bskor gnyis gang bskor/ / bskor pa'i rgyan ni rnam pa gsum/ / mi 'dra'i tsheg gis don gcig la/ / yang yang bskor ba don la bskor/ / mi 'dra'i don rnams tshig gcig la/ / yang yang bzlas pa tshig la bskor/ / don de dgag byar byas nas de/ / sgrub tu mi ster 'gog pa'i rgyan/ / dbye na nyi shu rtsa gsum yod/ / byung zin don der min pa'i blo/ / skyes pa (pas) 'gog pa 'das pa 'gog / 'bras de 'byung ba'i rgyu gang zhig / sngon byas med ces rgyu 'gog pa'o/ / don der ma lus gzhan du ni/ / gus par ston pa ma gus 'gog / shis brjod tshig gis gsal byas nas/ / de nyid 'gog byed shis pa'i 'gog / don de bsgrub byar sngon bkod nas/ /2

sgrub byed rjes bkod don gzhan bkod/ / dbye ba rnam pa brgyad yin no/ / kun khyab khyad par la gnas dang / / sbyar dang 'gal dang mi 'os 'os/ / 'os shing mi 'os de ldog brgyad/ / don chos bsgrub byar kun khyab kyi/ / sgrub byed bkol pa kun khyab don/ / skyon yon bsgrub byar sgrub byed kyang / / de mtshungs bkod pa 'gal don gzhan/ / yongs grags las brgal 'ud ched pos/ / don gyi khyad ston phul byung rgyan/ / don gyi khyad chos de las lhag / dpe la med ston khyad 'phags phul/ / don chos 'ga' la the tshom dang / / 'ud brjod the tshom phul byung ngo/ / nges rnyed dka' ltar 'ud byas nas/ / rtags kyis nges rnyed nges pa phul/ / don chos gcig la khyab 'phags pa'i/ /tshad 'das bsngags brjod ngo mtshar phul/ / sems dang ldan pa'am sems med kyi/ / khyad chos ji ltar gnas pa las/ / rnam pa gzhan du sgro btags pa'i/ / rab rtog sgra ldan rab rtog rgyan/ / dbye na sems ldan sems med dang / / ting 'dzin rab rtog rnam pa gsum/ / sems med chos dngos gzhan zhig tu/ / sgo btags sems ldan rab rtog ste/ / sems med chos de gzhan zhig tu/ / sgro btags sems med rab rtog go / phyi nang rnam 'gyur brda sogs kyis/ / bsam don go byed phra mo'i rgyan/ / dbye na zur gyi phra mo dang / / rnam pa'i phra mo gnyis su 'dod/ / bsam don mtshon byed phyi yi brdas/ / go byed zur gyi phra mor 'dod/ / bsam don ma rmongasarnam 'gyur gyis/ / don ston rnam pa'i phra mo'o/ / bsgrib bya'i don gang sgrib byed gyis/ / zol du kha bsgyur cha yi rgyan/ / dbye na bzhi ste 'os pa dang / / mi 'os zol gyis smad dang bstod/ / gsal zin 'os pa'i bsgrib bya'i don/ / de mthun sgrib 'os byed 'os pa gzhan/ /zol gyis smras te sbed byed pa/ /'os pa'i cha yi rgyan du 'dod/ /gsal zin 'os min dngos po zhig / sgrib byed 'os pa'i dngos gzhan la/ / bsgyur nas zol gyis sbed byed pa/ / mi 'os pa yi cha rgyan nyid/ / bsgrib bya'i skyon sogs bstod pa'i tshul/ / byas te smad 26

pa zol gyis smad/ / sgrib byed zol gyis smad pa'i shugs/ / yon tan ston pa bstod pa'i cha/ /brjod bya'i don gyi go rim ltar/ / dpe rnams bkod pa rim pa can/ / khyad 'phags nyams ldan dga' ba'i sems/ / dngos su ston byed dga' ba'i rgyan/ / dbye na dngos thob dga' ba dang / /gzugs brnyan gyi ni dga' ba gnyis/ / dga' yul dngos thob dga' ba'i nyams/ / ston byed dngos thob dga' ba'i rgyan/ / gzugs brnyan tsam la'ang dga' ba'i nyams/ / ston byed gzugs brnyan dga' ba'i rgyan/ / sgeg sogs nyams brgyad gang rung gi / rnam gyur ston pa nyams ldan rgyan/ / dbye na rnam pa brgyad yin te/ / sgeg dang drag shul dpa' ba dang / / snying rje mi sdug bzhad gad dang / / rmad byung dang ni 'jigs rung ngo / / khyad 'phags yon tan ldan pa yi/ /nyams 'gyur brjod pa sgeg pa'i nyams/ / khros pa'i nyams kyis phyi rol tu/ / drag shul che ston drag shul nyams/ / phun tshogs yon tan ldan pa las/ / spro ba 'phel ston dpa' ba'i nyams/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de 'bras la/ / spyod par mi bzod snying rje'i nyams/ / yid du mi 'os dngos po yis/ / zhe log skyed byed mi sdug nyams/ / brjod pa'i tshig des nyan pa por/ / bzhad gad 'phel byed bzhad gad nyams/ / sngon med khyad 'phags yon tan gyis/ / ngo mtshar skyes ston rmad byung nyams/ / 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyu gang las/ / skrag pa'i nyams ston 'jigs rung nyams/ /gzhan las khyad 'phags nga rgyal gyi/ / tshig smras gzi brjid can gyi rgyal/ / dngos yod don der de min zhes/ / bsnyon nas brjod pa bsnyen dor rgyan/ / dbye na gsum ste khyad chos dang / / yul dang rang bzhin bcas pa'o/ / khyad chos dngos de gzhan zhig tu/ / brjod de chos la bsnyon dor yin/ / yul la ltos nas rnam gzhan du/ / 'gyur bar ston pa yul la bsnyon/ / dngos de'i rang bzhin gzhan zhig tu/ / gnas par ston pa rang bzhin la'o/ / bstod pa'i skabs min 'dod 27

dbang gis/ / bstod byas skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan/ / mngon 'dod dngos po srung sgrub phyir/ /gegs med smon pa bshis brjod rgyan/ / rnam pa mi 'dra'i rgyan gnyis yan/ / mnyam du bsres pa rab spel rgyan/ / brjod byed tshig gang yig gzugs dang / / sgra dang mtshungs par sbyar ba las/ /tshig sbyor mdzes shing brjod don kyang / / legs par ston nus sgra yi rgyan/ / rtsa ba'i dbye ba rnam gsum ste/ / yi ge bskor ba'i zung ldan dang / / bya dka'i rnam grangs gzhan dang ni/ / dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka'o/ / tshig sbyor gang du gzugs mtshungs pa'i/ / yi ge'i bar du tshig gzhan gyis/ / chod dang ma chod ci rigs pas/ / yang yang bskor ba zung ldan rgyan/ / yi ge bskor ba'i zung ldan la/ / dang por yod dang gzhan la yod/ / mtha' thog sbyar dang kun tu sbyar/ / bsres dang bzlog pa'i zung ldan drug / zung ldan tshig de rkang ba yi/ / thog yod thog ma'i zung ldan yin/ /bar ma chod dang bar chod dang / / chod cing ma chod zung ldan gsum/ / zung ldan tshig snga phyi'i bar/ /gzhan gyis ma chod de'i zung ldan/ / tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang ba yi/ / re re gnyis gnyis gsum gsum bzhir/ / bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi/ / dbye ba rnam pa bco lnga yod/ / zung ldan tshig gi snga phyi'i bar/ / gzhan gyis chod gang chod pa'i zung / / zung ldan tshig rkang snga phyi'i bar/ /tshig 'bru gzhan gyis chod pa dang / / ma chod spel mar yod pa ni/ / chod cing ma chod zung ldan no/ /dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' la/ / dbyangs dang gnas dang gsal byed gsum/ / re rer bzhi gsum gnyis gcig gis/ / dbye bas rnam pa bcu gnyis so/ / gab bya'i don gang tshig sbyor gyis/ /gab par byed par gab tshig rgyan/ / snyan ngag sbyor tshe brjod don dang / / brjod tshul rjod byed tshig sbyor sogs/ / nyams pas rgyan tu mi 'gyur ba/ / de ni snyan ngag skyon tu 'dod/ / de la bcu ste don nyams dang / / don 'gal don gcig the tshom can/ / rim nyams sgra nyams gcod mtshams nyams/ / sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor nyams/ / yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten dang / / rigs 28

lung dag dang 'gal ba'o/ /mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra/bzhin ltar lta bu ji ltar sgra/ / mthun mtshungs yang dag mtshungs dang mnyam/ / yang dag gsal dang nges par gsal/ / rab gsal gzugs kyi zla bo dang / / gnyen po dang ni dgra zla dang / / so sor rtog dang 'gal dang 'dra/ / blta bcas dang ni bslu ba dang / / rigs mthun rjes su smra ba dang / /gzugs brnyan dang ni so sor sdeb/ / gzugs mtshungs mnyam dang yang dag gzhal/ / mtshan nyid mthun 'dra mtshungs pa dang / /mthun phyogs dper byas dpe dang rtog / dman dang cung zad dman sogs dang / / rab tu smra dang so sor bzlog / rigs mthun mnyam byas sgra dag dang / / gang yang dman min don can tshig / ri bong mtshan ma'i gdong can sogs/ / 'bru mang bo yi tshig sdud dang / /'gran dang rgyal dang sdang ba dang / / 'khu dang mi mthun sgrogs pa dang / / 'thab pa dang ni 'phya ba dang / / sma 'bebs byed dang smod pa dang / / co 'dri ba dang 'gog pa dang / / rgod dang phrag dog mi bzod dang / / de yi mdzes pa zum byed dang / /de yi skal bzang 'phrog byed dang / / de dang 'gran las tshar gcod dang / / de dang mtshungs las lhag par mdzes/ / de yi rjes su rkang 'jog dang / / de yi nus pa la 'jug dang / / de yi rjes 'gro rjes su 'ching / / de yi ngang tshul de 'gog dang / / de yi rjes su byed ces pa'i/ / sgra rnams mtshungs pa gsal byed yin/ /29

le'u gnyis pa/ sum cu ba'i sgor/yi ge'i thob thang gi rnam bzhag1 ci zhig la dbyangs yig zer/lan/ gnas dang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur mi gsal zhing / rang nyid gsal byed rnams dang phrad pa la brten nas ming gi brjod pa'i sgra gsal bar byed pa'i sgra ring cha can de la zer/2 ci zhig la gsal byed zer/lan/ gnas dang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal zhing / rang nyid dbyangs dang sbyar na ming dang tshig gi brjod pa gsal bor ston pa'i nus pa yod pa dang / dbyangs 'jug pa'i gzhi yin pas na de ltar zer/3 ci zhig la rjes 'jug zer/lan/ ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams kye rjes su 'jug pas na de ltar zer/4 ci zhig la sngon 'jug zer/lan/ rang gi 'jug yul gyi ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams kyi sngon du 'jug pas na de ltar zer/5 ci zhig la yang 'jug zer/lan/ rjes 'jug gi yang rjes su 'jug pas na de ltar zer/6 yang 'jug gi thob thang ji ltar yin/lan/ na ra la gsum gyi rjes su da dang / ga da ba ma bzhi'i rjes su sa thob bo/ /7 ci zhig la ming gzhi'i yi ge zer/lan/ ming dang tshig gi brjod pa'i gzhi ru gyur cing / sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug dbyangs sogs 'jug pa'i gzhi yin pas na de ltar zer/ 30

slar bsdu bshad pa/1 rdzogs tshig ni rnam dbye gang gi 'phros don dang de'i go don ci yin/lan/ de ni rnam dbye dang po'i 'phros don dang / go don ni don de re zhig rdzogs par ston pas na rdzogs tshig zer/2 ci zhig la slar bsdu dang zla sdud zer/lan/ rang gi rjes de ma thag tu slar yang rang gi tshig grogs 'byung ba sdud pa'am mi 'byung bar byas pas slar bsdu dang / rang gi mjug de ma thag tu tshig rang gi zla bo'am grogs po 'byung ba bsdus pa'am mi 'byung bar byas pas na zla sdud zer/3 rjegs tshig la 'jug yul gyi dbang du dbye na du yod/lan/ gnyis te/ ming dang bya tshig gi rjes su 'jug pa'o//4go ngo sogs yod tshad rjogs tshog ke phrad jan nam/ rgyu mtshan chi/lan/ min te/ dper na mgo bo dang bu mo lta bu'i bo dang mo ni ming gi tshig grogs yin pas so/ /rnam dbye dang bo ngo tsam brjod pa/1 ci zhig la rnam dbye dang bo zer/lan/ chos gang zhig gzhan dang mi nor ba'i ched du gsar du ming zhig btags pa la rang gi ngo bo chos gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i cha nas tshig tu grub pa zhig la zer/2 rnam dbye dang bo ming tsam brjod pa la rtsa ba'i dbye ba du yod/lan/ gnyis te/ 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub kye ming ngo / /3 ci zhig la 'dod rgyal gyi ming zer/32

lan/ rgyu mtshan med par dngos po de la thog mar 'dod pa tsam gyi brda sbyar ba dngos po de'i ming du chags pa 'dod pa ltar rgyal bar byas pas de lta zer/ dper na sa dang / chu/ me/ rlung lta bu'o/ /4 rjes grub kye ming gi go don ci yin/lan/ 'dod rgyal thog ma'i ming de'i don la go ba chags pa sngon du song ba de gzhir byas nas/rgyu mtshan dang bcas te btags pa'i ming la zer/ dper na lcags rta dang / slob grwa lta bu'o/ /5 'dod rgyal dang rjes grub kyi ming gnyis ni gang gi cha nas dbye ba dang / de'i khyad par ci yin/lan/ ming gi 'dogs stangs kyi cha nas dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig la 'dod pa tsam gyis ming brda sbyar bas na 'dod rgyal dang tha snyad gang de 'dogs par rgyu mtshan bshad du yod pa zhig la rjes grub ces pa'o/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra bshad pa/1 i ldan zhes zer ba'i don gang yin nam/ de'i rnam dbye gang dag yin/lan/ i ldan zhes pa ni gi gu dang ldan pa'i don te rnam dbye drug pa dang gsum pa yin/2 'brel sgra'i go don ci yin/lan/ chos gang yang rung ba zhig dang 'brel ba'i 'brel yul dang 'brel chos so sor 'byed cing / gtso cher khyad gzhi 'brel yul dang nye bar byed pa'i rnam dbye'o/ /3 rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra'i 'jug tshul la dbye na du yod/ gang dag yin/lan/ bshad tshul mang che ba ltar na bdun te/ rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba dang / yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel ba/ cha dang cha can gyi 'brel ba/ bdag po dang yul gyi 'brel ba/ bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba/ khyad gzhi dang khyad chos kye 'brel ba/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba 33

rnams so/ /4 'brel sgra'i grub cha gsum po dpe brjod cig gi steng nas dbye zhib byed thub bam/lan/ thub te/ dper na bod kyi mi dmangs zhes pa'i bod ni 'brel gzhi dang / kyi ni phrad dang /mi dmangs ni 'brel chos yin pa lta bu'o/ /5 'brel sgra'i phrad don gzhan la 'jug gam/lan/ dper na 'di nyid bden gyi/ gzhan ni gti mug go lta bu mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan la 'jug pa yin/ rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra bshad pa/1 rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra/lan/ las gang byed pa po dang bya ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing gtso cher byed pa po la nye bar byed pa'i rnam dbye zhig la zer/2 byed pa po gtso phal ji ltar dbye dgos sam/lan/ shing mkhan gyis sta res shing bcad lta bu la mtshon na/ shing mkhan ni byed pa po gtso bo dang sta re ni byed pa po phal ba yin pa'o/3 byed sgra dang 'brel sgra'i 'dra sa dang mi 'dra sa gang yin/lan/ byed sgra dang 'brel sgra'i phrad kyi 'jug tshul dang sbyor tshul gcig 'dra dang / byed pa po zhig gis bya ba zhig byas pa gsal bor ston pa ni byed sgra dang / gzhi gang la 'brel chos gang zhig 'brel ba yod pa tsam ston pa ni 'brel sgra'o/ /34

la don bshad pa/1 la don la nges tshig 'dren rgyu yod dam/lan/ su sogs yi ge drug pa'i 'jug pa phal cher la sgra dang mthun pas na de ltar brjod/2 la don gyi phrad rnams rnam dbye gang la 'jugalan/ rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / bzhi ba dgos ched/ bdun pa gnas gzhi/ de nyid dang tshe skabs bcas la 'jug/3 rnam dbye gnyis pa'i go don phris/lan/ las dang bya ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing / gtso cher bya ba byas pa'i gzhi'am las la nye bar byed pa'i rnam dbye zhig la zer/4 rnam dbye gnyis pa'i grub cha gsum po gang dag yin/lan/ dper na bod yul la song lta bur mtshon na/ bod yul ni bya ba'i yul dang / la ni phrad/song ni bya ba'o//5 las su bya ba'i las de gang la go dgos/lan/ skabs 'dir bya ba'i yul la go dgos/6 las su bya ba rjes mthun pa la dpe brjod ji ltar 'bri/lan/ gzugs la mi lta bu'o/7 ci zhig la rnam dbye bzhi ba dgos ched zer/lan/ dgos pa dang bya ba gnyis so sor 'byed cing / gtso cher dgos pa gang zhig gi ched du bya ba byas pa la nye bar byed pa'i rnam dbye zhig la zer/8 rnam dbye bzhi ba'i grub cha gsum po dpe brjod dang sbrags nas shod/3

lan/ dper na kha zas su g.yo skol byed pa lta bu'i kha zas ni dgos pa dang / su ni la don phrad/g.yo skol byed pa ni bya ba byed pa'o/ /9 dgos ched gsal byed kyi sgra ga tshod yod/lan/ ched du dang / ched la/ don du/ don la/ phyir du/ slad du zhes pa sogs dang bstun nas ci rigs su sbyar rung ngo / /10 dgos ched rjes mthun pa'i dpe brjod ji ltar 'bri/lan/ dper na/ shig gsod par sta re 'phyar mi dgos lta bu'o/ /11 ci zhig la rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi zer/lan/ rten gzhi dang rten pa po gnyis so sor 'byed cing / gtso cher rten la nye bar byed pa'i la'i don can gyi rnam dbye zhig la zer/12 rnam dbye bdun pa'i grub cha gsum po bris/lan/ bod du sman rdzas mang zhes pa'i dpe brjod la mtshon na/ bod ni rten gzhi dang / du ni phrad/ sman rdzas ni rten pa bo'o/13 gnas gzhi rjes mthun pa'i dpe brjod ni gang 'dra yin/lan/ gnam la sprin med lta bu'o/ /14 de nyid dang tshe skabs kyi go don gang yin nam/ lan/ la don gyi yi ge yul gang la bya ba gang zhig byed pa'i tshe/ las dang bya ba ngo bo gcig pa'i don du sbyar ba ni de nyid ces bya'o/ / yul gang zhig la bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa'i tshe/ dus tshod gang yang rung ba zhig la brten pa gtso bor byed pa zhig la tshe skabs zhes zer/15 de nyid la grub cha gsum tshang dgos pa gang dag red/36

lan/ bya ba'i yul lam las dang gcig la don gyi phrad dang gnyis/ bya ba dang gsum mo//dper na sems su 'char zhes pa lta bu'i sems ni bya ba'i yul dang / su ni phrad/ 'char ni bya ba'o//16 tshe skabs kyi grub cha gsum po dpe brjod bzhag nas shod/lan/ dper na zhogs par lus rtsal sbyangs zhes pa lta bu'i zhogs pa ni dus tshod dang / ra ni la don gyi phrad/ lus rtsal sbyangs ni bya ba'o//17 de nyid dang tshe skabs rjes mthun pa'i dpe brjod re phris/lan/ dper na/ bden par ma grub dang dgong mor mi 'gro lta bu'o/ /18 las su bya ba dang de nyid/ dgos ched/ gnas gzhi bcas kyi khyad par ci/lan/ 〈la don gyi gnad don kha shas〉/ las/ tshig sbyor gang zhig gi yul dang las so sor snang min gang yang rung / bya las ngo bo gcig tu yod med kyi cha nas las su bya ba dang de nyid kyi khyad par byung ba dang / yul de la bya ba tsam byas pa dang yul de la phan 'dogs ched byas pa yin min cha nas las dang dgos ched kyi khyad par dang / yul de la byas pa'i grub pa dang yul de la ldan pa'i grub pa yin min cha nas las dang gnas gzhi'i khyad par byung ba red/19 na la gnyis de nyid la 'jug gam/ rgyu mtshan ci yin/lan/ 〈sum cu ba'i rtsa ba〉〉 las/ las dang ched dang rten gnas dang / de nyid tshe skabs la sgra yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mkhas pa mang che bas na la gnyis de nyid la 'jug par bzhe da de/dper na/ 〈blo gsal 'jug ngogs〉 su/ bod mi la mkhas pa yod/ de sa rang na 'dug lta bu'o//na la'i 'jug tshul gzhan bshad pa/na la gnyis la don ma gtogs pa'i don gang dag la 'jug pa yin/lan/ 〈smra sgo mtshon cha/) las/ na zhes bya ba'i tshig gi don/ dmigs kyis 'byed dang rgyu 37

mtshan dang / rgyu mtshan don gyis bstan pa dang / las dang ched dang rten gnas dang / phyi tshig de gzhan sogs ston dang / 'os par dka' ba mchog 'dzin las/ phyi tshig nges par byed pa dang / de las bzlog pa nyid dang ni/ 'gal ba'ang mi 'gal ston pa dang / smon dang 'dri dang the tshom gzhi/ tshe skabs rnams la 'di mthong ngo/ / zhes dang / la ni gnyis pa bzhi ba dang / bdun pa sdud dang sbyor ba dang / smon dang tshad 'dzin gzhi dang ni/ tshe skabs dag tu 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /('di ni 〈dris lan gzhon nu dga' byed)/ las drangs so//)'byung khungs bshad pa/1 rnam dbye lnga ba 'byung khungs kyi go don gang yin/ lan/ dngos po gang zhig gang las byung ba'am/ gang zhig gang las bral te byer ba'am/ gang zhig gang las lhung ba'am/ gang zhig gang las babs pa lta bu ston pa'i slad du nas las gnyis kyi tshig phrad sbyar bas don de 'grub pa zhig la zer/2 'byung khungs la 'jug pa gang dag yin/lan/ 'byung khungs dngos dang / cha 'dra ba/ las sgra rgyu mtshan bcas la 'jug go/3 nas las gnyis dgar sdud la 'jug gam mi 'jugalan/ 'jug ste/ 〈legs bshad ljon dbang〉〉 las/ rigs mthun dgar nas mi mthun las//sdud la nas sgra kho na 'jug ces gsungs so//4ci zhig la dgar ba zer/lan/ mang bo'i nang nas gcig dmigs kyis dgar ba'am/ logs su phye ba ni dgar ba'i don yin/5 ci zhig la sdud pa zer/ dbye na ga tshod yod/38

'bod sgra/1 ci zhig la rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa zer/lan/ yul mchog dman bar gsum la ming nas smos te 'bod pa'i tshe/ kye zhes ming dang 'brel pa'i 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar ba ni rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod pa'i don no/ /2 slob tshan du 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra ci tsam bkod yod/lan/ kye/ kwa ye/ ma ye/ a rog kho re bcas bkod yod/3 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra rnams ji ltar sbyor dgos/lan/ 'bod sgra'i sbyor tshul ni/ 'bod yul gyi ming gi thog mar sbyor ba/ mtha' mar sbyor ba/bar du sbyor ba bcas gsum gar sbyor rigs shing / phal che ba ming gi thog mar sbyor ba yin/ 4 sum cu ba'i gzhung dngos su bstan pa'i 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra ga tshod yod/lan/ sum cu ba'i gzhung dngos su bstan pa'i 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra gnyis te/ kye dang kwa ye gnyis yin no//5'bod sgra'i 'jug yul re re'i go don dang dpe brjod phris/lan/ ༷kye sgra ni zhe sa'i tshig ste/ zhe sa can dang gus pa'i tshul du 'bod par 'jug pa yin/dper brjod ni/ kye rgyal po chen po/ ④kwa ye ni nye ba'i tshig ste/ rang dang mnyam pa'am rang gi grogs po nang phan tshun 'bod par 'jug pa yin/ dper brjod ni/ kwa ye snying krogs dam pa/ ① wa ye ni yul dman pa'am rang las dma' ba lta bur 'jug pa yin/ dper brjod/ wa ye ma 'gro/ ④ma ye ni skyes mar 'bod pa'i sgra la 'jug pa yin/ dpe brjod/ ma ye bu mo chos bzang sgrol ma/ ①kho re ni snang bar mi 'akro pa'i yul drag shul gyi nyams ston byed sogs la sbyar srol yod/ dpe brjod ni/ kho re tshur la nyon dang spre'u'i tshogs/ ④sa rog ces pa 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra la 'jug tshul ni 40

7 yang sgra rgyan sdud kyi don las gzhan pa'i don gang la 'jugalan/ yang sgra ni don snga ma'i steng du rnam grangs du ma bsnan pa la 'jug go/lhag bcas/1 ji 'dra zhig la lhag bcas zer/lan/ rnam dbye ma yin pa'i phrad gzhan dbang can de te ste gsum ni ming ngam tshig gang gi mthar sbyar yang tshig don snga ma'i brjod bya ma rdzogs par lhag ma yod pa ston pa ni lhag bcas kyi sgra zhes bya'o/ /2 lhag bcas kyi phrad gang dag yin pa dang / phrad sbyor tshul ji ltar yin/lan/ de te ste gsum yin/ sbyor tshul ni/ da de na ra la sa te/ / ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang / / rjes 'jug med mthar sa ste 'thob/ /3 lhag bcas kyi sgra la dbye na du yod/lan/ mtshams sbyor lhag bcas dang / dam bca' ba'i lhag bcas/ gzhan 'dren pa'i lhag bcas dang gsum yod/4 ci zhig la mtshams sbyor lhag bcas zer/lan/ tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor byed pa dang / lhag bcas gnyis ga yin stabs/ mtshams sbyor lhag bcas zer/5 mtshams sbyor lhag bcas la dbye na gang dag yod/lan/ rim can mtshams sbyor dang cig car mtshams sbyor gnyis so/ /6ci zhig la dam bca' lhag bcas zer/lan/ tshig snga ma dam bcas pa de'i gsal byed dam sgrub byed du tshig phyi ma 'dren pa zhig la 42

zer/7 dam bca' ba'i lhag bcas la dbye na du yod/lan/ rgyu mtshan 'dren pa/ nges tshig 'dren pa/ dbye ba 'dren pa bcas so/8 ci zhig la gzhan 'dren pa'i lhag bcas zer/lan/ tshig snga ma de'i brjod bya las gzhan pa'i rnam grangs shig ston pa'i ched du tshig snga ma la lhag bcas kyi phrad sbyor pa la zer/'byed sdud/1 ci zhig la 'byed pa zer/lan/ dbye gzhi gcig las dbye ba so sor 'byed pa la zer/2 ci zhig la sdud pa zer/lan/ bsdu bya du ma bsdu gzhi gcig la sdud pa zhig la zer/3 'byed sdud kyi phrad gang dag yin pa dang / sbyor tshul ji ltar yin/lan/ gam ngam dam nam bam mam 'am ram lam sam tam bcas yin la/ sbyor tshul ni rjes 'jug rang 'dra'i mthar sbyor dgos pa dang / da drag can gyi mthar tam sbyor dgos so/ /4sdud pa'i sgra la dbye na gang dag yod/lan/ phyogs gcig tu sdud pa/ snga mar sbyar ba'i chos phyir mar sbyor ba sdud pa/ phyi mar sbyar pa'i chos snga mar sbyor ba sdud pa bcas so/ /5 'byed pa dang sdud pa gnyis la khyad par ci yod/lan/ ngo bo'i sgo nas khyad par ni/ dbye gzhi gcig gi dbye chos rnam grangs so sor 'byed pa de 'byed pa dang / dbye chos rnam grangs so so dbye gzhi gcig tu sdud pa'o/ / sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas 43

'byed pa ni dbye gzhi sngon du bkod nas dbye chos so so rjes su bkod pa dang / sdud pa ni de las ldog pa'o/ /6 ci zhig la the tshom zer/lan/ yin min mtha' gnyis ma nges par dogs pa za bar ston pa la zer/7 ci zhig la dri ba zer/lan/ brjod bya'i don gsal byed du dri bar 'jug pa la zer/8 ci zhig la gdam pa zer/lan/ gdam bya gnyis sam du ma las gang rung zhig bdams nas nges par byed pa la zer/ni sgra/1 ni sgra'i 'jug yul so so 'bri dgos/lan/ dgar ba dang brnan pa/ nges bzung / kha skong / tshig rgyan bcas la 'jug pa yin no/2 ni sgra dgar ba la 'jug tshul ji 'dra yin/lan/ dgar ba da dgar gzhi gang yang rung ba zhig dgar chos khyad par ba'i sgo nas logs su dgar ba zhig la zer/3 ni sgra brnan par 'jug tshul ci yin/lan/ tshig snga ma'i brjod don de la tshig phyi ma'i don rnams nan tan gyis brnan pa'i tshul gyis tshig phyi ma rnams re re bzhin ni sgra'i phrad sbyar ba la zer/4 bee sgra nges bzung la 'jug tshul ci 'dra yin/lan/ brjod bya'i don gyi dgar gzhi gang zhig dmigs su bzung nas dbye ba 'byed pa'i don ston par 'dod na dgar gzhi de rang la ni sgra sbyar nas mtshon dgos pa zhig la zer/44

5ni sgra kha skong ba la ji ltar 'jug pa yin/lan/ tshig lhug la tshig rkang grangs ma tshang ba'i kha skong sbyor mi dgos kyang / tshigs bcad la skabs skabs su ni sgra'i kha skong sbyor dgos pa zhig la zer/6 ni sgra tshig rgyan la 'jug tshul ji 'dra yin/lan/ tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug gi skabs 'ga' zhig la tshig gi rkang grangs ma tshang ba'i kha skong min kyang / ni sgra'i phrad de sbyar na tshig mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'gro ba zhig yin no/ /dang sgra/1 dang sgra don gang dag la 'jug pa yin/lan/ dang sgra ni don snga phyi phyogs gcig tu sdud pa dang / rnam grangs so sor 'byed pa dang / rgyu mtshan ston pa/ tshe skabs te dus ston pa dang / gdam ngag ste dge ba la sogs par skul ba'i tshig ston pa dang lnga'o/ /2 dang sgras ston pa'i sdud pa dang 'byed pa gnyis kyi khyad par ci yin/lan/ sdud pa ni dbye chos sngon du bkod nas dbye gzhi rjes su bkod pa la dang sgra'i phrad sbyar ba zhig dang / 'byed pa ni dbye gzhi sngon du bkod nas de las dbye ba'i rnams grangs mang por phye nas dbye chos so so'i ming gi mtshams su dang sgra'i phrad sbyar ba zhig yin/3 dang sgra gdams ngag la 'jug pa zhes pa'i don ji ltar 'grel/lan/ gzhan la legs nyes blang dor gsal bor ston pa'i phyir du/ bslab bya 'doms skabs don tshan so so'i 'jug tu dang ’ zhes sbyar ba zhig yin/4 dang sgra rgyu mtshan dang tshe skabs la 'jug pa gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ dang sgra rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa de tshig don snga ma'i rjes su rgyu mtshan mi 'dra ba mang po bkod 43

rgyu yod na rgyu mtshan bkod pa'i rjes su dang sgra'i phrad sbyor ba zhig yin la/ tshe skabs la 'jug pa de ni dang sgra tshig gi snga phyi'i bar tu sbyar tshe dus ston pa zhig go/spyi sgra/1 gang 'dra zhig la spyi sgra zer/lan/ spyi sgra zhes pa ni ci ji su gang bzhi bo de don gyi bye brag dmigs su mi 'dzin par spyi la khyab pa'i don gang yin pa de ston byed du 'jug par 'gyur pas spyi sgra zer/2 spyi sgra'i nang gses kyi khyad par ci/lan/ mi'i phyogs su spyi khyab du ston pa la su sgra thob pa/ rgyu mtshan don gyi dri ba la ci sgra thob pa/gsal byed dpe yi dri ba la ji sgra thob pa/ gang ni de dag la khyad med par 'jug pa yin no//3 gang sgra don gang dag la 'jugalan/ spyi sgra dngos dang bye brag dri ba bcas la 'jug4 zhig dang slad/ 'dra/ phyir/ ci/ snyed/ ltar/ dag rnams kyi mgor gang sgra sbyar pas don gang la 'jug pa ston/lan/ spyi dang bye brag dgos pa gsal byed/ yod med yin min sogs brjod don sna tshogs par sbyar ba/ rgyu mtshan/ bsdoms pa/ 'tshol ba dang rnam grangs bsdoms pa/ nges tshig nges bzung med pa'i spyi tsam 'jug pa ston no/ /5 zhig ste slad 'dra phyir rnams kyi mgor ci sgra sbyar bas don gang 'jug pa ston/lan/ dri ba dang the tshom/ ma nges pa/ dgos pa ston byed/ rigs mthun pa/ rgyu mtshan ston pa bcas la 'jug pa yin no/6 snyed srid ltar bzhin skad rnams kyi mgor ji sgra sbyar bas don gang la 'jug pa ston/46

lan/ mang po dang dus/ dpe 'dren pa/ dpe don mtshams spyor ba/ sngar zin rjes su 'chad 'gyur gnyis kur 'jug pa ston no//7 dngos bstan gyi spyi sgra'i phrad gang yin pa dang de dang 'jug pa mthun pa'i phrad gang yin/lan/ dngos bstan gyi spyi sgra'i phrad gang / dang / de dang 'jug pa mthun pa'i phrad la su ci ji’ bcas gsum yin/( spyi sgra'i phrad ci dang ji gnyis kyi 'jug tshul khyad par ci yod/lan/ de ni dri bar ci dang dpe la ji sbyor pa'i khyad par ro/ /bdag sgra/1 ci zhig la bdag sgra zer/lan/ ming gang rung gi mtha' na/ sngar pa po sogs ci rigs sbyar med par/ de rigs gsar du sbyar tshe/ dngos po'am/ bya ba'am/ khyad chos gang zhig gang zag gang la yod par gyur pa'i cha nas/bdag po'i don can du song bsabadag sgra zhes bya'o/ /2 bdag sgrar dngos bstan gyi phrad gang dag yod pa dang / gzhan bdag sgra dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i phrad gang dag yod/lan/ bdag sgra dngos bstan gyi phrad pa ba ma dang / de dag la na ro sbyar pa bo po mo drug go/bdag sgra dang phyogs mtshungs phrad ni can dang / ldan dang / mkhan bcas so/ /3 bdag sgra'i phrad pa po dang ba bo bcas kyi phrad sbyor tshul ji ltar yin/lan/ ga da ba sa na ma pa/ nga 'a ra la mtha' med ba/ zhes so//4ming mtha'i pa dang po/ ba dang bo yin tshad bdag sgra yin nam/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ ming mtha'i pa ba yin tshad bdag sgra min te/ rgyu mtshan ni/ thag pa dang skud pa/ a ma/47

bung ba/ legs po sogs ni ming mtha'i pa ba yin pa las bdag sgra'i pa ba min no/ /5 bdag sgra'i pa ba dang ming mtha'i ba pa gnyis kyi khyad par dpe yi sgo nas shod/lan/ yon tan pa lta bur mtshon na/ yon tan zhes pa'i ming gi mthar med pa gsar du sbyar na yon tan yod pa'i mi'am bdag po go bar byed pas bdag sgra dngos dang / thag pa lta bur mtshon na pa yig des ming gi grub cha zhig las gzhan bdag po sogs kyi sgra gang yang mi ston pas ming gi cha shas yin pa lta bu'o/ /dgag spros/1 ci zhig la dgag sgra zer/ de'i phrad gang dag yin/lan/ dgag sgra'i phrad rnams tha snyad gang gi thog ma'am rjes su sbyar tshe/ sbyar yul gyi don de med pa'am ma yin par ston pa dgag sgra zhes bya'o/ /phrad ma mi min med bcas yin no/ /3dgag sgra'i zad sbyor tshul ji lhar jasalan/ ma mi gnyis ga sngon la sbyor dgos pa dang / min med gnyis ni rjes su sbyor dgos pa yin no/ /3 dgag sgrar dbye na gang dag yod pa dang / de dag gi mtshan nyid ci/lan/ dbye na/ ma yin dgag gi dgag sgra dang med dgag gi dgag sgra gnyis yod de/ de'i dang bo ni rang sbyar sa'i tshig des dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan 'phen pa'i dgag sgra dang /gnyis pa ni rang sbyar sa'i tshig des dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan mi 'phen pa'i dgag sgra de la zer/48

de sgra/1 de sgra don ga tshod la 'jug de tsho gang dag yin/lan/ de sgra don dgu la 'jug ste/ de dag ni/ ④tha snyad 'das ma thag pa/ ④rnam grangs gzhan can/ ④tshig don snga ma'i brjod bya'i lhag ma yod par ston pa/ ④bden pa'i dngos po la 'jug pa/④gsang ba'i dngos po la 'jug pa/ ④bdag gi dngos po la 'jug pa/ ④ gzhan kyi dngos po la 'jug pa/ ④'das zin pa'i don la 'jug pa/ ④ma 'ongs pa'i don la 'jug pa bcas so/ /2 de sgra bden pa'i dngos po la 'jug pa dang gsang pa'i dngos po la 'jug pa gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ de sgra bden pa'i dngos po la 'jug pa ni dngos po de gnas tshul drang mo yin pa ston pa dang / gsang ba'i dngos po ni dngos po gang zhig dngos su mi thos par gsang pa'i tshul gyis bshad pa lta bu'o/ /3 tha snyad dbang du byas pa gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad la go ba ji ltar len dgos/lan/ tha snyad 'das ma thag pa dang rnam grangs gzhan can/ lhag bcas kyi 'jug tshul gsum ni ming tshig gi tha snyad dang brjod bya'i dngos po gnyis kyi nang nas / gtso bor tha snyad kho na la 'jug pas na tha snyad la 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /tshig phrad cing sogs bshad pa/1 tshig phrad cing sogs rjes 'jug gi mtha' la sbyor tshul ji 'dra yin/lan/ rjes 'jug gi mtha' la sbyor tshul gyi cha nas cing ces ce'o ce na ni ga da ba dang da drag gi mthar 'jug pa'i 'jug tshul gcig la/ rjes 'jug nga ma 'a ra la dang rjes 'jug med pa'i ming mtha' ru zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na sbyor pas 'di dag gi sbyor tshul gcig cing / rjes 'jug sa'i rjes su 49

dmigs bsal gyi dbang du ma gtogs shing shig she'o she na 'thob pas 'jug tshul gcig go/2 tshig phrad cing sogs don gyi sgo nas 'thob tshul shod/lan/ don gyi cha nas cing zhing shing gsum gyi don ston pa'i nus pa gcig mtshungs yin pas skabs babs kyi dgos mkho ltar sbyor chog cing / de bzhin du ces dang zhes/ ce'o dang zhe'o/ she'o/ ce na dang zhe na/ she na/ cig dang zhig dang shig sogs kyang de ltar sbyar ba'o/3 cing zhing shing gi 'jug tshul gang yin/lan/ chos snga phyi dang bya ba snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba 'jugadaper na/ bya ba snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba/ gris brgyab cing bsad/ chos snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba/ sra zhing 'thas pa lta bu'o/4 ces zhes 'jug tshul ci yin/lan/ ces dang zhes ni zer gyi don dang skabs 'gar 'dra/ ces zhes ni lung 'dren pa'i tshig la 'jug gong du brjod ma thag pa'i tshig de ngo sprod byed pa'i phrad yin/5 ce'o zhe'o she'o 'jug tshul dpe brjod bzhag nas shod/lan/ phrad 'di gsum ming tshig gi mtha' la sbyar tshe 'di zhes zer ro/ /'di zhes bya'o zhes pa'i don dang phal cher 'dra/ dper na/ skar ma de'i ming la tho rangs skar rgyan zhe'o/ / lta bu'o//6 cig zhig shig gi 'jug tshul shes sam/ lan/ gzhan la bya ba zhig byed par bskul ba'i skul tshig dang / gzhan gyi bya ba 'gog pa'i 'doms tshig rang gi re 'dun ston smon tshig sogs kyi mthar sbyar nas/ nan tan gyi tshig zur ram/ dam bca' pa'i tshig zur 'don pa'i sgra'o/ sgrubs shig lta bu skul tshig lam log du ma 'gro zhig (lta bu 'doms tshig la sbyar ba/ bstan pa ring du gnas shig lta bu smon tshig la sbyar ba)50

tshig phrad spyi'i go don/dang po/ ci zhig la tshig phrad zer/lan/ ming tshig gcig gam du ma'i thog mtha' bar gsum ci rigs kyi gnas su phrad kyi sgra de sbyar ba na don zhig ston la/ de ltar ma sbyar ba'i phrad kyi sgra rkyang ba des spyi bam pa zhig las don gsal bo gang yang mi ston/ de 'dra ba la tshig phrad ces zer/gnyis pa/ rnam dbye dang phrad rkyang gi khyad par gyi mu bzhi ji ltar 'dren/lan/ rnam dbye yin la phrad rkyang min pa ni/ ming rkyang yod tshad/ phrad rkyang yin la rnam dbye ma yin pa ni/ rjes 'jug la mi bltos pa'i phrad rang dbang can yod do cog gnyis ga yin pa ni/ la don dang byed 'brel/ gnyis ga gang yang ma yin pa ni/ dbyangs bzhi rnams yin no/ /

le'u gsum pa/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i skor/tshigs bcad rtsom yig 'bri tshul/1 ci zhig la tshigs bcad rtsom yig zer/lan/ tshig lhug par brjod pa ma yin par tsheg bar ram tsheg khyim gyi grangs nges par bcad pa'i rtsom yig la zer/ yang na/ tshigs bcad ces pa'i tshigs ni mtshams kyi don te/ tshig rkang gi ring thung gcod mtshams mnyam pa la tshigs bcad ces zer ro//2 ci 'dra zhig la tsheg bar ya dang cha zer/lan/ tsheg bar ya zer ba ni tsheg bar gcig rkyang byas pa la zer zhing / tsheg bar cha zer ba ni tsheg bar gnyis mnyam du 'don dgos pa la zer/2 tshigs bcad rtsom yig gi sho lo ga gcig gi nang gi tshig rkang bzhi bo'i tsheg bar la mang nyung shor na chog gam/ rgyu mtshan ci yin/lan/ mi chog ste/ sdeb sbyor nyams pa'i skyon che shos shig tu brtsi bzhin yod/4 tshigs bcad rtsom yig gi tshig rkang so so'i tsheg bar cha dang ya khel stangs de gcig mtshungs yin dgos sam/ rgyu mtshan ci yin/lan/ gcig mtshungs ma byung na klog dus snyan po min no/ /5 tshig rkang gi tsheg bar mang nyung ci tsam byed par mtha' gcig tu nges pa yod dam/lan/ nges par tsheg bar lnga nas so gsum bar du yod cing / da dung 'gro mgo 'phags pas mdzad pa'i 〈daspyi ga〉 zhes pa'i tshig rkang gcig por tsheg bar1379yod do/ /6 tshigs bcad yin na mtha' gcig tu tshig rkang bzhis grub pa zhig yin dgos sam/lan/ tshigs su bcad pa ni/ rkang pa gcig pa dang / gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi ba 32

dang / lnga ba dang / drug pa rnams su yod do/ / zhes gsungs so/ /7 gsham gyi tshigs bcad 'di'i tsheg bar mang nyung dang cha ya khel stangs ji 'dra yin pa ngos zungs/ pad ma kun bzang rang grol gyi gsung las/deng dus sngon rabs mi shes byis pa 'gas/ /rang rigs pha mes la 'khu ngan smras bcas/ /rang mthong gces lang shor ba'i bsam sbyor la/ /gzur gnas blo ldan rgan pos snyeng nas brtse/ /lan/ tsheg bar dgu ma'i rigs dang po yin zhing / cha bzhi'i rjes su ya gcig byas nas klog dgos so/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/1 rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi ngo bo ji 'dra yin nam/dngos po'i rang bzhin gnas skabs sogs/ / gang yin de las gzhan du ni/ /sgro 'dogs med par drang bo ru/ / brjod pa rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan/ /2 rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan la nang gses su rgyan gang dag yod/lan/ dbye na rigs dang bya ba/ yon tan/ rdzas bcas bzhi'o/3 ci zhig la rigs rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan zer/lan/ rigs spyi'i chos rnams drang bor brjod/ rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod par 'dod/'di'i rigs ni rigs rgyud kyi rigs tsam la mi byed par rigs mthun gyi rigs la bya'o/ /4 bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i go don gang yin/lan/ khyad gzhi byed pa po dngos su ston pa'i sgo nas des bya ba bzang ngan gang byas pa rnams 53

drang bor brjod pa zhig la zer/5 ci zhig la yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa zer/lan/ khyad gzhi gang la brten nas byung ba'i yon tan nam khyad chos gtso bor brjod pa zhig la zer/6 dzas rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gang yin nam/lan/ khyad gzhi gang gi ngo bo dang nus pa gang yang mi ston par khyad gzhi gang dang 'brel ba'i rdzas kyi dngos po tsam ston pa zhig yin/7 mgrin pa'i nang nas snyan sgrogs shing / / mig ni kun tu 'phrul ba yi/ /phug ron rtse 'dod dga' ma la/ / yongs su bskor nas mchu dag sbyor/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di rgyan gang dang / tshig 'di'i nang gtso bor gang gsal bshad byas yod ngam)lan/ rgyan 'di bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang / tshig de'i nang du byed pa po phug ron dang / bya yul dga' ma/ bya ba yongs su bskor nas mchu dag sbyor/ bya ba'i khyad chos/ snyan par sgogs/mig 'phrul/ rtse/ bskor/ mchu sbyor/ zhes sogs kyi bya tshig gsal bar brjod yod/8 rigs dang bya ba/ yon tan rdzas zhes pa'i yon tan dang rdzas kyi don ci yin/lan/ 'di'i skabs kyi yon tan ni/ skyon yon gyi yon tan kho na la go rgyu min par/ chos rang rang gi gshis lugs rang chos su grub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam 'gyur ram nus pa zhig yod pa de thams cad 'dir yon tan du 'jog rdzas ni gtso bo yul de'i rang mtshan thun mong ma yin pa gsal byed kyi rdzas sam dngos po zhig yin dgos/9 riṭa rang bzhin brjod par bya ba yon tan rdzas gang rung gi rang bzhin mi 'dres pa byed 54

thub bam/lan/ de mi thub la/ 'di dag bzhi bo brjod bya'i gtso che chung gi dbang gis rigs sogs mi 'dra ba'i tha snyad phyes pa yin/dpe rgyan bshad pa/1 ci zhig la dpe rgyan zer/lan/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis ngo bo tha dad par bkod pa la brten nas de gnyis mtshungs par byed pa zhig la zer/2 dpe rgyan la dbye na du yod/lan/ sum cu so gnyis so/ /3 chos dpe dang dngos dpe'i go don ji 'dra yin/lan/ ④dpe gang zhig la chos dang chos can gnyis su phye pa'i chos kye sgo nas dpe dpe can mtshungs par brjod pa la zer zhing / rjodape dang dpe can gnyis kyi khyad chos dngos su ma brjod par/ dpe dang dpe can gang gi sgo nas mtshungs par go nus pa zhig la zer/4chos dpe dang dngos dpe gnyis la 'dra ba'i cha dang mi 'dra ba'i cha gang dag yod/lan/ mchungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar ba'i sgo nas dpe dang dpe can gnyis mtshungs bar ston pa ni 'dra ba'i cha dang / mtshungs chos dngos su ston dang mi ston pa ni mi 'dra ba'i cha'o/ /5 ci zhig la sdog pa'i dpe zer/lan/ spyir dpe la brten nas dpe can go bar byed dgos kyang / skabs 'dir de dang mi mthun par go sdog nas dpe can dpe yi tshul dang / dpe dpe can gyi tshul du byas te/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis khyad chos 'dra ba'i sgo nas mtshungs par ston pa zhig la zer/3

6 spyir btang dpe rgyan la tshang dgos pa'i yan lag gsum po gang yin/lan/ dpe dang dpe can/ mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra bcas so/ /7 gang 'dra zhig la phan tshun gyi dpe zer/lan/ thog mar dpe la brten nas dpe can go ba dang / slar yang dpe can de la brten nas dpe go bar byed de/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis phan tshun dpe len re byas nas dpe dang dpe can gnyis mtshungs par ston pa zhig yin/8 ji 'dra zhig la nges pa'i dpe zer/lan/ dpe can de la 'os pa'i dpe zhig bkod de/ de dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod na yang dpe can de'i dper 'os so zhes ston pa zhig yin/9 gsham gyi dpe brjod 'di'i dpe dpe can dang de dag gi mtshungs chos rgyan bcas ngos 'dzin dgos/sbrang rtsi'i ro la sred pa'i rkang drug bzhin/legs bshad 'tshol rnams mkhas pa'i mdun sar rgyu/ /legs bshad don du gnyer ba de rnams bzhin/ /sbrang bu rnams ni pad ma'i tshal du 'gro/④rgyan gang gi dpe brjod yin/lan/ phan tshun gyi dpe'i dpe brjod yin/④'di'i nang gi dpe dang dpe can ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ dpe can ni/ yon tan slob pa'i ched du mkhas pa'am dge rgan gyi mdun du 'gro ba'i slob ma rnams yin la/ dpe ni sbrang rtsi'i ro la sred pa'i ched du pad ma'i tshal du 'gro ba'i sbrang bu yin/ 6

④dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi mtshungs chos gang yin/lan/ mtshungs chos ni sbrang bu rnams sbrang rtsi'i ro la sred pa'i ched du pad ma'i tshal du 'akro ba dang / slob bu rnams yon tan slob pa'i ched du mkhas pa'i drung du 'akro ba de yin/10 ji zhig la bsdus pa'i dpe zer/lan/ dpe can de nyid khyad chos de gcig pu'i sgo nas dpe de dang mtshungs pa tsam min gyi/ khyad chos gzhan zhig gi sgo nas kyang dpe de dang mtshungs par ston pa zhig yin/11 gang 'dra zhig la phul byung gi dpe zer/lan/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis rten nam gnas gzhi tha dad pa'i khyad par yod pa tsam ma gtoṭa/de gnyis khyad chos kyi sgo nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med ces/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis la spyir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod kyang / skabs der de gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gzhan ci yang med par brjod pa zhig yin/ 12 ji 'dra zhig la rab btags kyi dpe zer/lan/ dpe can gyi khyad chos de nyid dpe la yod snyam pa'i nga rgyal yod pa lta bur sgro btags nas/de'i nga rgyal 'gog pa'i ched du dpe gzhan zhig 'god pa zhig yin /13 6la byung gi dpe dang rab btags kyi dpe gnyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ phul byung gi dpe ni dpe dang dpe can gnyis gnas gzhi'i khyad par tsam las khyad par gzhan med ces 'ud chen pos brjod pa zhig dang / rab btags kyi dpe ni dpe yis dpe can gyi dper 'os pa kho gcig pu las gzhan med par 'dod pa la sgro btags nas da dung dpe gzhan yod par ston pa zhig yin/14 gsham gyi dpe brjod 'di'i dpe dpe can dang rgyan bcas ngos 'dzin dgos/57

me na sa yi 'dren byed yid 'phrog dang / /mtshungs zhes dpyid kyi pho nya dre gas mi 'tshal/ /pad tshal mtsho la gnas pa'i rna rgyan can/ / yon tan de ltar yid 'phrog ldan pas so/ / ④me na sa dang dpyid kyi pho nya zhes pa gang gi ming yin/ lan/ me na ga ni lha'i gar mkhan gyi ming / dpyid kyi pho nya ni khu byug gi ming / ④dpe dang dpe can gang yin/ lan/ dpe can ni me na ga dang dpe ni dpyid kyi pho nya dang rna rgyan can te rma bya yin/ ④dpe brjod 'di rgyan gang gi dpe brjod yin/lan/ dpe rgyan gyi nang gses dgu ba rab btags kyi dpe yi dpe brjod yin/15 ji 'dra zhig la rmongs pa'i dpe zer/ lan/ dpe can mthong ba'i tshe na dpe dang / dpe mthong ba'i tshe dpe can de nyid yin nam snyam du 'khrul ba'i rkyen dang 'khrul ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa'i sgo nas dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor dbye ba mi 'byed par rmongs pa'i tshul du brjod pa zhig yin/ 16 mongs pa'i dpe zhes pa'i rmongs pa’ la go ba ji ltar len dgos/lan/ de ni dpe dpe can phan tshun dbye ba 'byed ma nus par 'khrul ba yin la/ 'khrul ba'am rmongs pa de'ang dpe dpe can gnyis yi ngo ma shes pa tsam min par gtso bo dpe can dpe ru 'khrul ba ltar byas pa zhig yin dgos shing / shugs nas dpe dang dpe can gnyis mtshungs par ston pa zhig yin/ 17 gang 'dra zhig la the tshom gyi dpe zer/ 58

lan/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi khyad chos so so nas smos te/ dpe can de nyid dang / dpe gnyis so sor dbye ba gsal bor 'byed ma nus par the tshom za bar brjod pa'i shugs las/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis mtshungs par ston pa zhig yin/18 rmongs pa'i dpe dang the tshom gyi dpe yi khyad par ji 'dra 'byed dgos/lan/ rmongs pa'i dpe ni dpe can de dpe la 'khrul ba thag bcad pa dang / the tshom gyi dpe ni dpe de dpe can la 'khrul ba thag ma bcad par the tshom gyi sgo nas mtshungs par brjod pa'o//19 gang 'dra zhig la smad pa'i dpe zer/lan/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis phyogs 'ga' zhig gi cha nas mtshungs kyang / skyon 'ga' zhig gi sgo nas dpe can las dpe dman par brjod pa zhig yin/20 gang 'dra zhig la phreng ba'i dpe zer/lan/ dpe mang po bkod pa de'i snga ma snga ma dpe dang / phyi ma phyi ma dpe can du brjod pa'i tshul gyis dpe dang dpe can phreng bar brgyus pa bzhin du yod pa zhig yin/21 gang 'dra zhig la zla bo dngos po'i dpe zer/lan/ mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dngos su med kyang / dpe can dang de'i khyad chos snga phyi gang rung du bkod nas/ de dang mtshungs pa'i dpe gzhan zhig kyang de'i rogs zla'am grogs kyi tshul du bkod pa'i shugs las dpe dang dpe can gnyis mnyam du go nus pa zhig yin/22 rmongs pa'i dpe dang zla bo dngos po'i dpe ga nyis kyi khyad par ci/lan/ rmongs pa'i dpe ni dpe dang dpe can phan tshun 'khrul ba ltar ston pa zhig la mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dngos su yod pa dang / zla bo dngos po'i dpe ni snga phyi rim par dpe can dang dpe bkod de de gnyis mnyam par rtoṭa par byed cing / mtshungs gsal gyi sgra med kyang shugs nas go 59

nus pa zhig go /23 gang 'dra zhig la mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe zer/lan/ dpe dang dpe can du sbyor rgyu'i dpe de'i yon tan lhag cing / dpe can gyi yon tan dman pa yin kyang / de gnyis tshig sbyor gyi nang du mtshungs par bsdus nas sbyor ba gang yin pa de ni mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe yin/ 24 ci 'dra zhig la rgyu'i dpe zer/lan/ yon tan rang bzhin sogs rgyu mtshan zhig sngon du bkod nas/ dpe can de dpe de dang 'dra bar brjod pa zhig yin/ gzugs rgyan/1 ci zhig la bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can gyi rgyan zer/lan/④tshigs bcad/dpe dang dpe can gnyis po yi//bar du 'brel sgra 'ga' zhig ni//bsdus shing 'ga' zhig ma bsdus pa// bsdus shing ma bsdus gzugs can no//④tshig lhugadape dang dpe can gnyis po'i bar gyi 'brel sgra 'ga' zhig bsdus la/ 'ga' zhig ma bsdus par dpe can dpe yi gzugs su 'god pa zhig2 mtha' dag gzugs can gyi go don/ lan/ ④tshigs bcad/ 60

la yan lag gsum gzugs zer ro 5 ci zhig la ldan pa'i gzugs can zer/ lan/ ④tshigs bcad/dpe dang dpe can so so'e chos/ /phan tshun ldan pa ldan pa'i gzugs/ /④tshig lhug dpe dang dpe can gnyis po so so'i khyad chos rnams phan tshun gnyis shar ldan pa'i sgo nas dpe can dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa zhig yin/ 6 ci zhig la mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can zer/ lan/ ①tshigs bcad/yan lag can ni gzugs byas la/ /yan lag gzugs su byas ma byas/ /ci ltar rigs pa'i 'theng 'gros ltar/ /spel mar sbyor ba mi mnyam gzugs/ /④ tshig lhug khyad gzhi yan lag can de dpe'i gzugs su byas la/ yan lag rnams gzugs su byas pa dang ma byas pa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas 'theng po'i 'gros ltar spel mar yod pa zhig yin/7 'gal ba'i gzugs can gyi go don ci yin/ lan/ ④tshigs bcad/ dpe der srid min khyad chos 'ga'/ /62

bkod pa 'gal ba'i gzugs can no/ /④ tshig lhug gzugs su dgod bya'i dpe der mi srid pa'i don gyi khyad chos 'ga' zhig bkod rjes/don de nyid dpe'i gzugs su 'god pa zhig yin/ 8ci zhig la rgyu'i gzugs can zer/ lan/①tshigs bcad/ rgyu mtshan gang gis dpe dngos su/ / rtogs byed rgyu yi gzugs can no/ / ① tshig lhug dpe can la yod pa'i khyad chos rnam sa rgyu mtshan du bkod nas/ dpe can de la dpe dngos su rtogs par byed pa zhig yin/9ci zheg la dpe yi gzugs can zer/lan/①tshigs bcad/ gzugs bkod dpe dang dpe can gnyis/ /mtshungs sgras gsal bshad da pe yi gzugs/ /④tshig lhug gzugs su dgod bya'i dpe can de dang dpe gnyis khyad chos mthun pa'i sgo nas mtshungs par brjod pa zhig yin/ 10ci zhig la ldog pa'i gzugs can zer/ lan/④tshigs bcad/63

gzugs su bkod pa'i dpe dpe can/so sor dbye 'byed ldog pa'i dpe//④tshig lhug thog mar dpe can de nyid dpe'i gzugs su bkod nas/ slar yang de gnyis khyad chos mi mtshungs pa'i dbang gis so sor dbye ma 'byed pa zhig yin/ 11'gog pa'i gzugs can gyi go don ji 'dra yin/lan/༷tshigs bcad/ gzugs can nyid la gzugs kyi ni//khyad chos 'gal ba nyid mthong bas//gzugs can de la smad ltar brjod//de ni 'gog pa'i gzugs can no//④tshig lhugagazugs su 'god bya'i dpe can de nyid la bkod pa'i gzugs kyi khyad chos las go ldog pa'i khyad chos 'gal ba mthong ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ dpe can de nyid la smad pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa zhig yin/12 gzugs can gyi gzugs can gyi go don/lan/ ④tshigs bcad/ dpe can de nyid gzugs gcig tu//bkod rjes de yang gzhan zhig gi /gzugs su bkod pa 'phar ma ste// gzugs can gyi ni gzugs can no// ④ tshig lhug64

thog mar dpe can de nyid dpe gcig gi gzugs su bkod nas/ slar yang de nyid dpe gzhan zhig gi gzugs su bkod pa zhig yin/12 dpe rgyan dang gzugs rgyan gnyis kyi khyad par ci yin/lan/ dpe dang dpe can tha dad du bkod nas de gnyis mtshungs par sbyor ba dpe rgyan dang /dpe can dpe'i ngo bor bkod nas de gnyis gcig tu sgo btaṭa te sbyor ba ni gzuṭa rgyan yin no/

le'u bzhi ba/ nyer spyod yig rigs kyi skor/ brda tho/ 1 ci zhig labarda tho zer/ — lan/ gtan 'khel byas zin pa'i las don zhig 'brel yod las khungs sam mi sger la brda sprod byed du spyod pa'i yig rigs shig la zer / 2 brda tho la dbye na gang dag yod/lan/ drug ste/ bka' slob rang bzhin gyi brda tho dang / mchan bkod mdzub ston gyi brda tho/ kun shes rang bzhin gyi brda tho/ tshogs 'du'i brda tho/ go gnas bsko 'then gyi brda tho/ spyir btang gi brda tho bcas so/ /3 brda tho 'bri skabs don tshan gang dag 'dzoms dgos pa red/lan/ kha byang dang dngos gzhi'i nang don/ brda tho gtong mkhan gyi las khungs kyi ming dang lo zla tshes grangs bcas 'dzoms dgos/ngo sprod yi ge1 ci 'dra zhig la ngo sprod yi ge zer/lan/ rang las khungs sam tshogs pa'i mi dang las khungs gzhan nam mi sger bar phan tshun las don skor 'brel gtugs byed pa dang / gnas tshul shes rtogs byed pa/ tshogs 'du sogs spyi tshogs kyi byed sgo khag nang du zhugs pa bcas la mi mngags gtong byed skabs su mtshams sbyor byed pa'i yig rigs shig la zer/2 ngo sprod yi ge 'bri skabs don gang dag tshang dgos/lan/ lnga ste/ ngo sprod yi ge zhes pa'i kha byang 'bri ba dang / ngo sprod yi ge 'bri yul gyi las khungs 66

khungs sogs la re 'dun zhu dgos pa'i skabs su spyod pa'i ched spyod yi ge zhig la zer/2 re 'dun zhu yig 'bri skabs mnyam 'jog dgos pa gang dag yod/lan/ re 'dun zhu rgyu'i don dag dang re 'dun zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan gsal bor bris te mgo khrid dang /rtsa 'dzugs sam las khungs kyis dus thog tu zhib 'jug dang / thag gcod/ lan 'debs bcas byed bde yong ba byed dgos/ gal te rtsa 'dzugs nang du zhugs rgyu'i re 'dun zhu yig yin tshe/ so so'i rnam 'gyur dang dam bca' sogs 'bri dgos/gros tshogs zin bris/ 1 gang 'dra zhig la gros tshogs zin bris zer/lan/ kros tshogs zin bris zhes pa bee tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs zin bris 'god mkhan gyis gros tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i gnas tshul te/ gtam bshad mkhan gyi ming dang / gtam bshad kyi nang don/zhib 'jug dang gros bsdur byas pa'i gnad don/ mtha' ma'i gros chod bcas ji ma ji bzhin du yig thog tu 'god pa la zer/2 gros tshogs zin bris la rtsa ba'i nang don gang dag tshang dgos/lan/ gros tshogs zin bris 'god par dgod bya'i zin bris dang de'i kha byang dang / gros tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i gnas tshul/ nang don dngos/ mjug bsdu ba bcas khag bzhi tshang dgos pa yin/3 gros tshogs zin bris kyi grub cha bzhi las grub cha gtso bo de gang yin/lan/ gros tshogs kyi nang don ni kros tshogs zin bris kyi grub cha gtso bo yin/4 gros tshogs kyi rtsa ba'i gnas tshul zhes par nang don gang dag tshud yod/lan/ tshogs 'du 'tshogs pa'i dus tshod dang / tshogs yul/ tshogs 'du'i gtso'i 'gan pa/zin bris 'god mkhan gyi ming / tshogs zhugs mi sna/ tshogs 'dur zhugs ma thub pa'i mi'i ming dang 68

go gnas/ rgyu mtshan bcas 'bri dgos/ 5 gros tshogs zin bris 'god skabs do snang byed dgos pa'i gnad don gang 'dra yod/lan/ ④kros tshogs kyi nang don dngos ji ma ji bzhin 'god dgos pa las rang snang gang shar kyis kha sdon nam bzo bcos byed mi rung / lhag par du las don kros tshogs kyi kros chod cig yin phyir/ de ni las don sgrub pa dang las don la zhib bsher byed skabs kyi gzhi 'dzin sa yin pas/nor 'dzol gang yang mi yong ba byed dgos/ ④bskyar zlos dang nyog gtam/ don dag gal chen dang 'brel ba med pa'i tshig rnams spyir btang du zin thor mi 'god mod/ 'on kyang gros tshogs khyad par ba zhig yin na/ bskyar zlos sam nyog gtam gang yin rung tshang ma 'god dgos/ dgos gal yod tshe tshogs 'du grol rjes/ zin thor zhu dag byas nas nges par du 'brel yod mi snas spyan gziṭa gnang 'bul dgos/gan rgya/1 ci zhig la gan rgya zer/lan/ gan rgya zhes pa ni las khungs gnyis sam (kha shas) yang na las khungs dang mi sger ram/mi sger phan tshun bar las don gang rung zhig legs par bsgrub phyir dang / ar las dang tshong gnyer gyi bya gzhag gang rung zhig legs 'grub yong slad du phan tshun 'dra mnyam gnyis phan dang /mnyam gros gcig mthun gyis phyogs so so'i khe dbang dang 'os 'gan gtan 'khel byas rjes brtsi srung lag bstar bya rgyur kros mthun byung ba'i gzhi 'dzin byed du bris pa'i yi ge la zer/2 gan rgya 'bri stangs kyi rnam gzhag la tshang dgos pa du yod/ de dag 'bri dgos/lan/ gan rgya 'bri stangs kyi rnam gzhag la tshang ba bzhi yod/ de dag ni/ ④kha byang /④gan rgya 9 9
