'jog mkhan gyi ming / ④gan rgya'i dngos gzhi'i nang don/ ①gan rgya 'jog mkhan gyi ming 'god pa dang dus tshod bcas so/ /3 gan rgya 'jog skabs do snang byed dgos pa'i gnad don du yod/ de dag gang dang gang yin/lan/ gan rgya 'jog skabs do snang byed dgos pa'i gnad don bzhi yod/ de dag ni/ ①gan rgya ma bzhag gong du phan tshun gros mol legs par byed dgos pa dang / gros 'cham byung ba'i nang don rnams gsal bor bris rjes/ phyogs gnyis ga de nan tan gyi sgo nas brtsi srung byed dgos/ ①gan rgya'i nang du 'khod pa'i gtan 'bebs dang byed thabs khag nges par du rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims dang srid jus/ 'char gzhi bcas dang mthun dgos/ ④gan rgya'i nang du mi dmangs shog sgor soṭa kyi grangs ga 'bri dgos tshe nges par du yi ge'i thog nas mtshon par byed dgos/④slad phyin gan rgya la 'gal rkyen mi yong ba'i ched du gnad don rnams kha gsal zhib phra'i sgo nas 'bri dgos par ma zad/ yi ge dag cing spus gtsang bris nas phyogs so sos bltas rjes ming rtags 'god dgos pa bcas so /'tshams 'dri'i yi ge1 ci zhig la 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge zer/lan/ 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge ni/ thun mong ngam mi sger gyi ming thog nas phyogs ga ge mo nas dmiṭa bsal gyi legs skyes phul ba'am/ yang na bsam yul las 'das pa'i gyod gud phog pa dang gnod 'tshe tshabs chen byung ba'i thun mong ngam/ mi sger la byams brtse'i 'tshams 'dri zhus nas/ mdza' brtse'i sems khur mtshon par byed pa'i yi ge la zer/2 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge'i 'bri stangs ji 'dra yin/lan/ kha byang / che brjod/ dngos gzhi'i nang don/ mjug sdud pa dang lo zla tshes grangs bcas so//70

3 thugs rje che zhu ba'i yi ge 'bri skabs do snang byed dgos pa'i gnad don gang dag yod/lan/④thugs rje che zhu yul gyi ming dang / sa cha/ rgyu rkyen/ mjug 'bras/ de bzhin bya ba'i brgyud rim bcas zhib phra 'bri dgos/ ④phar phyogs kyi bsam pa dang bka' drin bzang po snying bcangs kyi sems 'dun 'bur du thon dgos/ ①brjod don bden zhing brtse dung rnam par dag pa/ ①che brjod kyi gtam tshad gzhi ran po zhig dgos pa/ 'bri stangs kyi rnam bzhag tshang zhing yig nor med dgos pa/ ①don dngos las 'das pa'i 'ud sgrog byed mi chog pa bcas so /gsar 'gyur stabs bde 'bri tshul/ 1 gsar 'gyur gyi go don phris/lan/ gsar 'gyur zhes pa ni gnas skabs kyi gsar byung gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin brgyud bsgrags byed pa zhig la zer/ 2 gsar 'gyur gyi khyad chos gtso bo ci yin/lan/ bden pa yin dgos la/ bden pa ni gsar 'gyur gyi bla srog yin/3 gsar 'gyur gyi brjod bya dang dus tshod kyi phyogs nas brjod na ji 'dra yin/lan/ brjod bya'i phyogs nas phyi rol yul la gnas pa'i don dngos shig yin zhing / don dngos de dus tshod kyi phyogs nas gnas skabs su gsar du byung ba zhig yin dgos/ 4gsar 'gyur gyi rin thang dang spel thabs gang yin/lan/ rin thang gi phyogs nas tshang mas do snang byed cing dgos mkho yod pa zhig yin pas/gsar 'gyur gyi yo byad dang yang na thabs sna tshogs brgyud nas 'grem spel byed dgos pa zhig yin/5 gsar 'gyur gyi dbye ba ga tshod 'dugalan/ (1) gsar 'gyur 'byung sa'i sa khongs dang khyab khongs gnas tshul/ 72

(2) gsar 'gyur gyi ngo bo'i thad nas dbye tshul/(3) gsar 'gyur gyi khyad chos thad nas dbye tshul/(4) gsar 'gyur gyi brjod gzhi'i thad nas dbye tshul/(5) gsar 'gyur spel sa'i thabs kyi thad nas dbye tshul bcas lnga yod/6 gsar 'gyur 'byung sa'i sa khongs dang khyab khongs nas dbye na du yod/lan/ rgyal spyi'i gsar 'gyur dang / rgyal nang gi gsar 'gyur gnyis/7 gsar 'gyur gyi ngo bo'i thad nas dbye na du yod/lan/ chab srid kyi gsar 'gyur dang / dpal 'byor gyi gsar 'gyur/ tshan rig slob gso'i gsar 'gyur/ dmag don gyi gsar 'gyur/ spyi tshogs kyi gsar 'gyur/ rig rtsal gyi gsar 'gyur/lus rtsal gyi gsar 'gyur/ tshogs 'du'i gsar 'gyur sogs yod/8 gsar 'gyur gyi khyad chos thad nas dbye na ga tshod yod/lan/ don chen rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur/ spyir btang gi gsar 'gyur/ sna gcig rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur/ sna mang rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur bcas so/ /9 gsar 'gyur gyi brjod gzhi'i thad nas dbye na ga tshod yod/lan/ dper 'os kyi gsar 'gyur dang / phyogs bsdus gyi gsar 'gyur/ dpyad gtam rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur/ skyon brjod rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur/10 gsar 'gyur spel ba'i thabs kyi thad nas dbye na du yod/lan/ ngag thog gi gsar 'gyur/ yig thog gi gsar 'gyur/ rlung 'phrin gyi gsar 'gyur/ brnyan 'phrin gyi gsar 'gyur/ dra thog gi gsar 'gyur bcas yod/73

brda khyab 'bri tshul/1 ci zhig la brda khyab zer/lan/ brda khyab ni rgyun spyod rang bzhin gyi gsal bshad rtsom yig cig yin zhing / de ni khe las las khungs kyes mdzad spyod pa la tshong zog ngo sprod byed pa'am zhabs zhu'i nang don dang / yang na spro rtsed kye rnam grangs sogs mtshams sbyor dang dril bsgrags bya thabs kyi nyer spyod yi ge zhig la zer/2 brda khyab kyi nus pa shes sam/lan/ (1) brda khyab kyis cha 'phrin spel ba dang dpal 'byor 'khrug po bzo thub/(2) brda khyab kyis mdzad spyod kyi lam ston pa dang / khe las kyi snyan grags rgyas su 'jug thub/(3) brda khyab kha shas kyis phyi tshong rgya cher btang ste phyi dngul gyi yong 'bab mang du gtong thub/3 brda khyab la khyab che chung gnyis yod la de ltar dbye tshul ni gang 'dra yin/lan/ khyab che ba'i brda khyab nang du dpal 'byor dang dpal 'byor du mi gtogs pa'i brda khyab tshang ma tshud yod/ khyab chung ba'i brda khyab ces pa ni dpal 'byor du mi gtogs pa'i brda khyab la zer/4 brda khyab kyi nus pa'i cha nas dbye ba gsum ni gang dag yin/lan/ dpal 'byor brda khyab dang / rig gnas brda khyab/ spyi tshoṭa kyibarda khyab bcas gsum yod/5brda khyab kyi nang don cha nas dbye ba gsum ni gang dag yin/lan/ tshong las rang bzhin gyi brda khyab/ ngal las kyi brda khyab/ lta ba'i brda khyab bcas gsum yod/74

6brda khyab 'bri stangs la dbye na du yod/lan/ mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus skor gyi brda khyab/ gsal bshad skor gyi brda khyab/ gros gleng skor gyi brda khyab/ ngo sprod skor gyi brda khyab bcas yod/7 brda khyab 'grem spel gyi thabs ni ji 'dra yin nam/lan/ tshags par du 'god pa'i brda khyab/ dus deb du 'god pa'i brda khyab/ brnyan 'phrin nas bstan pa'i brda khyab/ lam 'gel brda khyab/ bsgrags yig brda khyab/ sbrags srid kyi brda khyab sogs yod/8 brda khyab 'bri stangs la gang dag yod/lan/ kha byang / nang don dngos/ mjug byang /'char gzhi/1 'char gzhi'i go don phris/lan/ nga tshos slob sbyong dang bya ba/ thon skyed bcas kyi las 'gan re re bsgrub dgos pa'i skabs su/ sngon la las 'gan de'i bkod sgrig gam las sha'i rtsis gzhi zhig yig thog tu 'god pa de la 'char gzhi zer/2 'char gzhi'i nang don dang dus tshod kyi cha nas dbye na gang dag yod/lan/ thon skyed dang bya ba/ slob sbyong bcas kyi thad la dus tshod ring thung gi dbang gis rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod pa ste/ lo 'khor gyi 'char gzhi dang / dus tshigs kyi 'char gzhi/ zla re'i 'char gzhi sogs yod/3 'char gzhi bed spyod kyi khyab khongs shod/lan/ mi sger gyi 'char gzhi/ 'dzin grwa'i 'char gzhi/ las khungs kyi 'char gzhi/ srid gzhung gi 'char gzhi/75

4 'char gzhi'i nang don mtshon thabs kyi cha nas brjod na gang dag yod/lan/ don tshan sgrig pa'i 'char gzhi/ re'u mig gi rnam pa'i 'char gzhi/ don tshan dang re'u mig gnyis sbrags pa'i 'char gzhi/spyi sdom/1 spyi sdom gyi go don ji 'dra yin/lan/ spyi sdom ni thun mong ngam sger gang rung zhig gis dus rim zhig gi bya ba'am slob sbyong ngam/thon skyed dam/ bsam blo sogs kyi las 'gan zhig bsgrubs rjes/ de sgrub pa'i brgyud rim la phyir bltas kyes grub 'bras dang nyams myong thob pa dang / skyon cha gang zhig yod pa sogs la dbye zhib dang zhib 'jug byas te bris pa'i slob ston gyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i sdom tshig yig thog tu bkod pa la zer/2 spyi sdom gyi phan nus chen po bzhi bo re re phris/lan/ (1) grub 'bras gtan 'khel byas thog gnad don btsal zhing / nyams myong dang bslab bya blangs nas dus rim rjes ma'i bya bar slob ston byed chog (2) dus thog tu gong rim la gnas tshul snyan seng zhus te/ gong rim gyi rgyab skyor dang rogs ram 'thob par byed pa/ (3) khyon yongs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i chos nyid spyi sdom byas nas sne gcig gis khyon yongs khrid thub pa/ (4) mi rnams kyis gnad don la lta zhib dang dbye zhib/ thag gcod bcas byed rgyu'i 'jon thang je cher 'gro thub pa/3 spyo sdom gyi nang don la dbye na du yod/lan/ slob sbyong gi spyi sdom/ bsam blo'i spyi sdom/ thon skyed kyi spyi sdom/ las lnga'i spyi sdom/ ngal rtsol gyi spyi sdom sogs yod/76

4spyi sdom gyi ngo bo'i thad nas dbye na du yod/lan/ khyon yongs kyi spyi sdom/ ched don gyi spyi sdom/5 spyi sdom gyi khyab khongs thad nas dbye na du yod/lan/ mi sger gyi spyi sdom/ sde tshan spyi sdom/ sa khul gyi spyi sdom/6 spyi sdom la dus tshod kyi cha nas dbye na gang dag yod/lan/ ④dus bkag gi spyi sdom/ lo 'khor gyi spyi sdom/ lo phyed kyi spyi sdom/ slob skabs kyi spyi sdom/ dus bzhi'i spyi sdom/ zla re'i spyi sdom/ ④dus tshod nges gtan med pa'i spyi sdom/ dus rim gyi spyi sdom/7 spyo sdom gyi nang don 'bri stangs phyogs lnga bo phris/lan/ (1) mgo brjod (dmigs yul dang blang bya mig snga'i gnas tshul)(2) gnas tshul rags bsdus (brgyud rim mdor bsdus dang byed thabs)(3) mjug 'bras (grub 'bras dang skyon cha)(4) gdeng 'jog (nyams myong spyi sdom dang chos nyid 'tshol ba)(5) 'char gzhi (spyod rgyu'i byed thabs dang 'bad brtson gyi kha phyogs)( spyi sdom 'bri bar nang don gang dag tshang dgos/lan/ (1) kha byang / (2) gzhung dngos (spyi sdom gyi grub cha gtso bo yin zhing / de la gtso bo khag gsum 'dus te/ thog ma'i khag dang / bar gyi khag mjug bsdu ba'i khag) (3) ming 'god pa/(de ni sde tshan gyi ming dang tshe grangs kha byang gi nang du bkod med tshe gzhung dngos bris tshar rjes thig phreng kha shas mar phab nas 'bri shog gi g.yas ngos su 'god dgos)77

le'u lnga ba/ bod rtsom gyi skor/rtswa thang dran glu/1 〈rtswa thang dran glu〉 ni rtsom yig gang las bdams pa dang / rtsom pa bo su yin1lan/ 〈'bol rtsom zhogs pa'i skya rengal〉/ las bdams shing / rtsom pa bo ni don 'grub rgyal yin/2 〈rtswa thang dran glu〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs ji 'dra yin/ lan/ tsheg bar bcu gcig ma'i rigs gnyis pa cha bzhe'i rjes su ya gcig slar yang cha gcisgyug byas nas tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas bris yod/3 〈rtswa thang dran glu〉 las rtswa thang gi khyad chos gang dag la brten nas pha yul dran pa'i 'dun pa mtshon par byas yod/lan/ rtsom pa pos rtswa thang gi dgong zhogs dang dus bzhe'i khyad chos la brten nas pha yul dran pa'i 'dun pa mtshon yod/4 〈rtswa thang dran glu〉 zhes pa'i brjod don gtso bo gang red/lan/ rtsom pa pos rtswa thang gi rnam pa brjod pa brgyud nas rang nyid pha yul la dga' ba'i brtse dung zab mo de mtshon par byas yod/yid du 'ong ba'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho/1 〈yid du 'ong ba'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho〉 ni gang las drangs pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈kha ba'i rnam shes〉 las drangs pa dang / rtsom pa po ni 'phrin las chos grags yin/2 〈yid du 'ong ba'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i〉 rtsom stangs ci 'dra yin/78

lan/ bcad lhug spel mas bris pa'i gsal bshad rtsom yig cig yin/3 yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes pa'i ming 'di ji ltar thogs pa yin/lan/ dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya 'akro mgon 'phags pa'i dus su btsugs pa'i bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal yar 'brog stag lung khri dpon gyi mnga' khongs sa char chags pas yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes thogs pa red/4yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i chags dbyibs la khyad chos ci zhig yod/lan/ dbyengs nar mo ste/ byang ngos chung la lho ngos che ba red/5 〈yar 'brog g.yu mtsho〉 zhes pas ci zhig gsal bshad byas yod/lan/ mtsho de'i gnas yul dang chags dbyibs/ yul gyi rnam pa sogs gsal bshad byas yod/6rtsom 'di'i gsal bshad kyi thabs gang dag bkol yod/lan/ dpe 'jog pa dang / lung 'dren pa/ grangs ka 'god pa sogs kyi thabs spyad yod/slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya/1 〈slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya〉 ni gang las bdams/ rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 〈mdo sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs tshul gyi bslab bya nor bu'i gling du bkrod pa'i lam yig〉 las bdams/ rtsom pa po gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me (1762—1823) yin/2 rtsom 'di'i slob gnyer byed tshul gyi bslab bya ci ltar bstan yod/lan/ rnam g.yeng dang le lo yi dbang du mi 'gro bar brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin brten dgos pa dang / slob spyong gi nyams myong dang thabs shes/ der rnam 'gyur ji 'dra 'dzin dgos pa sogs bstan yod/3 〈slob gnyer byed tshul gyi basbab bya〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs kyi cha nas khyad chos ci yod/79

lan/ tshig rkang lnga re tshigs bcad gcig tu byas pa dang / tshig don go sla zhing bab chags shing /dpe dang gzugs su bkod pa gnad la 'khel ba bcas so /4dpe 'dzin skyon sbyangs yun du byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ don ni tshig la brten pas gzhung tshig blor 'dzin byed dgos pa dang / dpe klog tsam dang ngag sgros than thun gyis mi phan pa bcas so//slob ma sdod rung du bya ba'i gdam ngag1 〈slob ma sgod rung du bya ba'i gdam ngag/〉 zhes pa gang nas btus pa yin/ rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 〈dpe chos rin chen spungs pa〉 las btus te bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni po to ba rin chen gsal (1027—1105) dbus kyi 'phan po ru sku 'khrungs/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas las gdams ngag zhus/ bka' gdams gzhung drug gi 'chad nyan mdzad de bka' bdams pa'i srol bton/ po to dgon pa btab pas dge bshes po to ba zhes grags/ gsung rtsom la 〈be'u bum sngon po)/ dang 〈dpe chos rin chen spungs pa〉 sogs bzhugs//2 〈dpe chos rin chen spungs pa〉 ni gsung rtsom ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ de ni jo bo rje a ti shas mdzad pa'i 〈byang chub pam gyi sgron me'i〉/ nang don rnams 'jig rten gyi kha dpe dang sbyar te dpe re bshad nas don re gsal bar bstan pa'i gsung rtsom phul du byung ba zhig go/3 slob khrid nyan pa pos sdod kyi skyon gsum spang ba zhig gang dag yin/lan/ sdod kha spubs pa dang / sdod zhabs brdol ba/ sdod dri ma can bcas so//4 slob khrid nyan pa'i tshe dri ma drug spong dgos pa gang dag yin/lan/ nga rgyal dang / ma dad pa/ don du mi gnyer ba/ phyi rol rnam g.yeng / yid bsdus/ skyo 80

ba bcas drug go/5slob khrid nyan pa'i shes bya mi 'dzin pa'i skyon gang dag yin/lan/ tshig mi 'dzin pa dang / don mi 'dzin pa/ brda ma 'phrod par 'dzin pa/ log par 'dzin pa/ma lus par mi 'dzin pa bcas lnga'o//6 snod kyi skyon gsum dang dri ma drug ces pa'i snod dang dri ma'i don ni ci/lan/ sdod ni 'dir yon tan 'khrid bya'i slob ma dang slob ma'i blo'am rig pa la go ba dang / dri ma ni slob ma'i bsam pa ma dag pa'i don/7 sdod kyi skyon gsum kyi dang po sdod kha spubs pa dang dri ma drug gi bzhi ba phyi rol rnam g.yeng gnyis kyi don la khyad par ci yod/lan/ snga ma ni rig pa nang du bying zhing 'thibs nas rang stobs dwangs gsal gyi cha med pa dang /phyi ma ni rig pa nang du mi gnas par rta rgod bzhin phyi la shor bas bying ba dang rgod ba gnyis kyi khyad par ro/ /chu'i bstan bcos/1 〈chu'i bstan bcos)/ kyi mtshan cha tshang la ci zer ba dang / de'i rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 〈legs bshad chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs phreng brgyad ldan// zhes pa'i mtshan gsol zhing / rtsom pa po ni gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me (1762—1823) yin pa dang / khong ni mdo smad mdzod dge smad (da lta yin su'u zhing chen gtsos grong khyer khongs) du 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dge bshes lha rams pa'i ming btags blangs/ dgung lo so gcig par bla brang dgon pa'i tshogs chen khrir bzhugs te 'gro ba'i bstan pa rin po che rgya cher spel/ gsung rtsom po ti 12 bzhugs/ khong gi rnam thar rgyas tsam shes 'dod na dbal mang paṇḍitas mdzad pa'i 〈dad 81

pa'i pad mo bzhad pa'i nyin byed// la gzigs par zhu'o//2 legs bshad 'dir chu'i bstan bcos zer ba'i don ce yin/lan/ chu'i ngo bo dang rang bzhin/ phan nus sogs la sbyar nas blang dor gyi tshul la 'jug tshul bstan pa'i phyir ro//3 5chu'i bstan bcos/〉 kyi bstan bya gtso bo ci red/lan/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba'i blang dor dang 'jug ldog bstan pa'o//4legs bshad 'di'i rtsom stangs ci 'dra red/lan/ tsheg bar mdun ma'i tshigs bcad 'bri tshul ltar bris pa'i bslab bya zhig go/5rtag gus brtson pa ma btang na// mi 'grub bya ba ci yang med// ces pa'i rtag gus brtson pa’ji ltar 'grel/lan/ rtag sbyor dang gus sbyor brtson 'grus zhes pa'i bsdus ming ste/ dang po ni dus rtag tu brtson 'grus chen po byed pa la zer zhing / gnyis pa ni rang nyid kyes sbyang ba'i shes bya la mthong chen dang gal cher bzung ste brtson 'grus byas pa la zer ro//legs bshad kyi gtam rgyud tshan pa gsum/1 〈legs bshad kyi gtam rgyud tshan pa gsum/〉 ni gang nas btus te bdams/lan/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i 〈lugs kye bstan bcos skye bo gso ba'i thigs pa zhes bya ba'i 'grel ba// las bdams/2 legs bshad 'di'i rtsom pa po ngo sprod rags tsam byed thub bam/lan/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan (1374—1434) dbus stod sbram (dbu stod 'brang ma dang) du sku 'khrungs/ rje tsong kha ba'i slob ma yin/ sku tshe gang bor dam chos 'chad nyan kho na mdzad/82

gsung rtsom ni 〈'dul ba'i bslab bya chen mo// sogs pod gnyis bzhugs/〈 〈wadang sreg pa'i/〉 gtam rgyud kyis gnas lugs ci zhig bstan yod/lan/ rang la stobs dang nus pa ji 'dra che yang gnyom chung la thub tshod byas drags na mtha' mar rang nyad phung ba bstan yod/4 〈byi la'i rdzun tshig〉/ ces pa'i gtam rgyud kyi bstan bya gtso bo ci red/lan/spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang du rdzun smra ba dang mgo skor gtong mkhan ha cang mang bas mi rnams kyis der dogs zon byed dgos pa bstan yod/5 〈rgyal po'i sras dang bram ze'i bu〉/ zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyis bstan pa'i bya ba'i 'jug sdog gi gnas lugs ci zhig bstan yod/lan/ yon tan slob par dbul phyug dang dbang thang gi che chung med par chung dus nas 'bad pa chen pos sbyong dgos pa bstan yod/a chung gis rta nyos pa/1 〈a chung gi rta nyos pa〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom 'di gang las bdams shing / rtsom pa po su yin pa red/lan/ de ni bod kyi deng rabs rtsom yig dpe tshogs 〈rta nag sgrog 'gros〉 las bdams shing /rtsom pa po ni thub bstan zhes pa de yin/2 sgrung gtam 'di'i don gang la sbyar yod pa red/lan/ de ni spyi lo 1980 lor thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs gtan 'bebs dang lag bstar byas pas rgya che ba'i rong 'brog sa khul gyi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen je legs su song ba'i rnam pa der sbyar ba red/2 〈a chung gis rta nyos pa〉 zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kye khungs sne dang sngon 'gro/ mgo tshugs/ 'phel 83

rgyas/ mtho rlabs/ mjug 'bras gang yin pa red/ lan/ a khu sri thar gyi rta pe cin ci phu’ dang po dang / rta des 'gran sdur khrod ang dang po blangs pa ni gnyis pa dang / sri thar gyis rta 'tshong ba ni gsum pa dang / a chung gis rta nyos pa ni bzhi ba dang / a chung khyo shug 'ongs nas sri thar la sgor mo sprad pa ni lnga ba dang / sri thar gyi bsam blor 'gyur sdog byung ba ni drug pa'o/ /4 〈a chung gis rta nyos pa〉 zhes pa'i sgrung gtam gyi mi sna gtso bo su yin pa red/lan/ a chung ni gtam rgyud 'di'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo'o/ /5 a chung gis rta ma nyos pa'i sngon la sri thar gyis sa chung la lta tshul ji 'dra bzung yod pa dang / rta nyos pa'i rjes su sri thar la bsam tshul ji 'dra bzung ba red/lan/ lo 'ga'i sngon la a chung ni dbul bo yin pas sri thar gyis a chung ni da dung sngar ltar dbul bo yin par snyam nas mthong chung gi lta tshul 'dzin zhing / a chung gis rta nyo thub pa des kho'i bsam pa 'gyur nas dga' spro dang yid smon skyes pa red/6 rtsom yig 'dir rtsom pa pos gang zhig gtsor bzung nas mi sna'i snang brnyan gsar bzhengs byas yod/lan/ mi sna'i skad cha dang bya 'gul zhib 'bri byas te mi sna'i snang brnyan gsar bzhengs byas yod/4 sgrung gtam 'di'i mjug tu a chung khyo shug rtar zhon nas sri thar tshang la 'ongs te sgor mo lhag ma sprad pa des ci zhig mtshon yod/lan/ a chung ni kha dan tshig la gnas shing / g.yo sgyu med pa'i mi tshul ldan zhig yin pa dang / gong mthon po byin nas rta ming chen nyos pa'i rgyu stobs ldan pa ma zad/ da dung gnyen sgrig byas yod pa dang / ngo ma ming don mtshungs pa'i phyug por gyur yod pa mtshon yod/ 84

8 lo 'ga'i rjes su a chung la 'gyur ldog byung ba des don ci zhig mtshon pa red/ lan/ thon skyed 'gan 'khri'i lam lugs lag bstar byas rjes rong 'brog sa khul du 'tsho ba je bzang du song ba bstan yod/srong btsam sgam po/1 〈srong btsan sgam po// zhes pa gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 〈dung dkar tshig mdzod/〉 las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las (1928—1997) bod ljongs nying khri rdzong du sku 'khrungs/ se ra dgon par mdo sngags kyi gzhung la sbyangs pa mdzad nas dge bshes lha rams pa dang sngags rams pa'i ming btags thob/ gsung rtsom la 〈tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed)/ dang / 〈bod kyi chos srid zung 'brel skor bshad pa〉 〈deb ther dmar po'i mchan 'grel〉 sogs bzhugs so//2 srong btsan sgam po ni rgyal bo ji 'dra zhig red/lan/ bod spur rgyal dus skabs su btsan po mang du byung ba'i nang nas ches phul du byung ba'i chab srid dang / dmag don/ khrims lugs/ phyi 'brel bcas la mkhas pa'i rgyal po chen po zhig red/3 srong btsan sgam po zhes pa'i tha snyad 'dir nges tshig 'dren rgyu yod dam/lan/ rgyud drang zhing srong ba/ khrims la nye ring med pas bka' btsan pa/ mi sus kyang khong gi bsam tshul rtogs mi thub pas sgam po yod pa bcas kyi sgo nas mtshan de ltar btags pa yin/4srong btsan sgam po'i yab yum dang / 'khrungs 'das/ 'khrungs yul bcas gang dang gang yin/lan/ dang po yab gnam ri srong btsan dang yum 'bri bza' thod dkar tshe spong bza' dang /gnyis pa spyi lo 617 lor 'khrungs pa dang spyi lo650lor dgongs pa rdzogs/ gsum pa grong khyer lha sa'i shar phyogs mal gro rgya ma pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling yin/83

5 slong btsan sgam po'i mdzad rjes gtso che ba lnga bo gang dag yin/lan/ bod yongs gcig gyur byas pa dang / rgyal sa lha sar spos pa/ bod yig gsar gtod byed pa/khrims lugs bzos pa/ zhing 'brog thon skyed gong spel gyi bya thabs lag bstar byas pa bcas so//( srong btsan sgam pos gtan la phab pa'i khod so drug ni gang dag red/lan/ bka' yi khrims yig chen po drug dang / bka' gros chen po drug yig tshang drug phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' tshan dru ga bcas so//slob dpon thon mi/1 〈slob dpon thon mi〉 zhes pa gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan 〈thon mi'i zhal lung〉 las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni tshe tan zhabs drung (1910—1985)yin la/ khong ni mtsho sngon zhung hwa rdzong du sku 'khrungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang bor bsten nas bcu phrag rig gnas dang sgos su gzhung bka' pod lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad/ spyi lo (1959—19yo) lo'i bar mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang /spyi lo 1978 lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan byas te dge slob mang bor rig gnas dang lo rgyus skor gyi dpe khrid rgya cher gnang / mdor na sku tshe gang bor bod mi rigs kyi las don bsgrubs pa yin/ gsung rtsom la 〈thon mi'i zhal lung〉 dang / 〈snyan ngag spyi don〉 sogs mang ngo //2 bod yig gsar bzo mdzad pa'i rkyen gang la thug pa yin/lan/ srong btsan dgung lo bcu gsum thog rgyal sar bzhugs pas/ mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bo rnams kyis pho nya dang yi ge mang du bskur/ de dus bod la ngag 'phrin tsam las yi ge med stabs/ rgyal po'i thugs la chos srid zung gi don ston thub cing / bod rang gi skad dang mthun pa'i yi ge zhig bzo dgos snyam nas thon mi sogs rgya gar la brdzangs so//86

3 bod yig tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas gsar bzo mdzad/lan/ legs sbyar gyi dbyangs gsal lnga bcu las bod skad la mi mkho ba'i dbyangs ā sogs bcu gnyis dang / gsal byed gha sogs mthug po lnga/ ṭa sogs log pa bzhi/ ྅dro ba dang kṣa mthar zad bcas bcu gcig dor/ dbyangs i u e o bzhi dang / gsal byed lhag ma nyer gsum po'i steng du bod skad la med du mi rung ba'i yi ge drug ste/ stod du ca cha ja gsum dang smad du zha za 'a gsum bcas drug dang dbyangs kyi dang bo a yig bcas bsnan pas dbyangs gsal so bzhi'i rnam gzhag gtan la phab bo /4 bod yig ni dus nam zhig la sus gsar bzo mdzad/lan/ dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs srong btsan sgam po'i ring la thon mi sam sto ṭas bod yig gsar du bzos/5 thon mi rgya gar du lo ci tsam bzhugs pa dang slob dpon gang la bsten/lan/ lo grangs bdun la bzhugs pa dang khong gis bram ze li byin ga ra bsten nas yig rigs du ma la mkhas par sbyangs pa dang / lha rig pa'i seng ge bsten nas sgra mdo mang bo dang lugs kyi bstan bcos sogs bslabs/6 thon mi sam sgoṭa la slob dpon zhes pa'i ming ji ltar thogs/lan/ rgyal bo srong btsan sgam pos thon mi slob dpon du bsten zhing bkur bste dang sri zhu blor mi shong ba mdzad pas slob dpon thon mi sam sgoṭa zhes gsol/7 bod kyi yi gzugs 'bri ba'i dpe gang la byas te gsar du bris/lan/ lañdza la dpe byas nas dbu can dang wartu la dpe byas nas dbu med bzos/8 yon tan gyi gzhi ma yi ge yin zer don ci/87

lan/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang yin yang srid 'byor rig gsum gyi shes bya rnams yi ge'i lam nas dar spel dang rgyud 'dzin byed pa'i rtsa ba yi ge la rag las pas yi ge ni yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yin zhes brjod chog9 thon mi'i bod yig gsar bzo mdzad par dge mtshan ci zhig yod/lan/ skabs de'i nye 'brel rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan dag la ngo gnong mi dgos par rgyal srid bde legs ngang skyob thub par gyur pa dang / bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum dar spel rgyud 'dzin yong bar dge mtshan bla na med pa thon par ma zad/ da lta'ang sngar mus bzhin nus pa 'dod bzhin yod pa lags so/ /10 thon mi rgya gar gyi tshad pas mi gnod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ lam nas bal bo rgyal bo'i lag nas tshad pa la phan pa'i sman ga bur dang / cu gang /tsan dan kyi chu sogs blangs nas bsten pas so/ /11 slob dpon thon mi mdzangs mi bdun gyi gras su ji ltar 'jog pa yin/lan/ bod yig gsar bzo'i phyag rjes la gzengs bstod pa'i don du/ bod phrug mdzangs mi rim byon bdun yod pa las thon mi de'i gras kyi mdzangs mi bzhi bar bsngags so/ /12 thon mis rgya gar nas bod du gdan drangs pa'i bstan bcos gang dag yod/lan/ sgra rig pa'i bstan bcos dang / 'dul pa rin po che'i tog mdo za ma tog bkod pa/spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dge bcu'i mdo bcas so/ /13 thon mis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos du mdzad pa red/lan/ brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams par grags kyang / da lta sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis las med do/ /88

phyag 'jus gnang ba/1 〈phyag 'jus gnang ba〉 zhes pa'i rtsom 'di gang nas bdams/ rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ spyi lo2001lo'i 〈sbrang char// deb dang po las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni tshe 'bar yin/2 〈phyag 'jus gnang ba〉 zhes pa'i nang gi mi sna dang / don dag gang zhig gtso bor bzung nas bris yod/lan/ paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis mgar ba rdo rje la phyag 'jus gnang ba'i don de gtso bor bzung nas bris yod/〈 〈phyag 'jus gnang ba〉 zhes pa'i rtsom kyi bstan don ji 'dra red/lan/ pan chen rin po ches ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi bde sdug la thugs khur gnang ba dang /rigs rus mchog dman smra ba'i lta tshul dgag nas mgar las ni bzo las yin pa dang / mi rigs dar rgyas su 'akro dgos na bzo las la brten dgos pa'o/ /4 paṇa chen rin po ches mgar ba rdo rje la phyag 'tshal du ma bcug pa dang / khong gis mgar ba rdo rje'i lag pa dam por 'jus pa sogs las khong gi mdzad pa ci zhig mtshon yod/lan/ mi dang mi 'dra mnyam yin pa dang / bla ma yang mi yin pa dang / mgar ba ni rigs ngan min pa bden dpang byas yod/5 paṇa chen rin po che mgar ba rdo rje tshang la sku ngo ma 'tshams 'drir phebs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ mgar ba rdo rjes bcos sgyur sgo 'byed kye srid jus 'og mgar las la brten nas khyim kyi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen je bzang du gyur pa dang phyug 'gyur gyi ma dpe du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /6 rtsom 'di 'bri thabs ci zhig spyad nas bris yod/lan/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom las go rim ji bzhin brjod pa'i 'bri thabs spyad yod/89

shing gi bstan bcos/1 〈shing gi bstan bcos〉 ni gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 〈legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan// las bdams shing / rtsom pa po gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me yin/2 6ma 'di'i bstan don gtso bo ci zhig red/lan/ bya ba'i blang dor dang 'jug ldog byed pa'i gnas lugs bstan yod/3 legs bshad 'di dpe gang la sbyar nas bris yod/lan/ dpe shing gi ngo bo dang lo 'dab 'bras bu sogs la sbyar nas bris yod/zhu 'phrin bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/1 〈zhu 'phrin bdud rtsi'i thigs pa'i ni gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs// las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni deng rabs bod kyi slob gso ba chen mo gsung rab rgya mtsho zhes pa de yin la/ khong gi gsung rtsom la 〈sum rtags kyi tshig don mdor bsdus〉 dang / 〈dag yig nyi ma'i 'od zer)〉 sogs bzhugs so/ / 2 〈zhu 'phrin bdud rtsi'i thigs pa〉 ni rtsom ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ tsheg bar bco lnga dang bcu ma/ brgyad ma bcas spel mar byas te tshigs bcad kyi lam nas bris pa'i bslab bya'i rtsom zhig go/ /3 shes yon pa rgyu longs spyod gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos gang dag yod/lan/ btsan pos 'phrog mi thub pa dang rkun mas rku mi thub pa/ rang gi rjes su 'brangs pa sa gang du thon na de ru bkol chog pa'i khyad chos ldan no//90

lan/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi sras srong btsan sgam po la go/〈 〈skyid pa'i lha sras〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs ni ji 'dra zhig red/lan/ lo rgyus kyi don dngos gzhir bzung nas bris pa'i sgrung gtam zhig red/4 〈skyid pa'i lha sras/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom du mi sna gang dag 'dus pa dang / mi sna gtso bo gang dag yin/lan/ gnam ri srong btsan yab sras dang / khyung bo spung zad/ myang tseng sku/ zhang snang / seng go rmya chen sogs 'dus te / de dag khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo ni srong btsan sgam po red/5 slong btsan sgam po chung dus nas dpa' rtsal che ba dang / rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i rgyu rkyen gang yin/lan/ lhan skyes kye shes rab che ba'i khar yab gnam ri srong btsan gyis thugs zhib mo'i ngang nas gso skyong gnang ba'i rkyen yin/'a dwags po'i gyen log 'dul bar dpung gi ru sna 'dren mkhan ni su red/lan/ dmag dpon seng go myi chen red/7 rtsom 'dir bod kyi dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba mngon par mtshon pa ni gang yin/lan/ rgyal blon dang blon po gsar rnying bar gyi 'gal ba yin/8 〈skyid pa'i lha sras〉 zhes pa'i rtsom du gtso bo ci zhig bstan 'dugalan/ srong btsan sgam pos byis pa'i dus su rang rkya thub pa'i sgo nas gnad don la brtag dpyad dang / bsam gzhigs/ dbye zhib/ thag gcod bcas byed thub pa'i snying stobs dang blo gros bstan yod/9 〈skyid pa'i lha sras〉 la rtsom tshul gyi cha nas khyad chos ji 'dra yod/lan/ mi sna'i gtam gleng dang bya byed zhib 'bri byas nas mi sna'i gzugs brnyan gsar bzhengs 92

byas shing / don gyi byung rim ltar don zhig zhib brjod byas pa dang /tshig la grims sha che zhing brjod pa zor yangs pa sogs so//nga rang byis pa yin dus/1 〈nga rang byis pa yin dus// zhes pa ni gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 〈rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen mo mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur/〉 las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni gtsang spyon he ru ga rus pa'i rgyan can nam sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan (1452—1507) zhes pa de yin la/ dgung lo bdun par rab tu byung zhing / bco brgyad par rje btsun sha ha rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge'i mdun nas bka' brgyud kyi chos 'khor phal mo che'i lung gsan/ gzhan yang slob dpon kun dga' nyi ma sogs bsten nas gsang sngags kyi dbang sogs mang bo gsan/gangs te se dang tsa ri tra sogs gnas nges med du byon nas sgom sgrub mdzad/ gsum rtsom la〈mi la'i rnam mgur〉 sogs bzhugs so//2 nga rang byis pa yin dus zhes pa'i nga rang’’ gis su bstan pa red/lan/ rje btsun mi la ras pa bstan pa'o//3 mi la ras pa'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig brjod thub pa yin nam/lan/ rje btsun mi la ras pa ni (1040—1123) yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang yum myang tsha dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su la stod gung thang skya snga rtsa zhes bya ba'i sar sku 'khrungs pa dang / ming la thos pa dga' zer/ yab 'das rjes khong gi a khu dang a nes ma smad gsum po'i nor yod rgu 'phrog nas sdug las sna tshogs btang ba la/ 'khon lan 'jal phyir slob dpon klu brgyad mkhan nas klog bslabs/ de nas bla ma gnyag g.yung ston khro rgyal dang / khu lung ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdun nas mthu dang ser ba'i gdams ngag bslabs te/ mi rta bco brgyad bsad pa dang / ser bas lo tog 93

brdungs pa'i sdig pa la 'gyod pa skyes nas/ spyi lo1077lor mar ba lo tsā ba'i mdun du byon nas sras mkhar dgu thog bzhengs te dbang dang gdams pa sdogs par thob/ na bza' ras rkyang dang zhal zas zwa tshod la brten nas sgom sgrub mdzad nas mthar tshe gcig lus gcig nyid la 'tshang rgya bar gyur cing / khong gis mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs slob ma mang bo bskyangs par grags so/ /4rtsom 'dir mi sna gang dag yod pa dang / de las gtso bo su red/lan/ mi sna ni mi la ma bu gsum dang a khu dang sa ne bcas dang / mi sna gtso bo mi la ras pa yin/5 〈nga rang byis pa yin dus〉 zhes pa'i rtsom khrod kyi mi sna a khu dang a ne'i rang gshis gang 'dra red/lan/ kha dan tshig la mi gnas pa dang / ham sems che zhing ngo tsha med pa/ ya nga snying rje med pa'i skyug bro ba'i rang gshis de bris yod/6 7nga tsha dkar rgyan ni bud med kyi rang gshis rang ga ba zhig yin nam/lan/ blo pham dang yid ches/ phugs bsam med pa'i bud med rang ga ba zhig min par/ las la brtson zhing sdug sran che ba/ chags sdang gi rang bzhin gsal zhing / ma 'ongs par yid ches kyis khengs pa'i bud med cig go /7 thos pa dga' ma smad gsum gyi 'tsho ba shin tu nyam thag pa de slob tshan gyis tshig gang gis mtshon thub/lan/ gos hrul phrag thag chad pa la gres ma'i ske rags bcings pa gyon nas las dal med byed dgos byung bas/ yan lag rnams ser shar song / lto gos ngan pa'i stabs kyis kha mdog skya la sha rid pa/ skra dang bo gser g.yu'i ral ba nyil le ba la/ phyis skya bo bseng bseng shig sro'i ral ba nyil ba byung zhes pas mtshon no/ /94

8 yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan sku gsheṭa khar kha chems bzhag pa'i nang don gco bo gang yin nam/lan/ thos pa dga' ma smad gsum dang khyim gyi rgyu nor yod do cog a khu dang a ner bcol te/bu yis khyim so pher ba na mdzes se mna' mar bsu ba dang / rgyu nor rnams lhag lus med par phyir sprad de pha shul bus 'dzin du 'jug pa de'o/ /9 〈nga rang byis pa yin dus// zhes pa'i rtsom gyi brjod bya gang yin pa phris/lan/ thos pa dga' ma smad gsum gyis a khu dang a de'i lag 'og tu dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba bskyang tshul dang / a khu dang a ne'i gnyis kyes khong ma smad gsum la mnar gcod btang ba'i khrel med kyi bya spyod brjod pa'o/ /10 〈nga rang byis pa yin dus〉 zhes pa'i rtsom tshul la khyad chos gang 'dra yod/lan/ don gyi byung rim phra zhing zhib pa dang / mi sna'i gshis sa 'bur du thon pa/ tshig sbyor bde zhing kha gsal ba/ skad cha'i nyams phun sum tshogs pa bcas so/ /11 mi bdag bdag tu re/ bdag po sgo khyir 'don’’ zhes pa ni slob tshan du go ba ji ltar len dgos/lan/ rgyu nor gyi bdag po min pa a khu dang a ne gnyis kyis rgyu nor bdag tu bzung zhing /bdag po ngo ma thos pa dga' ma smad gsum sgo khyi'i tshul du phyir bton pa'i don de bstan pa'o/ /12 2 rnga gdang rgyug dang / dud pa lang rgyug ’ ces pa'i chos dpe 'di ji ltar 'grel/lan/dbyar kha snga bor langs nas gdang la btags pa'i bzho ma'i gam du brgyugs nas 'o ma bzho ba sogs kyi gla ba byed pa dang / dgun kha ches snga bor langs pa'i khyim tshang gi dud khung nas du ba 'phyur ba dang mal langs nas las ga'am g.yog byed du brgyugs pa'i don/ rnga ni ma dag pa yin 95

te/ snga gdang rgyug ces snga mo'i snga byas na dag par 'dod/ ces 〈dpe chos sna ba'i bdud rtsi〉 las gsungs//13 khyung tsha dpal 'gran du mi 'dug bdud mo stag 'gran du 'dug ces pa don 'grel byos/lan/ khyung ni mi la ras pa tshang gi rus yin zhing / a ne ni rus khyung gi rgyud pa'i ya rabs lugs bzang gi srol skyong mkhan zhig min par/ de las ldog ste sdig pa'i las la mi 'dzems pa'i bdud mo stag la 'gran pa'i bud med cig 'dug ste/ 'dir drag rtsub che zhing ya nga snying rje med pa'i mi la ras pa'i a de la go/skyes bu rnam 'byed gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan/1 〈skyes bu rnam 'byed gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom gyi nang don gtso bo gang yin pa phris/lan/ skyes bu bzang ngan gyi khyad par brjod de/ skyes bu gang dang gang ni blang bya dang / gang dang gang ni spang bya yin par bris yod/2 slob tshan 'di'i rtsom stangs gtso bo gang yin pa shod/lan/ tsheg bar bdun ma'i rigs dang bo ltar tshigs bcad kyi lam nas bris pa'i legs bshad cig go /3 2 gang gi bya ba rtsom pa na/ / phyis 'byung skyon dang yon tan ci//legs par gtan la phab nas 'jug / de dag skyes bu zhib mo yin/ /’/ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di'i bstan don gtso bo gang yin nam/lan/ 'jig rten gyi skyes bu zhib mo can zhig byed dgos pa'i gnas lugs brjod yod/96

bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba/1 〈bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba〉/ da gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 〈bslab bya gces bsdus〉/ las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho (1825—1897) zhes pa de yin la/ khong ni mdo smad rtse gzhung du sku 'khrungs/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun la slob gnyer mdzad cing / gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma ni thu'u bkwan blo bzang bshad sgrub dbang phyug dang co ne blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs mkhas pa brgya phrag tsam 'dug gsung rtsom la po ti bzhir longs pa bzhugs so/ /2 〈bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba〉 bslab bya gang gi 'grel ba'i tshul du brtsams pa yin/lan/ 〈mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba'i// don 'grel gyi tshul du brtsams pa zhig yin/〈 〈mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba〉 ni ci lta bu'i bslab bya zhig yin nam/lan/ de ni dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang du 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba la gangams pa'i mi chos kye bslab bya zhig go /4 〈bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba〉 zhes par gtso bo ci zhig brjod yod/lan/ mi dang mi'i bar la 'brel 'dris ji ltar byed tshul dang / 'brel 'dris byed dus su phyogs gang dag la gzab dgos pa sogs brjod yod/5 slob tshan du mi rigs rang gi skad cha brjed mi rung bar bstan pa'i tshig ni gang yin/lan/ skad rigs thams cad shes na bzang mod kyang / / rang gi pha skad brjed na ngo tsha yin//6 nang gi rang sems dgra ru ma ldang na/ / phyi yi 'dre gdon sus kyang thub par dka'/ / zhes par don 'grel byos/lan/ rang nyid kye sems de rang gis gcun thub tshe/ phyi yi dgra ci 'dra zhig byung yang des kho la 97

gnod pace yang byed mi thub ces pa'i don no//thang stong rgyal bo/1 〈thang stong rgyal bo/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom ni ji 'dra zhig red/lan/ lo rgyus kyi don dngos gzhir bzung nas bris pa'i mi sna ngo sprod pa'i gsal bshad rtsom yig gcig go / 2 zam pa 'dzugs rgyu'i kun slong dang snying stobs ji ltar byung ba yin/lan/ khong gi pha yul du lo re'i dbyar khar mi zog mang bo chus khur ba'i gnas tshul mthong ba dang / lha gdong gru kha nas gru gla ster rgyu med pas chu nang du bskyur ba rkyen byas te chu bor brgal mi thub pa rnams la zam pa 'dzugs rgyu'i dam bcas so/ /3 thang stong rgyal bo zhes pa'i mtshan ji ltar thogs pa red/lan/ khyab gdal chen po'i thang chen na/ / stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ / 'jig rten rgyal bor lta bur bzhugs// de'i phyir thang stong rgyal bo thob/ /4 thang sto5 rgyal bos mi tshe gang bor shing zam dang lcags zam ci tsam bsgrun pa dang / thengs dang bor bskrun pa'i lcags zam ni gang yin/ lan/ thang stong rgyal bos shing zas 60 dang lcags zam 58 tsam bskrun pa/ skyid chu'i lha gdong gru kha'i lcags zam ni khong gis thengs dang por btsugs pa yin/5 thang stong rgyal bos lha mo'i zlos gar gyi srol btod pa'i dgos pa ci yin/lan/ zam pa 'dzugs par ma dngul dang lcags bsdu bar mang tshogs la skul slo byed pa'i phyir ro/6 thang stong rgyal bo ni gdong mchong dpa' bo zhig yin par shes byed gang yod dam/lan/ dpal ri bo che'i lcags zam 'dzugs skabs/ lcags thag chad nas gtsang bo'i nang lhung ba 98

rdo pha bong la 'khril nas mi mang bos 'then ma thub par/ khong gis rta zla'i grang ngar la ma'adzem par 'khyags rom nas blangs pa de'o//7 thang stong rgyal bos lcags zam bskrun pa des bod la byas rjes gang dag bzhag yod/lan/ bod kyi 'grim 'grul la byas rjes rlabs chen bzhag pa mazad dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas thadala'ang byas rjes bzhag pa red/da bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyis thang stong rgyal bo'i bka' drin la rjes dran zhu ched lugs srol ji 'dra zhig dar ba red/lan/ snga dus khyim tshang so sor thang stong rgyal bo'i sku brnyan re bstan pa'am yang na gnas khang gsar ba spo skabs thog mar thang stong rgyal bo'i snang brnyan gdan 'dren pa sogs byed srol yod/bod kyi mi rgyud ji ltar byung tshul bshad/1 〈bod kyi mi rgyud ji ltar byung tshul bshad pa/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom 'di gang las bdams pa red/lan/ spyi lo1983lo'i 〈shes bya'i zegs ma〉 deb bco lnga ba las bdams/2 〈bod kyi mi rgyud ji ltar byung tshul bshad pa/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom gyi bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed so sor ngos zungs/lan/ bod kyi mi rgyud byung tshul ni bsgrub bya dang / sngon byon mkhas pa'i bzhed pa dang / tshad thub khungs ldan gyi lo rgyus deb ther gyi lung dang / tshan rig gi lta ba mang bo 'dren pa bcas sgrub byed do//3 bod kyi sdod bcud chags tshul ji 'dra zhig yin pa bstan yod/lan/ bod 'di thog mar chus yongs su bkang ba'i mtsho chen po zhig yin la/ chu rnams kong rong du thim ste skam sa'i rnam pa chags shing rim gyis rtsi shing dang nags tshal rgyas nas ri dwags dang gcan gzan dang / spra spre'u gnas su gyur/ de nas spre'u rnams blo rdo zhing lus stobs rgyas te mi ru 99

gyur nas 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ngo / /4 bong kyi 'akro ba mi'i rigs yul gang nas ji ltar byung ba yin nam/lan/ yul yar lung khog nas rtsed thang gong po ri'i spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang brag srin mo gnyis 'grogs pa las spre'u phrug mang du 'phel te rim gyis 'akro ba mi'i rigs byung ba red/5bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po de gang nas byung ba red/lan/ de la mkhas pa rnams bzhed pa mi mthun mod/ mang che bas spu bo'i yul gyi yum bya mo btsun bya ba'i sras tha chung u be ra zhes pa de yin par 'dod do/ /6 bod kye mi rgyud ni rgya gar nas chad par 'dod pa'i bstan bcos gang yin/lan/ 〈lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel〉/ zhes pa'o/ /7 bod kyi lo rgyus su grong la snga ba sogs brtsi ba gang dag yod/lan/ zhing la snga ba zo dang zhing dang / yul la snga ba yar lung khog krong la snga ba phying ba stag rtse/pho brang la snga ba yum bu bla mkhar/ rje la snga ba gnya' khri btsan po sogs so/ /da bod kyi rgyal sa dang mkhar rdzong dag ri brag gi gdong snar brtsigs pa'i srol ji ltar byung /lan/ gnya' khri btsan pos bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur te pho brang yum bla mkhar brtsigs pa nas byung / 9 bod yul gyi sa'i chags tshul gyi shes byed dang khungs ci zhig yin/ de la yang dag pa'i bden dpang gang gis byas/lan/ de ni bod mi blo rno ba dag gis brtags shing dpyad pa'i sdom tshig de mes pos mang tshogs dang phas bu la bshad pa lta bu'i sgo nas gcig nas gcis tu brgyud/ de rjes su yi ger bkod pa yin/bshad tshul de'i yang dag pa'i bden dpang ni/ sngar gyi bshad rgyun de tshan rig dang mthun pa'i /0(

po/ gdags khri btsan po/ me khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po bcas yin/3 stod kyi steng gnyis gang yin/lan/ stod kyi steng gnyis ni/ gri gum btsan po dang pu de gung rgyal gnyis yin/4 bar gyi legs drug ni gang yin/lan/ bar gyi legs drug ni/ i sho legs/ de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ gu ru legs/ 'brong zhi legs/e sho legs/ /5 spyi lo bee nam zhig la 'go tshugs pa dang chos lugs gang gis gtan la phab/lan/ spyi lo 'di rigs ldan gsum pa bzang bo'i khri lo don brgyad pa nas 'go tshugs ste ye shu ma shi ga 'khrungs pa'i lo nas brtsis pas/ ye shes chos lugs kyis gtan la phab pa'i lo tshugs yin/6 grong btsan sgam po rgyal rabs du ba yin/ dgung lo ga tsam gyi thog rgyal sar bzhugs pa red/lan/ srong btsan sgam po rgyal rabs so gnyis pa yin zhing / dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes thog rgyal sar bzhugs pa red/7 slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas dang / mkhan chen po rnyi sa tā gnyis bod du gdan 'dren pa'i rgyal bo su yin/lan/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan yin/8 gang 'dra zhig la bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar zer/lan/ bstan pa snga dar ni glang dar ma'i sngon gyi chos rgyas mes dbon rnam gsum gyi sku ring la bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba la zer zhing / bstan pa phyi dar ni glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal byon nas sangs rgyas kye bstan pa slar gsos te dar rgyas byung ba la zer/102

9 rgya bza' kong jo dang bal bza' kong jo bod du phebs skabs so sos gdan drangs pa'i rten skal gang yin/lan/ snga mas jo bo shākya mu ne dang / phyi mas jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje gdan drangs pa red/10 dbul phyug lan gsum gyi bar tu snyoms par mdzad pa'i rgyal bo su yin/lan/ mu ne btsan po yin/bod du gso rig dar tshul mdo tsam bshad pa/1 〈bod du gso rig dar tshul mdo tsam bshad pa)〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de gang nas bdams pa dang rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 1997 lor si khron mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i 〈bod kyi gso rig snying nor gces bsdus〉 las bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po ni khams sde dge dpal spungs su 'khrungs pa'i thub bstan phun tshogs (1955) yin/2 bod kyi gtam dpe la/ nad la snga ba dang / sman la snga ba gang ngos 'dzin byas yod/lan/ nad la snga ba ma zhu ba/ sman la snga ba chu khol ma ngos 'dzin byas yod/3 chu khol tsha mo dang mar khus nad gang dag bcos pa red/lan/ chu khol tsha mos ma zhu ba'i nad bcos pa dang / rma kha la mar khu byuṭa nas khrag gcod pa red/4 bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig gi 'byung khungs gang yin/ deng gi sa cha gang la ngos 'dzin byas pa red/lan/ bod kyi gna' bo'i shes rig gi 'byung khungs ni zhang zhung zhes pa ste/ deng gi mnga' ris spu hrengs khul yin/5 ston pa gshen rab mi bo che dus nam zhig la gnas gang du 'khrungs pa red//03

lan/ spyi lo sngon —657lor/ zhang zhung 'ol mo lung ring du sku 'khrungs pa red/6 zhang zhung gi gso rig gzhung lugs 〈gso rig 'dod dgu 'bum bzhi〉 zhes pa ni sus phyogs bsgrigs byas pa red/lan/ de ni dpyad bu khri shes kyis phyogs bsgrigs byas pa red/7 〈mi 'jig pa'i mtshon cha〉 zhes pa de rgyal bo gang gi skabs su brtsams pa yin/ rtsom mkhan dag gang gi yin/lan/ bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su brtsams pa yin/ rtsom mkhan ni rgya gar gyi bha ra rnya dza/ rgya nag gi han wang hang / ta zig gi ga le nu bcas yin/8 rgya bza' gyim shing kong jos bod du khyer yong ba'i gso rig gi dpe cha dus nam zhig la lo tsā ba gang dag gis bsgyur ba red/lan/ de ni spyi lo712lor/ hwa shang ma ha kyin da dang / khyung bo tsi tsi/ khyung bo do tshugs/ rgya phrug gar mkhan/ cog la smon lam 'bar sogs kyis bsgyur/9 spyi lo 762 lor/ g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon pos kong po sman lung du sman gyi slob grwa btsugs pa la thog mar slob ma ci tsam bsdus pa dang / slob yun dang slob gzhi gtso bo/ so so'i yon tshad dang bstun pa'i ming btags ji ltar gtan 'beb byas pa red/lan/ thog mar slob ma sum brgya bsdus shing / slob yun lo bcu gtan 'bebs byas/ 〈gso rig rgyud bzhi/〉 slob gzhi gtso bor byas/ slob ma so so'i yon tshad dang bstun pa'i ming btags kyi go rim ni/ yon tshad mtho shos la 'bum rams pa dang / de'i 'og ma la rab 'byams pa/ de'i 'og ma la bka' bcu ba/ de'i 'og ma la bsdus ra ba bcas rim pa bzhir phye yod/10 sman pa'i ming lha rje zer ba'i mtshan ji ltar byung ba yin//04

lan/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'i btsan gyis sman pa la gang bkur ha cang chen po gnang zhing / spyi tshogs thog nas sman pa la brtsi bkur byed dgos pa'i bka' bsgrags/ bod kyi rgyal bo la lha zhes 'bod cing / des kyang rje ru bkur ba'i phyir na lha rje zhes mtshan gsol/11 g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po ni dus nam zhig la 'khrungs pa dang / khong gi brtsams chos gang yin/ lan/ khong ni spyi lo 1116 lor gtsang stod sgo bzhi re thang du 'khrungs/ khong gi brtsams chos ni 〈sngo 'bum chen po〉 dang 〈g.yu thog cha lag bco brgyad〉 yin/12 dngul chu btso bkru chen po gsar btod gnang mkhan su yin/lan/ de ni mkhas grub o rgyan pa yin/13 gang 'dra zhig la byang zur lugs gnyis zer ba yin/lan/ byang lugasazhes pa byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang gi slob rgyud rnams la zer/ zur lugs zhes pa zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i slob rgyud rnams la zer/14 lha sa'i lcags po ri la lcags ri 'gro phan rig byed gling 'dzugs mkhan su yin/ khong gi gso rig gi brtsams chos rang lugs gang yin/lan/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yin/ khong gi gso rig gi brtsams chos ni 〈beeḍūrya sngon po〉/yin/ gso rig rgyud 'dzin gyi lugs ni byang lugs yin/15 byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang dang zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje gnyis kyi 'khrungs dus dang 'khrungs yul gang yin/lan/ byang ba rnam rgyal grags bzang sa/ spyi lo1295lor gtsang ngam ring du byang ba sde ba'i dpon tshang zhig nas zur mkhar du sku 'khrungs//03

16 sde dge dpal bzang dgon du shar dpal spungs sman grwa 'dzugs mkhan su yin/lan/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas yin/17 byang zur lugs gnyis la rtsa ba'i cha nas mi 'dra ba yod dam/ de gnyis mi 'dra ba'i phyogs gang yin/lan/ rtsa ba'i cha nas mi 'dra ba gang yang med kyang / slob dpon rnam gnyis kye 'khrungs yul sogs khor yug gi cha rkyen mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis sman rdzas ngos 'dzin gnang stangs la mi 'dra ba re zung dang / gtar kha dang me btsa'i gsang dmigs ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' yod pa red/dge ldan legs bshad/1 dgo lngan leṭa band kyi mtshan byang yongs la ci zer/mdzad pa po su yin/rtsom stangs ji 'dra yin/lan/ mtshan byang yongs la 〈mkhas pa dang blun po brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs bshad pad ma dkar po'i chun po/〉 zer/ mdzad pa po ni/ dga' ldan khri rabs bco lnga ba paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa (1478—1554) yin/ bstan bcos hril bor tshigs bcad sho lo ga brgya dang nyer lnga yod/ rtsom stangs ni legs bshad ltar brtsams yod/2 〈dge ldan legs bshad〉〉 ji ltar brtsams pa red/lan/ bshad tshul la bstan bcos 'di mdzad skabs sa skya ba la 〈sa skya legs bshad〉 ces pa yod na/ dge lugs par dge ldan legs bshad/’ ces pa zhig ci ste yod mi rung zhes do zlar brtsams par grags so//〈 〈dge ldan legs bshad/〉 kyi nang don ji 'dra red/lan/ bstan bcos 'dir gtso bo mkhas pa dang blun po'i tshul lugs brjod pa'i sgo nas skye bo 106

rnams la 'jig rten mi chos dang dam pa'i lha chos te/ lugs gnyis kyi legs nyes blang dor ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rgyas par bstan yod/4 〈dge ldan legs bshad// kyi rtsom stangs thad khyad chos ji 'dra yod/lan/ legs bshad hril bor gshib sdur gyi mtshon thabs spyad yod la/ rjod byed kyi tshig sdeb legs shing go sla bar ma zad/ tshig snga ma gnyis dpe can dang phyi ma gnyis dper bkod pa de dag kyang 'byor zhing gnad du 'khel pa sha stag go / da dung gnas lugs kyis kun nas phyug pa'i gtam rgyud sogs la sbyar yod pas yid 'gugs pa'i nus pa ldan no/ /snyan tshig khag bzhi/1 〈snyan tshig khag bzhi〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de gang las bdams shing rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ de ni bod kyi rtsom rigs dpe tshogs 〈sprin gyi sgra dbyangs// las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni ban de bkra shis yin/2 'bag sku'i zhal ras’’ zhes pa'i tshan pa de'i drang phyogs ci ltar bris yod/lan/ gser gyis brgyan pa'i kho'i zhal ras la mi tshang ma dad cing / dad ldan gyi mi rnams kyis rang nyid kyi rtsol bar brten pa'i 'bras bu rang la 'bul bar bskul zhing / rang gi mdun du nor dang longs spyod ha cang yang ngoms pa med pa bris yod/3 'bag sku'i zhal ras / zhes pa'i tshan pa de'i zur gzhogs nas ci zhig mtshon yod/lan/ rgyun du ngag nas spyi don kho na smra ba'i g.yo zol la brten nas mthon po'i khri la 'dzegs te mi dmangs kyi gnya' la zhon cing / lkog tu mi dmangs kyi rgyal kha'i 'bras bu bdag gir bzung ba dang / rang don 'ba' zhig gnyer yang ngoms pa med pa'i dpon po za rngam can dag gi rang gshis ngan pa de mtshon par byas yod//07

4 'bag sku'i zhal la gser bzang btso ba'i khu ba byugs don ci/lan/ de ni mchod yon 'bad med du thob pa dang / gzhan nor g.yo 'phrog byed pa'i ched dang /mdun du longs spyod ci tsam spungs kyang yid mi tshim pa'i rang gshis so/ /5 2 gzig lpags gyon pa'i bong bu ’ zhes pa'i tshan pa de'i drang thad du ci zhig bris yod pa red/lan/ g.yo sgyu ldan pa'i mis bong bu yi lus la gcan gzan gzig gi pags pa bkab nas lo tog za ba gang der mi rnams kyi dogs zon byed dgos pa bris yod/6 gzig lpags gyon pa'i bong bu zhes pa'i tshan pa de zur gzhogs nas ci zhig nas ci zhig mtshon par byas yod/lan/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kye mi kha shas kyis g.yo sgyu'i thabs la brten nas gzhan yid rmongs par byed pa dang / lus la rgyal khab dang mi dmangs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bcas kyi khe phan sgrub pa'i phyi gos gyon nas ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi 'bras bu ham zos byed pa'i bya spyod de mtshon par byas yod/7 ne tso’ zhes pa'i snyan ngag de'i zur gzhogs nas ci zhig mtshon par byas yod/lan/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i steng rig gnas med cing nus pa dang nyams myong dben pa kha shas kyis g.yo sgyu'i kha gsag la brten nas go sa mthon por 'dug pa'i skal ba ldan rjes/ khe spogs bza' rgyu kho na'i don du khrel med kyi bya spyod skyug bro ba de mtshon yod/8 4 wa skyes rgyal bo ’ zhes pa'i snyan ngag de'i zur gzhogs nas ci zhig mtshon par byas yod/lan/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod mi kha shas la yon tan dang nus pa ci yang med kyang / g.yo dang rdzun la brten nas dpon po'i thob thang dang go sa blangs shing / mi rigs kyi khe phan dang la rgya bor te rang gi mi rigs la mthong chung dang dma' 'bebs byed pa'i spyod tshul la zur za byas yod//02

9 wa skyes rgya bos lus la tshon byugs don ci yin/lan/ go sa thob pa'i ched du'o/ /10 'bag sku dang wa skyes rgyal bo gnyis kyi mtshon bya ci yin/lan/ 'bag skus dpon po za rngam can dang wa skyes rgyal bos g.yo zol la brten nas khri la bzhuṭa pa'i dmangs don mi sgrub pa'i dpon ngan kha shas mtshon/ma bu gnyis kyi mdzad rjes/1 〈ma bu gnyis kyi mdzad rjes〉 zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa dang rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di — 1983 lo'i 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉/ deb bzhi ba las bdams pa dang rtsom pa po ni grags pa 'byung gnas yin/2 rtsom yig de rtsom stangs gang gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / bstan don gang yin/lan/ rtsom yig de ni lhug rtsom gyi rtsom stangs khongs su gtogs pa dang / de'i bstan don ni rtsom pa pos tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa dang snyan ngag gi nyams la brten nas/ krung go gung khran tang gis mes rgyal bcings bgrol dang 'dzugs skrun byed par rlabs chen gyi byas rjes bzhag pa la bsngags brjod byas yod pa dang / de brgyud nas krung go gung khran tang med na krung go gsar ba med pa dang / da lta'i bde skyid med pa bstan yod/3 〈ma bu gnyis kyi mdzad rjes〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ga 'dra zhig red/lan/ bcad lhug spel ma'i bris pa'i lhug rtsom snyan ngag cig red/4 〈ma bu gnyis kyi mdzad rjes〉/ las parang byung khams kyi nam zla'i 'gyur ldog’/ ces pa'i tshig des don ci zhig bstan yod/lan/ skabs de'i gsar brje'i gnas babs dza drag che zhing gtan 'jags min pa'i rnam pa /09

bstan yod/5 〈ma bu gnyis kyi mdzad rjes〉 kyi rtsom yig khrod ngo mtshar ba'i snang ba’ dang rmi lam’’brjod pa des don ci zhig bstan yod/ lan/ krung go gung khran tang gis dbu khrid gnang ba'i gsar brje'i mtshon byed khyad rtags gsal bar byas shing bu rgod sngon rjes gnyis kyi khyad par rnam par phye ba red/6 lo rgyus su bkod pa'i bskal chen bzhi brgyud’ ces pa de'i don gang yin/lan/ krung go'i gsar brje'i lo rgyus dus rim gal chen bzhi ste/ rgyal nang gsar brje dmag 'khrug dang po dang gnyis pa/ ri 'gog dmag 'khrug bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug bcas so /7 〈ma bu gnyis kyi mdzad rjes〉 zhes pa'i ma bu gnyis gang la ngos 'dzin dgos/lan/ ma bu gnyis kyi ma ni mes rgyal la ngos 'dzin pa dang bu ni krung go gung khran tang la ngos 'dzin dgos/8 tsham yum gyi lus la gcong nad drag po phog’’ ces pa dang / pa lus stobs rim bzhin nyams’’zhes pa dang / ra phyi'i tsha grang gi 'byung khams 'khrugs pa’ zhes pa sogs kyi bstan don ci yin/lan/ ra ma yum gyi lus la gcong nad drag po phog’/ ces pa ni mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su gnod 'tshe chen po byung bas mi dmangs rnams dka' sdug myang ba'i don bstan yod/ ra lus stobs rim bzhin nyams pa’ zhes pa des mes rgyal nyams rgud du gyur pa dang mi rigs 'jig nyen la thug pa'i don bstan yod/ pa phyi'i tsha grang gis 'byung khams 'khrugs pa ’ zhes pa des btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis btsan 'dzul byas pas rgyal nang gi rnam pa zang zing du gyur pa'i don bstan yod/9 〈ma bu gnyis kyi mdzad rjes〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig gi mgor dus kyi dge mtshan brjod pa de'i //0

don gyi snyeng bo'am dmigs yul ci yin/lan/ dus kyi dge mtshan brjod pa de'i shugs nas rang re'i mes rgyal ni rnam pa kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus bzang bor gnas pa bstan yod/ya ru zhig1 〈ya ru zhig〉 ces pa'i rtsom yig de gang las bdams shing / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom yig de 1985 lo'i 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal// deb dang po nas bdams shing / de'i rtsom pa po ni tshe dbang yin/2 〈ya ru zhig〉 ces pa ji lta bu'i rtsom yig cig red/lan/ 'bod pa'i tha snyad dang po'i 'bri thabs bkol nas bris pa'i lhug rtsom shig yin/3 ya ru zhig’ gi mtshon bya ci/lan/ ra rig gnas gsar brje'i ’ nang du nyams nyes byung ba'i gzhon nu zhig yin/4 〈ya ru zhig〉 ces pa'i rtsom yig nang kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa'i dgun kha’ zhib 'bri byas pa de'i mtshon bya ci/lan/ des rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i las 'gan mtshon par byas yod/5 4 dpyid kyi dpal yon shar ba zhib 'bri byas pa des ci mtshon/lan/ des tang krung dbyang gis mi bzhi tshogs khag’’ rdul du brlas pa mtshon par byas yod/6 g.yag rgan gyi skad cha yis ci zhig mtshon/lan/ spyi tshogs ring lugs deng rabs can bzhi 'dzigs skrun byed pa'i 'bod skul mtshon par byas yod/7 〈ya ru zhig)〉 ces pa'i rtsom 'dir 'bri thabs gang dag spyad yod/

cang shes rta pho/1 〈cang shes rta pho/〉 zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po su red/lan/ rtsom 'di ni1984lo'i 〈zang char/〉 deb gsum pa las bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po ni rdo rje mkhar yin/2 〈cang shes rta pho〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'di'i brjod bya'i bstan don gyi thad nas ci 'dra yin/lan/ brjod bya'i bstan don phyogs gsum nas bstan yod pa ni/ gcig nas rtsom pa pos rta pho'i khyad chos dang yon tan mang bo zhig la bstod pa byas pa brgyud de bod rigs mi dmangs kyi las la brtson zhing gzhung rgyud drang ba/ zhi zhing 'jam pa'i gshis ga sogs la bstod pa byas yod pa/gnyis nas dus rabs gsar ba'i nang gi bod kyi na gzhon rnams kyi spobs pa dang snying stobs/brtson 'grus bcas la bsngags brjod byas yod pa/ gsum nas bod kyi shes ldan pa rnams kyi spobs pa dang yon tan la bstod pa byas pa brgyud nas/ der rjes su yi rang byed pa'i bsam tshul mtshon yod/3 8cang shes rta pho/) zhes pa'i rtsom stangs thad nas khyad chos ji 'dra yod pa red/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ni tshig lhug snyan ngag cig yin pa/ brjod bya gson nyams ldan phyir mtshon thabs sna mang bkol yod pa dang / tshig gi gcod mtshams thung zhing dbyangs 'gros snyan pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan no/ /4 ci 'dra zhig la tshig lhug snyan ngag zer/lan/ lhug rtsom gyi khyad chos yod la snyan ngag gi khyad chos kyang ldan pa dang / lus tshigs bcad ma yin par lhug pa yin pa dang / tshig gi gdegs 'jogs gsal zhing brjod bya la snyan ngag gi ro nyams ldan pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la zer/1/8

shes rab brgya ba/1 〈shes rab brgya ba〉 zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa yin/ mdzad pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 〈shes rab brgya ba// las btus pa/ mdzad pa po ni 'phags pa klu sgrub yin/khong ni 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi ya gyal te/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya'i thog rgya gar lho phyogs be dngha'i yul du bram ze zhig gi khyim du sku 'khrungs/chung dus nas rig gnas kun la mkhas par sbyangs/ gsung rtsom la 〈skye bo gso thigs〉/ dang〈bshes pa'i springs yig〉 〈shes rab sdong bu〉 sogs bstan bcos mang bo yod/2 shes rab brgya ba zhes pa'i ming ji ltar btags pa yin/lan/ 'di la yi ge dang tshig gi tshogs mang bo med par don gyi gnad 'dus shing / 'jig rten mi chos kyi blang dor 'byed cing / gtan tshigs kyes brgyan pa'i gzhung lugs 'di la tshigs su bcad pa brgya yod pas na/ shes rab brgya ba zhes brjod/3 slob tshan 'dir bkod pa'i sho lo yi so so'i dpe don sbyor stangs thad nas ji 'dra zhig red/lan/ dpe don sbyor stangs thad nas/ tshig bcad sho lo sa re re'i tshig rkang snga ma gnyis ni don dang / phyi ma gnyis ni dpe yin la/ dpe rgyan gyi zla bo dngos bo'i dpe ltar bris yod/4 〈shes rab brgya ba)〉 zhes brjod don ci/lan/ shes rab kyi dge mtshan brjod yod/5 〈shes rab brgya ba〉〉 yi rtsom stangs thad khyad chos ji 'dra yod/lan/ yig tshogs nyung zhing don mang bo 'dus pa dang / tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs pa/ dpe don sbyor ba gnad du khel zhing brjod don gting zab par ma zad/ gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa/bya tshig gcig gis tshig tril bo'i nang du srog gi nus pa thon yod pa soṭa khyad chos mang bo yod do/ /2(

byas yod/7 〈 sde ba'i klan ga〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs thad nas khyad chos ji 'dra yin/lan/ rtsom stangs sgrung gtam yin la/ byung rim spros pa go rim gsal ba/ don dag bris pa bden snang gis khengs pa/ mi sna'i snang brnyan 'bur du thon pa/ mjug bsdus pa mtshar zhing blo yul las 'das pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan no/ /na gzhon tsho la lta tshul re gnyis gleng ba/1 〈na gzhon tsho la lta tshul re gnyis gleng ba〉/ zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 1985 lor 〈zang char〉/ deb bzhi ba'i nang gi 〈gling seng chen gyi byung ba mdor bsdus〉〉 zhes pa las btus pa dang / rtsom pa po ni mdo smad dmu dge dgonapa'i 'gram sog po ru sku 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon dmu dge bsam gtan (1914—1993) yin/2 〈na gzhon tsho la lta tshul re gnyis gleng ba〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ de ni dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i na gzhon 'ga' re'i lta tshul nor 'khrul yo bsrang byed par bris pa'i dgag sgrub rtsom yig cig yin/3 rtsom pa pos gzhan gyi lta ba gsum dgag yod pa ci/lan/ rjo bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma tsho ni chos la zhen pa'i stabs kyes de dag gis brtsams pa'i lo rgyus sogs la yang dag pa gcig kyang med’’ ces pa dang /① sum cu ba ni thon mis brtsams pa ma red’’ ces pa dang / ④thon mi sam sto ṭa zer pa zhig med ces gsum la dgag pa gnang yod/4thon mi 'khrungs yul gang yin pa dang yab kyi mtshan la ci zer/lan/ thon mi 'khrungs yul sne mo thon nas yin pa dang sa gnas der thon lugs ra kha bya ba'i /22

grong dang de'i sa zhing yang ngos 'dzin rgyu yod/ (lho kha gnyal gyi sa 'bo rwa zhes pa'i grong tsho de nas yin par bzhed pa mi 'dra ba yod) yab kyi mtshan la a nu ra ga ta zer/5 brda sprod pa sum cu ba bee slob dpon thon mi' brtsams pa gang gis shes thub/lan/ bu ston chos 'byung sogs deb ther nang thon mis yi ge dang sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad par gsungs pa de yang lo chen nam bzang gi 'grel ba bstan pa'i sgron mer drangs pa las shes thub/6 4ba tshan gyi tshig mon yul rdor gcod ’ dang khyi tshogs nang dmur ’ gnyis kyi don ci/lan/ mon yul rdor gcod kyi don ni blang bya dor byar gyur pa/ dor bya blang byar gyur ba'i don bstan yod/ khyi tshogs nang dmur gyi don ni rang mi rigs nang khul du phan tshun la 'khon 'dzin dang phrag dog byed pa'i don bstan yod/7 〈na gzhon tsho la lta tshul re gnyis gleng ba〉/ zhes pa'i brjod bya'i snying bo ci/lan/ slob tshan 'dir yab mes gong ma'i mdzad rjes dang bod kyi lo rgyus la rgyus med kyi gtam spra bar dgag gzhag mdzad de bod kyi rig gnas kye gal chen rang bzhin brjod de yang dag pa'i lo rgyus smra ba'i lta tshul ldan dgos pa'i gnas lugs bstan yod/8 〈na gzhon tsho la lta tshul re gnyis gleng ba〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs thad khyad chos ji 'dra yod pa red/lan/ rtsom 'dir gnad du khel ba'i gtam dpe bkod de gzhan lugs dgag pa dang lo rgyus kyi dngos don dper bkod de rang gi lta tshul bden par bsgrubs pa/ gnad don bton pa bye brag rang bzhin ldan zhing spyi khyab kyi ngo bo ldan pa/ gnad don la rigs 'ded byas pa bden tshugs thub cing don la gnas yod//23

rtswa thang / ljang mdog gi pha sa/1 〈1 thang / ljang mdog gi pha sa/〉 zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 〈bee thang gi shes bya phran tshegs dang de'i srung skyob skor〉/ zhes pa las bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po ni mig dmar dbang 'dus yin/2 — thang du rtswa'am sngo ljang skye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen gang dag 'dus yod/lan/ rtswa thang du rtswa'am sngo ljang skye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen gtso gras su gnam gshis dang / sa rgyu'i rkyen/ skye dngos kyi cha rkyen/ de dang chabs cig mi'i bya 'gul sna tshogs sogs 'dus yod/3 slob tshan du rtswa thang rig pa'i nang nas drangs’ yod pa'i rtswa thang gi mtshan nyid cung 'thus tshang ba'i mtshan nyid cig yod pa de ji 'dra yin pa red/lan/ zhing sa dang nags tshal/ bye thang / rdo g.yam gyis khengs pa'i sa cha/ de bzhin chab rom sogs khongs su mi gtogs pa'i rtswa phran rigs sna tshogs skye ba'i sa cha zhig la rtswa thang zhes brjod do/ /4 sngo kheb kyi grub cha gtso bo ni gang dag yin/lan/ sngo kheb kyi grub cha gtso bo ni shing phran dang / rtswa rigs sdum bu sogs yin/5 1 thang gi rtswa la dbye ba gang dag yod/lan/ rtswa thang gi rtswa la dbye na rtswa dang spang rtswa/ bye rtswa bcas khag che ba gsum du dbye yod/6 rwa thang gi gnad don che shos ni gang yin pa red/lan/ rtswa thang bye sa dang sa nag tu gyur ba de yin/7 mdo dbus sa mtho'i rtswa thang gi spyi'i rgya khyon dang / bed spyod chog pa'i rtswa thang gi spyi'i rgya khyon ci tsam zin yod/lan/ mdo dbus sa mtho'i sa bab mtho ba'i rtswa thang gi spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma khri /2 4

tsho 250 tsam yod cing / de'i nang du bed spyod chog pa'i rtswa thang gis rtswa thang spyi'i rgya khyon 70yozin gyin yod/8 la gcig gam ne le gcig gis nyi ma gcig la a bra ga tshod gsod pa yin/lan/ wa gcig gam de le gcig gis nyi ma gcig la a 225gsod pa red zer/9 'o 'thung khung 'dru'i srog chags rtswa thang la gnod pa byed mkhan gang dag yin/lan/ byi ba dang / a bra/ bye long / phyi ba sogs kyis rtswa sa bslogs nas rtswa thang la gnod pa chen po bzo bzhin yod/10 a bra dang byi long bcas kyi gnyen po gang dag yin/lan/ wa dang sre mong sogs gcan gzan chung ba'i rigs dang / ne le sogs 'dab chags kyang yod do/ /11 e sha ya gling gi shing mi skyes pa'i dmigs bsal gyi rtswa thang gang yin/lan/ rang cag 'tsho bzhin pa'i mdo dbus sa mtho'i thog gi rtswa thang yin/12 phyugs 'tsho tshad las brgal na rtswa thang la gnod pa ci zhig 'byung ba yin/lan/ phyugs 'tsho tshad las brgal na rtswa thang bye sa can tu 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin/13 (rtsu thang / ljang mdog gi pha sa〉 zhes pa 'di rtsom stangs gang gi khongs su gtogs pa dang /brjod bya'i thad nas ji 'dra yin/lan/ rtsom yig de da gsal bshad rtsom yig gi rtsom stangs khongs su gtogs pa dang / de'i brjod bya'i thad nas rtswa thang nyams nyes su 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen dang / rtswa thang du 'tsho ba'i mi rnams la der srung skyob byed dgos pa'i kros gzhi bton nas/ mi rnams la rtswa thang yun nas yun du gnas par 'bad dgos pa'i skul ma btang yod//23

gtsod/1 〈gtsod// ces pa'i slob tshan 'di gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di — 20༅ lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par sgrun pa'i 〈bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng dus kyi khor yug srung skyob// ces pa las bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po ni zla ba tshe ring yin/2 9 gtsod’’ 'tsho sdod byed sa gang yin/lan/ ( gtsod ni mdo dbus mtho sgang na 'tsho sdod byed pa las yul gru gzhan na med/3 gtsod’ kyi rigs ji ltar dgar yod/lan/ gtsod ni rmig pa kha dbrag gi sde dang ba glang gi khongs su gtogs shing / pho la gug po dang mo la yu mo zer/4 'dzam gling thog tu gtsod la rin thang dang skad grags che ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo gang yin/lan/ gtsod ni khu lu'i 'jam tshad dang / spus tshad/ ljid tshad sogs kyi thad nas bshad na/ khu lu gzhan las 'jam zhing mnyen pa/ yang ba sogs kyi khyad chos ldan no/ /5 gtsod kyi khu lu'i ske dkris nub phyogs kyi mi drag dang rgyal po tshang gi spyod rdzas su ji ltar gyur ba yin/lan/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i nang du hpha ran si'i rgyal bo na pho lon gyis lcam jo se hphin zhes par ske dkris gcig gnang ba dang / kho mo der ha cang dga' bo byung ste/rjes su kha che'i yul nas ske dkris bzhi brgya tsam mngags nyo byas pa/ dus de tsam nas bzung ste khu lu'i ske dkris de nub phyogs kyi mi drag dang rgyal bo tshang gi spyod rdzas su 'gyur 'go tshugs yod pa red//26

6 gtsod gnas yul gyi sa cha gtso bo gang dag rgyal khab rim pa'i rang byung srung skyob sa khul du gtan 'khel gnang yod pa red/lan/ rang rgyal shin cang sa khongs kyi ri bo er cin dang / mtsho sngon khongs gtogs kyi a chen gangs rgyab/ bod ljongs kyi byang thang bcas kyi sa khul yin/te spyir gtsod kye gzugs po'i mtho tshad dang / mgo mjug ring tshad la li smi ci tsam yod/lan/ spyir gtsod kyi gzugs po'i mtho tshad la li — 65—80 dang / mgo mjug gi ring tshad la li smi120—140tsam yod/ gug po'i ring tshad la li smi55—80tsam yod/8 gtsod kyi grangs 'bor skor la sa gnas kye 'brog pa dang rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod las tshan gyis sdom rtsis byas pa ji 'dra yin/lan/ gtsod kyi grangs 'bor sa gnas 'brog pa kha shas kyes khri 10—15 yod pa ngos 'dzin byed pa dang / rgyal khab kyi 'brel yod las tshan gyis sdom rtsis byas pa ni 206 lor gtsod grangs khri 15yod pa'o/ /9 rang srog blos btang nas gtsod srung skyob gnang mkhan gyi dpa' bo thog ma gang dag yin/lan/ mtsho sngon zhing chen 'bri stod rdzong gi rdzong u hru'u ci gzhon pa rgyas bzang bsod nams dar rgyas/ bod rang skyong ljongs nyi ma rdzong gi nags las nyen rtog pa nor bu g.yu rgyal lta bu ni rang srog blos btang nas gtsod srung skyob gnang mkhan gyi dpa' bo thog ma yin/10 gtsod rnams byang bskyod byed dgos don ci yin/lan/ byang mtha'i rtswa rigs pa phru gu btsa' skabs mkho ba'i 'tsho bcud yod pa dang / phru gu la gcan gzan gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i phyirwa ro//11 〈gtsod// ces pa'i slob tshan 'di rtsom stangs gang gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / de'i nang /27

don gtso bo gang dag yod/lan/ rtsom yig de ni lung drangs te gsal bshad byed pa las gzhan da rung grangs sa 'god pa'i gsal bshad byed thabs bkol yod/ de'i nang rtsom pa pos tshan rig gi yig cha dang gling sgrung /ngag rgyun sogs 'brel yod dpyad yig sna tshogs la brten nas gtsod kyi gnas yul dang 'tsho stangs kyi khyad chos/ grangs 'bor/ khu lu'i rin thang sogs ngo sprod byas rjes/ der srung skyob byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul btang yod/ mi dmangs shes rab rtsal gyis dge mtshan gsar du bskrun pa/1 〈mi dmangs shes rab rtsal gyis dge mtshan gsar tu bskrun pa〉/ zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 〈snyan ngag spyi don tshig rgyan rig pa'i lde mig〉 las bdamasapa dang / rtsom pa po bstan pa rgya mtsho (1909—1971) mdo smad rnga ba mdzod dge phyogs su 'khrungs/2 6ma yig de ji lta bu zhig red/lan/ mi dmangs kyi shes rab dang stobs shugs la bsngags brjod byed par bzhag nas bris pa'i don brjod pa gtsor byas pa'i lhug rtsom zhig yin/〈 〈mi dmangs shes rab rtsal gyis dge mtshan gsar du bskrun pa〉 zhes pa'i rtsom lus gang 'dra yin pa dang / rtsom hril bor khag du yod/lan/ rtsom lus bcad lhug spel ma yin la/ rtsom hril bor khag gnyis su dgar chog4 2 mi dmangs shes rab’’ zhes pa'i mi dmangs de gang la go dgos sam/lan/ skabs der yun cin mi dmangs la go dgos/5 yun cin rdzong gi rang byung bkod pa ji lta bu zhig yin//28

lan/ yun cin rdzong ni ri bo mang zhing brag ri mang ba/ gcong rong zab la rma klung drag tu 'bab pa yin/6 yun cin gyi mi dmangs kyis rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod byas nas rang byung gi gnod pa las ji ltar rgyal/lan/ kho tshos dka' ba khyad du bsad nas grwa sde'i brag gshags pa dang dpa' bo'i rkang zam btsugs te rma chu yur 'dren gyi ar las bskrun nas than skam las rnam par rgyal/7 rtsom yig de rtsom stangs gang gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / brjod bya'i snying bo gang yin/lan/ rtsom yig de ni bcad lhug spel ma'i rtsom lus dang ldan pa'i lhug rtsom zhig yin zhing / de'i brjod bya'i snying bo ni mi dmangs dang / spyi tshogs gsar ba/ gung khran tang bcas la bstod bsngags byas yod/mdo khams kong rtsed ra ba'i yul ljongs/1 〈mdo khams kong rtsed ra ba'i yul ljongs〉/ zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ljongs zhing lnga'i mnyam bsgrigs dge thon slob grwa'i slob deb 〈lta klog dang rtsom stangs〉〉 las bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po bkra thang bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ 1947 lor mdo khams spo 'bor sgang gi cha shas rgyal thang khul du sku 'khrungs pa yin/2 kong rtsed ra ba'am kong jo ra ba zhes pa'i ming ji ltar btags pa yin/lan/ yul de'i ming du kong rtsed ra ba'am kong jo ra ba zhes pa ni sngon rgya bza' bod du byon skabs/ yar lam sa der spro ba skyes te rtsed 'jor rol bas ming de ltar btags/3 kong rtsed ra ba bee rgyal nang nas stod rgya gar la tshong 'grul byed pa'i lam bu gal chen zhig yin la//29

skabs de'i tshong rdzas gtso bo ni gang dag yin/lan/ yar dbus su 'dren pa ni ja gtso bo yin pa dang / mar la khyer ba'i tshong zong la rgya gar dang bal bo nas drangs pa'i gos chen kying kheb sogs dang / 'brug pa'i 'bu ras dang snam bu/ de min mchod pa'i yo byad sogs yin/4 kong rtsed ra ba'i sde dpon che shos su yin/lan/ sa gnas de ga'i sde dpon mi drag che shos da zha lu zhal ngo zhes pa de yin/5 zha lu zhal ngo'i dbang gi khyab khongs dang / dpya khral ji ltar bsdu tshul/ de'i thog ma'i sdod yul/gnas spo byas tshul bcas ji 'dra yin/lan/ de'i dbang gis khyab pa'i sa khongs ni yag ra lha chen gong kha zhes pa nas 'jang glu dbyangs sgang yan chad yin pas/ lo ltar ke leb sgur gsum gyi khral bsdu ba dang khrims kyi khrun thag gcod kyin yod/ zha lu zhal ngo'i sdod gnas sngon spong rtsi rag mthil du yod/ rjes su spong rtsi rag 'du 'dzi che bas sun snang skyes te/ 'grim 'grul stabs bde min pa'i lung khug zha lu zhes pa'i khul du dpon khang bsgrun nas der gnas spo byas so/ /6 kong rtsed ra ba'i skyes pho mo'i gon pa gyon lugs ji 'dra yin/lan/ kong rtsed ra ba'i skyes pa tsho'i gyon chas bod khams phyogs dang 'dra bar stod gos ni phu thung zhing che ba 'bu ras sam ras dkar dang / dar khru sogs las grub pa/ phyu ba mchin mdog dmar smug gam phrug dmar po'i phyu ba/ mgo la dgun dus su tshe ring dbyar dus su rgya gar zhwa mo gyon pa/ lham shur rtsi dang / nam rgyun pags rigs sogs kyi gos gyon gyin yod/ bud med kyi chas su smad g.yogs snam mo zhes pa sul lteb mang po yod pa'i dkar po dang sngo nag gang rung / gzab mchor spras skabs kyi stod gos ni/ gos chen bkrag mdangs che ba dag gi thog tu stod thung phu med gos chen /30

gangs can bod kyi yig gzugs 'bri tshul gyi mdzes rtsal ji ltar byung ba/1 〈gangs can bod kyi yig gzugs 'bri tshul gyi mdzes rtsal ji ltar byung ba〉/ zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni1982lo'i 〈mtsho sngon slob gso// deb bzhi ba las bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po ni mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung (1910—1985) yin/2 〈gangs can bod kyi yig gzugs 'bri tshul gyi mdzes rtsal ji ltar byung ba// zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ de ni bod kyi yig gzugs 'bri tshul gyi mdzes rtsal ji ltar byung ba'i skor ngo sprod byas pa'i gsal bshad rtsom yig cig yin/3 bod kyi yig gzugs 'bri tshul la rnam pa du yod pa dang / gang dag yin/lan/ rnam pa gnyis yod/ rim gyis gzabs nas 'bri dgos pa'i gzab ma'i yi ge dang / de tsam gzab mi dgos shing mgyogs por bris chog pa'i gshar ma'i yi ge yin/ da lta gzab ma'i yi ge la dbu can dang / gshar ma'i yi ge la dbu med kyi yi ge zer ro//4 dbu can dang dbu med zer don gang yin/lan/ de ni yi ge la mgo 'dren yod pa dang med pa'i sgo nas btags pa yin/5 bod kyi yig gzugs 'di thog mar ji ltar byung ba red/lan/ thon mar bod rgyal srong btsan gyi sku ring la thon mis gsar bzo mdzad pa'i phyag bris ni sbal nag na la brgyangs pa dang 'dra zhing / de'i rjes yig mkhan mkhas pa du ma'i yig gzugs mi 'dra ba mang du byung yang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi dbu tshugs nas yun ring ma lon pa na/ khyung po g.yu khri 'bar zhes bya bas lo tsā ba chen po ska ba dpal brtseṭa luṭa kyi dbu chen yig gzugs dkyil 'khor /32

gyi cha tshad la dpe blangs nas cha chen cha chung du bgos te cha tshad thig khongs su 'bri ba'i srol phyes/6 da lta nga tshos spyod bzhin pa'i yig gzugs 'di su zhig gi phyag rgyun yin/lan/ khyung bo g.yu khri 'bar bya ba'i phyag rgyun yin/7 bod yig thog mar 'bri sbyong byed dus go rim ji 'dra zhig yin dgos/lan/ thog mar gsal byed sum cu nas dbyangs bzhi/ mgo 'dogs brtsegs gsum sogs la sbyong dgos shing / de nas rim bzhin dbu med kyi yig gzugs sbyong ba'i mgo 'dzugs dgos/8 dbu med kyi yig gzugs sbyong ba'i go rim ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ thog mar sug ring 'bri tshul sbyong dgos shing / de cung zad lobs pa na tshugs yig zer ba dbyebs gru bzhi can ji ltar 'bri tshul sbyong dgos/ de lobs nas bar bris zer ba yig gzugs cung zad zlum po byung na 'bri sla ba can sbyong dgos/ de legs par lobs pa na rgyugs yig gam 'khyug yig ji ltar 'bri tshul sbyong dgos pa yin no/ /9 dbu can gyi yig gzugs la thig khog tu drangs par khyad chos gang dag tshang /lan/ ring thung dang zheng tshad snyoms pa dang / mtho dma' tshad dang ldan pa/ ya yo kyag kyog mi shor ba ste yon tan gsum tshang /10 bod kyi yig gzugs rnams mdor dril na gang du 'du ba yin/lan/ bod yig la gzab chen dang gzab chung / 'bru chen/ 'bru chung / par bris/ rgyugs bris bcas drug la thams cad 'dus so/ /11 bod kyi yig gzugs kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs gtso bo ni gang yin/lan/ thig ris kyi khyad chos dang bzo lta'i thon nyams spyi khog gi rnam gzhag gshis sha'i snang brnyan sogs yin//3

12 thog mar yig gzugs sbyong skabs lus kyi 'dug tshul thad blang bya gang dag bton yod/lan/ lus gzur nas mi 'dug par drang thad du 'dug pa/ lus ha cang mi dgye ha cang mi sgur bar ran par 'dug pa/ cog tse brtan po mtho dma' tshad dang ldan pa la brten nas bri ba'i gzhi la 'bri dgos/13 yig gzugs sbyong skabs lag pa dang sgyu gu 'dzin stangs/ 'bri gzhi'i shog bu sogs la re ba ji 'dra 'dzin dgos/lan/ lag g.yas brkyangs bskums lhod gsum 'tsham zhing / lag pa'i spar khyim phug ron gyi sgo nga tshud cing lta bu'i bar stong bzhag pa'i sor mo mas ma gsum gyi bskums tshad ran par byed na phan zhing / smyu gu bzung ba'i skabs na cung zad bsnyal ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin dgos la/ mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi dam lhod ran pa dang / yig gzugs chung tshe sgyug kha nas tshon gang dang phyed tsam las mi ring ba bzung na legs/ yi ge bri gzhi de rang gi nu ma g.yas pa'i drang thad du'am dkyel krung gi skabs su pus mo'i steng du bzhag ste/ lus stod drang bor bsrangs te bris na bzang ngo/ /14 yig mkhan ’ zhes pa'i don ci yin pa dang / bod kyi yig mkhan gyi gces nor bzhi ci/lan/ yig mkhan zhes pa ni yi ge ba'am drung yig gi ming yig la/ 'dir yig gzugs mkhas pa la go dgos/ bod kyi yig mkhan gyi gces nor bzhi ni/ snag tsha dang snag bum/ shog bu/ smyu gu ste bzhi yin no/ /15 dbu med kyi yig gzugs la sna kha ci tsam yod pa dang / de las gzhan pa'i dbu med kyi yig gzugs gang dag yod/lan/ sug ring dang tshugs yig bar bris/ rgyugs yig gam 'khyug yig bcas bzhi yod la/ de las gzhan sug ring zlum bris dang sug ring dpe bris/ sug ring dkyus ma/ sug thung / 'bra tsha //)// sa ca

bcas kyi dbye ba mang ngo /16 bod kyi yi ge re re ni lhu lag gang dag gis grub pa yin/lan/ mgo rke/ dpung ba/ mchu/ spo/ rkang ba bcas drug gis grub/17 yig mkhan mkhas pa yin pa'i tshul gang gis shes thub/lan/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ gang dag yi ge 'bri ba bo/ snyom gtsang 'grig gsum ldan pa dang // legs mgyogs dag gsum drug tshang na// mkhas pa'i go sa thob pa yin zhes gsungs so//〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉 dang de'i rtsom pa po/1 〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉 zhes pa'i rtsom 'di gang nas bdams pa dang / de'i rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 1981 lo'i 〈sbrang char// deb gnyis pa las bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po ni rdo rje rin chen yin/2 〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉 zhes pa'i rtsom pa po su yin pa red/lan/ rtsom pa po ni gan su'u zhing chen yin lho khul du gtogs pa'i gtsos bstan 'dzin sde khrod du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas dbang brag dgon pa dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas (1801—1866) zhesapa de red/〈 〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉 yi ming gzhan la ci zer zhing / ji lta bu'i bstan bcos shig red/lan/ ming gzhan la 〈mdo smad chos 'byung)/ zer zhing / de ni yul mdo smad kyi chos dang srid kyi bya ba'i skor gsal ba'i lo rgyus chen mo zhig yin/4 〈deb ther rgya mtsho/) zhes pa rgyu mtshan gang la brten nas brtsams pa red/lan/ de ni khong gi bla ma rje dbal mang parnyi tas sa mdo'i rgyu mtshan shes mkhan dkon pas deb ther 'di lta bu zhig 'bri dgos gsungs pa dang mnyam du/ dga' ldan the bo sprul ba'i sku/ dpa' ris /3

sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma sogs gnas lnga rig pa'i mdzod du gyur pa du mas yang yang skul bar brten gzhung 'di rtsom pa'i 'gan 'khri lhur bzhes pa yin no/ /5 khong gis deb ther 'di rtsom par lo rgyus rig gzhung gang tsam la gsan cing gzigs pa yin/lan/ rtsom pa pos bka' chems/ chos 'byung / deb ther/ lo rgyus/ bstan rtsis/ 'khrungs rabs/rnam thar/ gdung rabs/ rgyal rabs/ gdan rabs/ rtogs brjod/ dkar chag rus mdzod sogs rnam grangs drug brgyar nye ba zhig gsan cing gzigs pa yin/6 〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉 zhes pa ni po ti gsum gyi bdag nyid can yin zer don ci/lan/ 〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉 zhes pa ni 〈yul mdo smad kyi ljongs su thub bstan rin po che ji ltar dar ba'i tshul gsal bar brjod pa deb ther rgya mtsho/) zhes bya ba dang / 〈deb ther rgya mtsho las chos sde chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi dkar chag gdan rabs kha skong dang bcas pa〉〉 〈deb ther rgya mtsho las kha gya tsho drug nas rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi bar gyi dgon sgrub sde phal che ba'i dkar chag tho tsam bkod pa/〉 bcas po ti gsum tsam yod pas so/ /7 〈deb ther rgya mtsho〉〉 zhes pa'i gzhung 'di ru yul mdo smad kyi gnas tshul gang dag bkod yod pa red/lan/ gzhung 'dir yul mdo smad kyi ljongs su bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib dang / chab srid dpal 'byor/ rig gnas slob gso/ tha na sa ming chu ming dang sa'i chags dbyibs sogs zhib byung rgyas pa bkod yod pa ma zad/ dgon sgrub sde'i gdan rabs dang lha rten chos gsum/ dpe mdzod gtsug lag grwa tshang 'dzin grwa btsun grangs mang nyung sogs bkod yod pa red/8 〈deb ther rgya mtsho// zhes pa'i gzhung 'di'i khyad chos ci/lan/ gzhung 'di'i brjod bya'i khungs btsun pa dang rjod byed kyi tshig go sla la/ brtsams pa'i /36
