dus skabs kyang cung 'phyi ba sogs lo rgyus kyi gzhung gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos du ma dang ldan no//9 gzhung 'di'i ma dpar la chag 'jig gi nyen kha ci zhig byung /lan/ 〈deb ther rgya mtsho// zhes pa'i gzhung 'di'i ma dpe ni a mchog dgon dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du bzhugs kyang / dpar brkos nas ma 'gyangs par ma pu hphang jag dmag gis mer bsregs pas/ dpar du thebs pa'i tshar grangs kyang nyi shu tsam las mi 'da' zhing dkon pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin/gna' rabs rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi bang mdzod tun hong /1 〈gna' rabs rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi bad mdzod tun hong〉/ zhes pa'i dpe khungs dang rtsom pa po gang yin//lan/ rtsom 'di ni1981lo'i 〈zang char〉 deb dang bo las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni khrin chin dbyin dang don grub rgyal gnyis yin/2 〈gna' rabs rig gnas sgyu rtsal gyi bang mdzod tun hong/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs thad kyi khyad chosaci yin/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ni yul skor zin tho'i rtsom stangs su gtogs shing / rtsom pa po tun hong brag phug la lta skor du skyod pa'i dus kyi snga gzhug dang lta skor byas pa'i gnas kyi go rim ltar bris yod pa ma zad/ zhib 'bri dang dpyad brjod bcas kyi 'bri stangs sbrags mar spyad yod pas gtso gnad gsal zhing gnad phigs pa sogs kyi khyad chos du ma ldan no//3 mo ko khu'u brag phug de sa gang na yod pa dang / de rgyal rabs gang dag brgyud nas 'phro rim 'phro bzo bskrun byas pa red//37

lan/ gan su'u zhing chen tun hong rdzong gi shar phyogs su yod la/ de ni cin rgyal rabs shar ma'i can yon gyi skabs su btsun pa yo tsun bya bas thog mar bskrun la/ we rgyal rabs byang ma dang / we rgyal rabs nub ma/ kro'u rgyal rabs byang ma/ su'e rgyal rabs/ thang rgyal rabs/ sung rgyal rabs/ mi nyag dang yon rgyal rabs bcas brgyud nas 'phro rim 'phro bzo bskrun byas/4bod kyis tun hong dbang bsgyur ba'i dus yun dang lo tshigs shes sam/lan/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus mjug nas dus rabs dgu ba'i dus dkyil la thug pa'i bar tu spyi lo781—848 lo'i bar gyi lo ngo drug cu re bdun gyi ring la dbang bsgyur ba red/5 tun tong brag phug gi grangs tshad dang de dag las bod yig yod pa'i brag phug gang dag yin/lan/ tun hong mo ko khu'u la brag phug bsdoms pas 492 yod la/ slob tshan 'dir 'god pa ltar na brag phug sang365ba dang ang17par bod yig yod pa'o/ /6 brag phug 'di dag dus nam zhig mi su zhig gis phyi ru bton pa yin/lan/ man ju'i rgyal rabs kyi khri lo nyer drug pa (spyi lo 1900) zla lnga ba'i tshes nyer drug nyin rgya nag btsun la wang yon lu'u bya bas brag phug ang 17 pa'i nang gi bye ma 'phyag skabs glo bur du logs shig na gyang srubs phye ba mthong zhing zhib tu bltas tshe 'dam sbyar gyi sgo yin pa shes/7 brag phug de dag gi nang du rig rdzas kyi rnam pa dang nang don/ yig rigs bcas kyi sgo nas dbye na gang dag yod pa red/lan/ chos lugs kye dpe cha dang / yig rigs/ lha sku/ thang ga chos lug yo byad/ we rgyal rabs byang ma nas sung rgyal rabs bar gyi chos lugs dang / mtshan nyid rig pa/ rig gnas/ sgyu rtsal/ lo rgyus sogs dang / legs sbyar gyi yi ge dang / bod yig rgya yig gru gu dang li yul gyi yi ge sogs yig rigs mi 'dra ba brgyad yod par bshad//38

8 tun hong gter yig la thog mar dpyad pa gnang mkhan gyi bod kyi mkhas pa dang / gter yig gang las byung /lan/ gter yig ni brag phug ang bcu bdun pa las byung ba yin la/ de thog mar zhib 'jug gnang mkhan ni bod kyi mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel yin/9 ci zhig la yul skor zin tho zer/lan/ yul skor zin tho zhes pa ni gnas gang yang rung ba zhig la rang nyid kyis dngos su lta skor byas pa las byung ba'i mthong thos kyi rnam pa bris nas/ rang la des myong tshor ci 'dra byin pa ji bzhin du bris pa zhig yin/10 yul skor zin tho'i grub rkyen gtso bo gsum po gang yin/lan/ gnas rten dang ljongs rnam/ tshor snang bcas yin/rgya bod mthun lam gyi lo rgyus dpang rtags/1 rtsom khungs dang rtsom pa po gang yin/lan/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpetshogs 〈kha ba'i rnam shes〉 las bdams/ rtsom pa po ni 'phrin las chos grags yin/2 〈rgya bod mthun lam gyi lo rgyus dpang rtags〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs khyad chos ji 'dra yin/lan/ yul skor zin tho ltar brtsams shing / rtsom pa pos gnas skyod kyi go rim gzhir bzung nas yul ljongs kyi rnam pa nas dpal zha lu gser khang gi phyi'i bkod pa sogs ngo sprod gnang yod/3 dpal zha lu gser khang ni gnas gang du yod/lan/ bod ljongs gzhis rtse sa khul gzhis rtse rdzong khongs su gnas shing / bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus mgor btab pa'idagon rnying grags can zhig yin//39

4 dpal zha lu gser khang zhes pa'i ming de ji ltar thogs/lan/ zha lu gser khang ni lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis rang gi bla ma lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi drung du song nas bla ma'i mda' bsnyeg par gnas gzhi zhwa lu tsam zhig brtsig par zhu bar gnang thob ste bzhengs pa yin la/ zha lu gser khang ni 'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas ming thoṭa pa red/5 〈rgya bod mthun lam gyi lo rgyus dpang rtags)/ zhes pa'i mtshon don shes sam/lan/ dpal zha lu gser khang la chus 'jigs pa byung rjes rgya yul nas bzo bo mkhas pa mi nyung ba 'byor te nyams gso byas pa yin/ de las rgya bod mi rigs bar gyi mdza' mthun gyi 'brel ba mtshon zhing / gtsug lag khang gi dbu rtser g.yu rtsi sngon po'i rgya phibs kha sprod du brgyan pa dang / rgya phibs 'dabs ne pad ga gtsang khang dbus ma'i sgo'i dbyings dang mdun gyis sum skas bcas bzo skrun gyi bkod pa'i cha nas rgya nag gi dgon pa dang lha khang gi khyad chos ldan pas so/ /6 rtsom yig 'di'i nang du dpal zha lu dgon pa ji ltar ngo sprod gnang yod/lan/ chags yul gyi bkod pa dang bzo skrun gyi sgyu rtsal/ rten gtso bo/ rdo gzhong gi 'byung khungs/de'i 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul bcas ngo sprod gnang yod/sprin/1 sprin zhes pa'i slob tshan du sprin phyi'i rnam pa gang dag bris yod/lan/ sprin gyi rnam pa dang nyams 'gyur/ bzo lta sogs bris yod/ 2 sprin gyi 'gyur sdog ji ltar mtshon yod/lan/ sprin brkyang ba'i skabs dang dril ba'i skabs kyi rnam pa gnyis bsdur nas brjod yod/2 sprin gyi byed nus mtshon pa'i tshig re gnyis brjod thub bam//4(

lan/ pa mi dbul phyug med par dgos 'dod ster’’ ba dang / pa sa ri klung med par rtsi bcud 'gugs pa’’ sogs kyi tshig bkod yod/( sprin gyi yon tan ston pa'i tshig gang 'dra bkod yod/lan/ ma 'brog thams cad mar khu'i rgya mtshor btang // 'brog mi'i rgyal ba mar gyis bkang / /rong thams cad 'bru sna'i thang mar brdal// ’’ sogs bkod yod/5 sprin gyi khyad chos de gang gi dpe ru bkod yod/lan/ ( lha rdzas’ dang paras bal ’ sogs kyi dpe ru bkod yod/( sprin zhes pa'i snyan ngag 'di'i brjod snying gang yin//lan/ rtsom pa pos sprin gyi mdzes pa'i rnam pa dang / 'gyur sdog byed nus dang yon tan sogs bris nas/ des rang 'brog kun la 'tsho ba gsar ba'i longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i bstod bsngags gnang yod/rnga chen rol dbyangs/1 rtsom khungs dang rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus byos/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ni 1992 lo'i 〈gangs rgyan me tog〉 las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni (1933—2004) lor mtsho sngon kro tshang sa char skyes pa'i bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag pa yid dam tshe ring yin/ rtsom yig 'di thog mar rtsom pa pos rgya yig gis bris shing / dbyangs can sgeg pa'i blo kros kyis bod yig tu bsgyur ba yin/ 2 (rnga chen rol dbyangs〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ji lta bu zhig yin/lan/ de ni yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i snyan ngag cig red/3 snyan ngag 'di brtsams pa'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs gang yin//41

bstod pa bklags pa'i 'char snang /1 〈bstod pa bklags pa'i 'char snang// zhes pa'i rtsom khungs dang rtsom pa po gang yin/lan/ rtsom pa po ni drag btsan rang krol yin la 1984lo'i sbrang char// deb dang po las bdams pa yin/2 'di'i rtsom stangs khyad chos gtso bo gang red/lan/ tshigs bcad kyi lam nas bris pa'i dgag sgrub rtsom yig cig yin la/ dpe 'jog pa dang gzugs su 'god pa sogs kyi sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon thabs la brten nas brjod don gzugs snang yod pa'i sgo nas mtshon par byas yod/3 rtsom rig sgeg mo'i mgul rgyan du// bcos ma'i me tog nyer phul kyang / /dpyod ldan rkang drug gsar ba'i khyus/ / sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston ji ltar myong // zhes pa don ci yin/lan/ rtsom rig sgeg mo'i gzugs su bkod pa dang / de'i mgul rgyan la me tog bcos ma byin kyang / dpyod ldan rnams rkang drug gi gzugs su bkod nas/ rkang drug gis sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston myong mi thub ces bstod rtsom bcos ma'i nang du shes bya khyad par ba len rgyu med pa bstan/bod kyi skad yig sgor gleng ba/1bod kyi skad yig skor gleng ba zhes pa'i rtsom khungs dang rtsom pa po gang yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 〈bod rig pa'i byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur skor mdo tsam gleng ba〉/ zhes pa las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni 1927 lor khams mi nyag mgar thang du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal red/ 2 〈bod kyi skad yig skor gleng ba/) zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ de ni bod kyi skad yig gi 'phel rgyas kyi thabs lam gsal bor bris pa'i dgag sgrub rtsom 143

yig cig red/3 bod kyi yi ge byung ba'i 'dod tshul rigs gnyis yod pa ni/lan/ bod kyi lo rgyus phal mo che dang 〈thang yig gsar rnying// sogs su srong btsan sgam po'i skabs la thon mis gsar du brtsams par 'dod pa dang / bshad tshul gzhan zhig ni srong btsan gong rol la bon gyi yi ge yod par bshad/4mi rigs gang yin rung de'i srog rtsa ni ci yin pa red/lan/ skad dang yi ge gnyis yin/5 mi rigs gang de'i yi ge bzang ngan gyi khyad par ni ci ltar dbye dgos/lan/ de ma yi ge'i lo rgyus kyi rgyun ring thung la bltas pa ma yin par/ yi ge de mi rigs de'i phal skad dang mthun che ba/ slob bde ba dang khyab rgya che ba/ ming tshig gis 'dang tshad che ba/ tshig sbyor gyis don tan tig ston thub pa sogs kyi khyad chos dang ldan tshe yi ge de sngon thon gyi yi ger brtsi ba red/rdza ri'i chu phran/1rtsom pa po dang rtsom khungs gang yin//lan/ rdza ri'i chu phran zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'di ni bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈kha ba'i rnam shes〉/ zhes pa nas bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni sgom pa bkra shis yin/2 〈rdza ri'i chu phran/〉 zhes pa ru nang don ci zhig mtshon yod/lan/ rtsom pa pos rdza ri'i chu phran ’ nas mtshon bya'i don snying gangs ljongs mi dmangs kyi steng du 'phos nas/ mes rgyal deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun la bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rang gi blo kros dang stobs shugs yod tshad 'bul bzhin par bsngags brjod gnang yod/2 〈rdza ri'i chu phran// kyi rtsom stangs khyad chos gang 'dra yin/144

lan/ rtsom lus bcad lhug spel mar sbyad cing / 'char yan gyi 'bri thabs spel te/ brjod bya gting zab la brjod tshul mdzes par byas nas brtse dung shugs drag tu mtshon par byas yod/sa skya paṇḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan/1 rtsom khungs dang rtsom pa po ngo sprod byos/ lan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes pa'i slob tshan 'di'i rtsom pa po ni dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las yin la/ 〈deb thar dmar po// las bdams/2 〈sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'di ni ji lta bu zhig red/lan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta'i lo rgyus ngo sprod byed pa'i rnam thar rang bzhin gyi rtsom yig byug yin/3 sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan ngo sprod mdor bsdus byos/lan/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni spyi lo 1182 lor yab sa skya'i dpal chen 'od po che dang /yum ma gcig gar phu ma nyi khri lcam gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ chung dus kyi mtshan la dpal ldan don grub zhu zhing / khu bo rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan la kun dga' rgyal mtshan du gsol/ khong gis chung dus nas bzung bla ma ris med du bsten nas rig gnas spyi dang sgos su mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang bor sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i grags pa sa steng du khyab/ spyi lo 12༅ lor yon rgyal rabs kyi rgyal bo go dan gyis gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar hor rgyal bo'i rgyal sa ling cu rtser phebs shing chos srid kyi bya ba mang bo mdzad/ mthar dgung lo bdun cu ba spyi lo1251 lor lang gru sprul ba'i sder sku gshegs/4 sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i gsung rtsom la pod du yod pa dang / de dag las grags che ba gang yod/lan/ pod gsum yod pa dang / de las grags che ba ni 〈thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal /43

ba'i bstan bcos〉/ dang 〈legs bshad rin po che'i gter〉/ 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos//〈mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo〉 〈sgra la 'jug pa// 〈tshig gi gter/〉 〈tshad ma rigs gter〉/la sogs pa yin/5 sa paṇa gyis rgyal bo go dan mdzes nad las krol bar byas pas/ rgyal bos dmigs bsal gyi thob thang ci zhig gnang /lan/ sangs rgyas chos lugs pa'i grwa ba rnams chos lugs gzhan dag gi bla ma tsho'i gral mgor sdod chog pa'i dmigs bsal gyi thob thang gnang /6 sa paṇa khong nyid hor yul nas bod yul du bka' yig cig btang ba'i ming la ci zer ba dang /nang don ji 'dra red/lan/ de ni bod kyi bla ma dang dge bshes mkhas pa tshos sa paṇa khong nyid phyir bod yul du phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba gnang ba'i bka' lan du 〈dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yon mchod rnams la springs pa/) zer ba'i bka' yig cig gnang / de'i nang don ni go dan rgyal bos khong rnam par thugs 'dogs che tshul dang chos la dad pa yod tshul/ de'i khrims 'khur dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang bo bris shing bod hor gyi mnga' 'og tu 'du dgos pa'i bsam pa bstan/chu dang skar ma ṛ ṣi/1 rtsom khungs ngo sprod byos/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ni 1982 lo'i 〈sbrang char// deb dang po las bdams shing bod ljongs sman rtsis khang gis bsgrigs/2 〈chu dang skar ma ṛ ṣi〉/ zhes pa'i slob tshan du chu'i ngo bo'i sgo nas brjod na//46

lan/ yang ba/ dwangs pa/ 'jam pa/ zhim pa/ dri mi nga ba bcas kyi rang bzhin ldan pa ma zad/rlan 'dzin pa dang skom pa sel ba/ tsha gdung sel ba bcas kyi nus pa ldan pa red/3 chu la rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs sgo nas dbye tshul gnyis yod pa ni gang yin/lan/ yul gyi khyad pa dang / dus kyi khyad par gnyis yin/4 yul dus gang nas byung ba'i chu ni chu ngan yin/lan/ dang po yul nas brjod na/ rlan gsher che ba'i yul dang / ba tshwa can gyi yul/ 'dam rdzab can gyi yul/ dug shing nags tshal can gyi yul/ nyi 'od dang rlung gis reg pa chung ba'i yul bcas kyi skyes chu'i rigs la chu ngan zer/ gnyis pa dus kyi cha nas brjod na/ de yang dpyid sa slebs tshe/dgun dus bsags pa'i mkhar rdul mi gtsang ba rnams dpyid dang sos sha'i drod rlung ches cher ldang bas sa rlung 'phel ba dang / sa rlangs dang mtsho rlangs bar snang du 'phyur ba'i kha char babs pas rdul rlung mi gtsang ba rnams sa steng gi chu nang du 'dres pa'i rkyen gyis skyes chu lci ba dang rtsub pa/dri cung zad nga ba/ bskol na lbu ba che ba/ btung na pho bar gnod pa/ brgal na lus la gzan pa bcas kyi zhan cha yod pas dpyid chu ngan zer pa yin no/ gnyis pa dus kyi cha nas brjod na/pa dpyid chu ngan dang / ston chu bzang zer ba ltar/ 〉’ dgun dpyid gnyis la bsags pa'i mkha' rlung mi gtsang ba'i rigs tshang ma dbyar gyi dus su nyi 'od dang rlung / char chu'i stobs kyis yang yang zhi bar sbyangs rjes/ ston dus mkha' rlung rim bzhin gtsang bas char chu dang skyes chu dwangs la yang ba/ bskol na wu ba med pa/ btung na pho bar mi gnod pa bcas kyi yon tan ldan pas ston chu bzang zer ba yin no/ /5 yul dus gang nas byung ba'i chu la chu bzang zer lan/ dang po yul nas brjod na/ sa gzhi gtsang la nyi 'od legs par 'phog pa'i skyes chu'i /47

rigs la chu bzang zer/ gnyis pa dus kyi cha nas brjod na/6 skar ma ṛ ṣi skabs chu bzang zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ skar ma 'di nyid shar ba'i dus skabs ston zla 'bring po yin pas/ ston zla 'bring ba'i ston chu bzang zer ba ste/ dus kyi sgo nas ngos bzung ste chu bzang zer ba las skar ma ṛ ṣi rang la nus pa gang yang med par bshad pa ni tshan rig gi 'dod tshul dang yongs su mthun no//bdag gi gzhon nu'i lo rabs/1 〈bdag gi gzhon nu'i lo rabs〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig dang rtsom pa po gang red/lan/ rtsom yig de ni 〈mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur// las bdams shing / rtsom 'di phyogs sgrig mdzad pa po gtsang myang stod stag tshal du sku 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan can (1452—1507) zhu ba de yin/2 rnal 'byor ba rus pa'i rgyan can gyi mtshan dngos la ci zer zhing / ming de ji ltar btags/lan/ mtshan dngos la sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zer zhing / gtsang spyon teḥru ku dang rus pa'i rgyan can sogs kyi ming khong gis bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sngags kyi gdams pa bslabs te heḥru ku'i cha byad rus rgyan dang thod pa/ rkang gling / kha ṭā rnams 'chang zhing dur khrod sogs gnas nges med du tho co'i spyod pa mi'i blor mi shong ba sna tshogs mdzad pas btags pa 'dra snyam//48

〈 〈bdag gi gzhon nu'i lo rabs〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ji lta bu zhig red/lan/ de ni mi la ras pa ste thos pa dgas dka' spyad snyeng rus kyis a ma'i re ba ltar mthu sbyangs te khong ma smad gsum sdug la spyor mkhan dag la 'khon lan bslogs pa'i gnas tshul bkod pa'i phyir dran rang bzhin gyi gtam rgyud cig red/4mi la ras pa ma smad gsum la sdug po gtong mkhan su yin pa dang / des ci zhig mtshon/lan/ a khu dang a ne gnyis yin/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs su btsan pos gnyom chung dang phyug pos dbul bo la brnyas bcos byed pa dang / rgyu nor dang dbang shugs kyis bden lugs kyi tshab byed pa'i tshul min lugs 'gal gyi gnas tshul brjod yod/5 ma myang tsha dkar rgyan gyis mi la ras par bskur ba'i gab yig de'i nang don ji 'dra yin/lan/ ( lung ba kha byang du lta ba nyi ma ma 'char ’ zhes pa ni rnal 'byor ba'i bem po'i nang la nyi ma mi 'char ba dang / ra skar ma smin drug 'char ba’’ zhes pas skud pa dkar pos hab btsems byas pa dang / nye tshan krong ba bdun po zer ba ni gser srang bdun po bstan pa yin/6 mi la ras par mthu gnang ba'i slob dpon ni su yin/lan/ bla ma gnubs chung ba yin/yang sprul de nyid gsal byed/1 〈yang sprul de nyid gsal byed/〉 ces pa'i rtsom yig de gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom yig de ni 〈bslab bya gces bsdus// las bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po ni gung thang sku phreng gsum pa/ gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me yin/2 〈yang sprul de nyid gsal byed〉/ ces pa'i rtsom yig de ji 'dra zhig yin//49

lan/ de ni mi kha shas kyis rang nyid kyi khe grags gtam gsum don du gnyer phyir gang byung du sprul sku ngos 'dzin byas te mir mgo bskor gtong ba'i bya spyod la zur za byed pa'i dgag sgrub rtsom yig cig yin/〈 〈yang sprul de nyid gas la byed〉/ ces pa'i rtsom yig tu gang byung du sprul skur ngos 'dzin byas te mir mgor bskor gtong ba'i bya spyod de gtam rgyud gang dang sbyar ba red/lan/ 〈mi ro rtse sgrung〉/ las shing bzo kun dga'i ’ lo rgyus dang sbyar yod/4 shing bzo kun dga'i’ lo rgyus de ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ sngon shing bzo kun dga' dang lha bzo kun dga' zer ba gnyis yod pa nang ma mthun pas/ lha bzo kun dgas cig shos gsod par 'dod nas yi ge rdzun ma btang ba rgyal po kun skyong gis gzigs nas de bzhin byas/ shing bzo kun dgas rang gi blo gros la brten nas lha yul la song nas phyir rang yul du 'bod pa'i yi ge rdzun ma zhig rgyal por byin/ rgyal pos sngon lugs ltar byas pas lha bzo kun dga' mes bsregs par byas pa'i lo rgyus de yin/5 lha bzo kun dga' ‘lha yul du 'gro bar khas blangs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ shing bzo kun dga' lha yul nas phyir yong rjes rgyal pos rgyu nor mang po gnang ba de lha bzo kun dga' yis mthong nas/ rgyu nor la ham pa langs te lha yul du 'gro bar khas blangs/6 lha bzo kun dga' nor la sred pas lha yul du 'gro bar khas blangs pa'i dpe des mtshon don ci/lan/ da lta 'byor ba cung zad yod pa'i grwa rigs la bla ma'i ming btags tshad las 'das pa dang / rang gi nye du'am sbyin bdag lta bu re ltos byed sa rer 'khrungs so zhes rdzun btab ste snga ma'i nor rdzas blos ma thongs pa'i steng du skye ba brgyud nas gsog 'dod skyes pa de mtshon/7 lha bzo kun dga' bud shing brtsegs pa 'bar nas mes bsregs pa de brgyud nas don ci zhig 30

bshad yod/lan/ gzhan la 'tshe ba'i le lan rang la 'khor ba gsal bshad byas yod/8 lha bzo sreg dus kye rol mo'i sgra de la sbyar nas gnas lugs ci zhig gsal bshad byas yod/lan/ skye shi'i 'phrang la slebs pa'i tshe phan rgyu med la gnod tshabs che ba'i gdung rdzogs kyi chab chob mang bo'i sgra bee lha bzo sreg dus kyi rol mo rdung ba lta bu la sbyar ro/9 shing bzo kun dga' lha yul du mi sdod par phyir mi yul du yong ba'i don ci/lan/ shing bzo kun dgas bu smad gso dgos zhes mi yul du yong ba yin la/ des rang dbang du skyes pa len pa'i nus pa yod na/ bstan pa la phan pa bsgrub dgos pa'i gnas lugs bstan yod/10 shing bzo kun dga' lha yul la 'gro khar sa 'og tu 'dzul ba'i dpe don ci zhig gsal bshad byas/lan/ mi tshe sdig la bskyal na dag zhing du 'gro 'dod kyang mgo thur du bstan nas mar ngan song du 'akro dgos pa'i bzlog med kyi chos nyid de bstan yod/11 rang blo rang la lkog gyur du ma song ba shes bzhin du gzhan gyi g.yo sgyur yid 'khrul nas las de'i dbang du 'phro bar byed cing / rnam shes rnal du mi gnas pa der dpe ci sbyar yod/ don ci bstan yod/lan/ dpe spyon pa la sbyar yod la/ des bya ba'i 'jug ldog gi gnas la 'khrul nas rang sdug rang gis nyo ba de bstan yod/12 〈yang sprul de nyid gsal byed〉/ ces pa'i rtsom gyi bsgrub bya ci yin nam/ bsgrub bya de sgrub par sgrub thabs ci zhig bkol yod/lan/ rtsom 'di'i bsgrub bya gtso bo ni yang sprul ’ gyi skog gyur gnad don de nyid gsal bar /3/

byed pa ste/ bla ma dang skyes bu dam pa'i ming re bzung ste gdeng ci yang med par dkor rdzas 'ba' zhig bsags nas phyir skyes te/ longs su spyod par byed pa'i 'dang byed pa rnams ni shing bzo kun dga'i lo rgyus dang 'dra bar sgrub pa'o/ / de yang dpe la brten nas rigs bsgres pa'i thabs kyis skog gyur gyi gnas lugs de nyid gsal bshad byed thabs spyad yod/12 〈yang sprul de nyid gsal byed// ces pa rtsom gyi brjod bya ci/lan/ mi kha shas kyis rang nyid kyi khe grags gtam gsum don du gnyer phyir gang byung du sprul sku ngos 'dzin byas nas mir mgo skor gtong ba'i bya spyod la zur za dang sun 'byen byas yod/14 〈yang sprul de nyid gsal byed〉/ ces pa'i rtsom stangs thad khyad chos ji 'dra yod/lan/ rigs 'gre'i thabs dang dbye zhib byed pa'i thabs sbyad nas gnas lugs gsal bshad byed pa dang / rtsom lus bcad lhug spel mar bcings shing bye brag gi gnad don la dbye zhib byas pa phra zhing zhib pa/ gzhan lugs dgag cing rang lugs 'thad ldan du bsgrubs yod pas brjod don rtogs sla ba/ go bskon blo 'gug gi nus pa ldan pa sogs khyad chos mang ngo / /bod kyi skad yig gi 'phel rgyas skor gleng ba/1 〈bod kyi skad yig gi 'phel rgyas skor gleng ba// zhes pa de gang nas gdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom yig de ni 〈bod rig pa'i byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur skor mdo tsam bshad pa〉/ las bdams/ rtsom pa po nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal yin/2 〈bod kyi skad yig gi 'phel rgyas skor gleng ba〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs ji 'dra yin/lan/ de rang lugs gtso sgrub byas pa'i dgag sgrub rtsom yig cig yin/3 rtsom yig 'di'i gleng bya gtso bo ci yin pa dang / rtsom pa po'i rang lugs sam lta ba gtso bo ci/13 —

lan/ bod kyi skad yig ni gleng bya gtso bo dang / bod kyi skad yig rjes lus mi thebs pa'am 'phel med rang sor mi gnas pa'i ched du mdun du bskyod par 'bad pa byed dgos pa ni rang lugs sam lta ba yin/4 rtsom pa pos bod kyi bod kyi skad yig gong 'phel du gtong bar lta tshul ji 'dra bton yod/lan/ spyi tshogs gsar ba gsar rkyang du gyur yod pas tshan rig la brten te spyi tshogs yar rgyas su gtong ba las thabs lam gzhan med par gyur zin pa dang / bod kyi na gzhon khag cig skyed sring byas te deng rabs tshan rig dang rig gnas yod tshad bod yig gi lam nas sbyong dgos pa de yin/5 bod kyi skad yig slob pa dang mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig slob pa la rtsom pa pos lta tshul ji 'dra bton yod/lan/ thog mar bod kyi skad dang yi ge gnyis po mthar phyin pa dang byang chub pa zhig bslabs rjes/da gzod mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig sbyangs nas sngon thon mi rigs kye legs cha de dag bod kyi dus rabs kyi dgos mkhor skong dgos pa de yin/6 bod kyi skad yig de sngon thon skad yig gi rjes zin thub par byed pa'i gom pa dang po ci yin pa bstan/lan/ slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum gyi bod yig slob deb bsgrigs pa dang / slob grwa khag gi nang du bod skad kyi thog nas slob rgyu'i las don de yin/7 rtsom pa pos bod kyi skad yig yar rgyas su gtong ba'i bya rim khrod bsgrub dgos pa'i gnad don dang / blang bya/ thabs lam sogs bye brag gi kros gzhi khag lnga bton yod pa ci/lan/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa zhig byed pa dang / sngon thon mi rigs kyi legs cha blangs te rang gi rig gnas la bcud ster ba/ slob grwa khag la dus rabs dang /5—

mthun pa'i slob deb cha tshang zhig dgos pa la bod skad kyi thog nas slob khrid byed thub pa'i dge rgan dpung khag cig dgos pa/ mi rigs spyi'i mdun lam sems dgos pa/ tshan rig rig gnas kyi shes bya mang po bod yig tu bsgyur dgos pa dang gsar byung gi dngos po la tha snyad gsar ba sbyor dgos pa bcas khag lnga bton yod/da bod kyi skad yig skyob pa'i thabs lam nyag cig phyogs bsdus kyitshul du bstan yod pa ci/lan/ mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig gi legs cha mtha' dag blangs nas bod rang gi skad yig tu bsgyur rgyu de yin pa bstan yod/9 〈bod kyi skad yig gi 'phel rgyas skor gleng ba〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs dang brjod don ci 'dra yin/lan/ rtsom yig 'dir dpe 'god pa dang gshib bsdur byed pa/ rigs dgar ba'i sgrub thabs bcas la brten nas/ bod kyi skad yig 'phel rgyas su gtong dgos pa'i skor gyi gnad don bton yod par ma zad/ gnad don de dag ji ltar thag gcod dgos pa'i skor gyi thabs lam bstan yod/gtsug g.yu/1 〈gtsug g.yu〉〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de sus bris pa yin la/ don ci zhig bris yod/lan/ rtsom pa po — 1941 lor lha sar 'khrungs pa'i sku zhabs glang mdun dpal 'byor yin/ rtsom yig de ni gtsug g.yu'i byung tshul nas mthar jo bor phul ba'i gnas tshul bris yod pa'i sgrung gtam zhig yin/2 〈gtsug g.yu〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs la khyad chos ji 'dra yod/lan/ sgrig gzhi tshig dam zhing 'tsho ba'i rang bzhin dang mthun la/ mi sna gsar bzhengs byas pa gson nyams ldan pa/ mi sna'i gtam gleng la brten nas don gyi byung rim gsal brjod byas pa/ rjod 4

tshig kha gsal zhing go bde ba/ rjod tshig spyi skad la gzhol ba sogs kyi khyad chos yod/〈 〈gtsug g.yu〉/ zhes pa'i brjod snying gang yin/ lan/ rtsom pa pos gtsug g.yu bris pa brgyud nas mun nag spyi tshogs kyi 'dod rngam dang gdug rtsub che ba'i dpon ngan la sun 'byin drag po byas yod la/ nyam thag ngal rtsol mi dmangs la dung sems bcangs yod/4 sgrung gtam 'dir mi sna gang dag yod pa dang / mi sna gtso bo'i rang bzhin ji 'dra zhig yin pa bstan/lan/ mi sna gtso bo ni phun tshogs dang dpal ldan yin la/ gzhan bu mo bde skyid dang spo bo/ rmo bo/sru mo/ sku ngo rdzong / a pha bkra shis sogs yod/ de las mi sna gtso bo phun tshogs ni dkon mchog la dad pa che zhing rang bzhin drang zhing brtan tshugs che ba/ snying rje ldan zhing sdug bsngal bzod bsran thub pa/ bu dang chung mar brtse dung che ba zhig yin la/ dpal ldan ni dgra la 'khon 'dzin che zhing la snying stobs ldan pa/ rgyu 'bras rtsi ba/ byams sems ldan zhing gus bkur yod pa can zhig yin/gnas bstod dbyangs can sgeg mo'i glu dbyangs/1 rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus byed thub bam/lan/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo tshe tan zhabs drung ngam rje 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo kros ni rab byung bco lnga ba'i lcags khyi (spyi lo 1910) lor mtsho sngon zhing chen zhun hwa rdzong du sku 'khrungs la/ dam pa 'di'i sku tshe hring bor tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gzhir bzung nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya che ba mdzad pas snyan ngag dang rnam thar/ rtogs brjod sogs gzhung po ti brgyad lhag brtsams shing /skal ldan gyi bu slob mang du bskyangs/ rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing glang spyi lo 1985lo'i zla drug par bla brang du dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan/3

2 rtsom 'di'i kha byang la 'grel ba byed thub bam/lan/ gnas bstod sa gnas lan kru krong dang de'i lte bar gnas pa'i nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo la rtsom pa pos bstod pa'i lam nas brtsams pa'i snyan rtsom zhig go/dbyangs can sgeg mo'i glu dbyangs tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs pa'i lam nas brtsams pa ni lha mo dbyangs can ma 'phyor sgeg gi nyams dang bcas te glu dbyangs len pa dang 'dra ba'i don/3 rtsom 'di'i brjod snying gsal bshad bya dgos/lan/ slob tshan 'di'i nang lan gru krong khyer gyi bkod pa spyi dang / lhag par nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob grwa'i khor yug dang / slob grwa'i nang gi rig gnas slob gnyer gyi cha rkyen sogs bris yod/ da dung dge slob yongs kyis rig pa'i gnas la sbyang ba lhod med byas nas spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs bskrun la 'bad pa bskyed bzhin pa'i rnam pa brjod yod/4 rtsom stangs kyi khyad chos ji 'dra yin nam/lan/ spyir rtsom pa po 'di nyid kyi brtsams chos bcad lhug spel ma gang yin rung snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs pas spras pa'i khyad chos du ma ldan pas/ gnas bstod 'di nyid kyang khong gis brjod byar gyur pa'i gnas gang zhig gi sgod kyi chags tshul dang bcud kyi rnam pa la rtog bzo ma yin pa'i tshig gis don dngos dang mthun pa'i bstod pa byas te/ yul de nyid gzhan la ngo sprod dang mtshams sbyor gyi tshul gyis bris yod/gsar bzhad rig gnas kyi dpyid dpal/1 rtsom 'di'i rtsom khungs dang rtsom pa po gang yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 1980lo'i 〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/〉 deb dang po las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni 1941lor lha sar skyes ba'i deng rabs bod kyi rtsom pa po glang mdun dpal 'byor yin/36

2 〈gsar bzhad rig gnas kyi dpyid dpal〉 zhes pa'i rtsom lus dang rtsom stangs phris/lan/ rtsom lus ni tshigs bcad yin la rtsom stangs ni bsdus brjod yin/3 ci 'dra zhig la bsdus brjod zer/lan/ bsdus brjod rtsom yig ni brjod 'dod kyi bya dngos yid la bsam nas/ de mtshon byed kyi dpe gzhan zhig la kha g.yar te rang gis brjod par 'dod pa'i kun slong ngam bsam blo de mngon par mtshon pa zhig yin/4 〈gsar bzhad rig gnas kyi dpyid dpal〉/ zhes pa'i nang gi mtshon bya dang mtshon byed gang yin/lan/ mtshon bya ni rig gnas gyi dus su bod kyi rig gnas la gnod 'tshe dang gtor brlag btang nas re zhig nyams dmas su gyur pa dang / rig gsar mjug sgril rjes tang gi srid jus bzang bo'i 'og slar yar slar gso dang gong 'phel gtong ba'i rnam pa de yin la/ mtshon byed ni yid 'ong pad ma'i skyed tshal la mi 'dod sprin dag 'khrigs pa'i dus ngan pa'i gnod 'tshe thebs nas re zhig 'dab pa rnyid cing bzhin bzang dud par gyur na'ang / cung ma 'gor bar skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung nas shar bas dpyid dpal rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa de yin/5 slob tshan khrod kyi dus kye nam zla ’ dang yid 'ong pad tshal pa gshen ma nyung shas /pa dgun gyi bsil 'khyags gangs lhags bzhi bo rta bdun dbang bo/ pa chu skyes padma’ pa rkang drug bung ba ’ bcas kyis don gang zhig mtshon par byas yod/lan/ ( dus kyi nam zla’ yis srid jus kyi 'gyur ldog mtshon pa dang / ‘ yid 'ong pad tshal gyis bod kyi rig gnas mtshon/ ra gshen ma nyung shas zhes pas spyi tshogs rnying ba'i sku drag dang ma rtsa can sogs mtshon/ ((dgun gyi bsil 'khyags gangs lhags bzhi bo yis mi bzhi'i phyogs /57

khag mtshon/ rta bdun dbang bos srid jus gsar ba mtshon/ ( chu skyes padma pa rkang drug bung ba ’ rig gnas slob pa'i slob ma mtshon/6 〈gsar bzhad rig gnas kyi dpyid dpal〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig gi brjod don ci yin/lan/ rtsom 'dir lo rgyus kyi dus skabs du ma'i nang rbad kyi rig gnas ni sku drag dang ma rtsa can kho na'i spyod yul du gyur pa dang / mi bzhi'i phyogs khag sogs kyis bod kyi rig gnas gnod 'tshe btang ba'i ngan 'bras spyi bsdoms byas pa ma zad/ tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i 'og tu bod kyi rig gnas la slar yang gson shugs rgyas pa'i rnam pa la bsngags brjod gnang yod/rgyal blon 'bangs kyi chas gos dang dar lcog 'dzugs srol/1 〈rgyal blon 'bangs kyi chas gos dang dar lcog 'dzugs srol/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de gang las bdams shing / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni 〈deb ther dkar po〉 las bdams shing / rtsom pa po ni mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel (1905—1951) yin/2 sngon gyi rgyal po'i cha byad ji 'dra yin/ lan/ dar dmar po'i la thod bzhes pa dang za 'og gi ber dang phyags lham sne 'khyil gyon pa dang / zhwa dmar btsan zhwa'i dbyibs can rtse mo mtho zhing phra ba'i g.yas zur du tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan zhing dar dmar gyis bcings pa'i lhag ma mdun nas bsgol bsgrigs byas nas gyon pa dang /skabs 'gar thang zhu yang gyon no/ /3 khron chen gyi cha byad ji 'dra yin/lan/ blon chen phal cher rgyal bo'i chas dang 'dra ba dang / dmag mi rnams kyis stag lpags gyon pa yin/ skabs der bod dang ta zig pa rnams mdza' 'brel che bas bod kyi rje blon rnams kyis ta /3 8

zig pa'i lugs gnang ste za 'og gi ber dang phyags lham sne 'khyil sogs gyon pa yin/4 sngon bod kyi rgyal 'bangs rnams kyi bzhugs gnas/lan/ bod kyi rgyal bo'i bzhugs gnas ni pho brang yin pa dang / blon dang 'bangs kyi bzhugs gnas ni gur yin no/ / 5 sngon bod mi'i dar lcog 'dzugs srol de ji ltar dar ba yin/lan/ de ni thog mar dmag gi rtags su mngon la/ rjes su chos kyi las su song bas bod khyim yin phyin gnas gang na yod kyang dar lcog slong ba'i srol de ma nyams par yod/6 sngar gyi btsan po'am rgyal bo sogs kyi cha byad ji ltar yin par dpyad gzhi khag lnga drangs yod pa ni gang yin/lan/ dang po bee sngon dus kyi yin nges pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur ci rigs dang / gnyis pa da ta zig gi srol/ gsum pa ni btsan dang rgyal bo/ zhang blon sogs su 'bod pa'i yul lha 'di dag la bltas nas sngon gyi btsan po dang rgyal po rnams drag po dang g.yul gyi cha lugs ji ltar mdzad pa'i rnam pa dang / bzhi ba ni sngon gyi btsan po dang rgyal po'i 'khor gyi ru 'dren sde bzhi bya ba de yin pa dang / lnga ba ni rgya gar shar ngos kyi bhar ma pa rnams yin no/ /7 〈rgyal blon 'bangs kyi chas gos dang dar lcog 'dzugs srol〉〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs thad khyad chos ji 'dra yin/lan/ rang lugs sgrub stangs thad du rigs 'ded dang gnas lugs brjod pa/ lung 'dren pa/dpe 'god pa sogs kyi sgrub thabs mang du yod pas don gyi gnad 'byin par byas yod pas sgrub byed khungs btsan zhing / klog pa por bden snang gi 'du shes ster ba sogs khyad chos mang ngo / /

bsam yas gtsug lag khang /1rtsom 'di'i mtshan don la 'grel ba ji ltar byed/lan/ spyi lo dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus dkyil du btsan po khri srong btsan gyis skabs su bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig yin/ bod du nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i gtsug lag gi dang po yin la/ mtshan hril bor dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zer/2 bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs tshugs pa nas legs grub byung ba'i lo tshigs ci yin/lan/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bod du gdan drangs rjes/ mkhan chen gyis sa dpyad mdzad nas spyi lo762lor btings shing spyi lo766lor legs par grub/3 bsam yas gtsug lag khang la lugs gsum bsam yas zhes zer ba'i lugs gsum ni gang dag red/lan/gtsug lag khang 'di thog so rim pa gsum gyis grub pa dang / 'og khang bod lugs dang /bar khang rgya nag lugs/ steng khang rgya gar lugs gsum yin/4 mkhan slob chos gsum ni gang dag yin/lan/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho (sto dhi sa twa) dang / slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan bcas yin/5 bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa des ci zhig mtshon/lan/ rang ra'i mes po rnams kyis gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir lugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims bzang bos khyab par mdzad cing / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi srol bzang dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod rtsa chen zhig yin pa ma zad/ dpa' zhing las la brtson pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rang gi blo rig la brten nas bskrun pa'i rin thang gzhal du med pa'i 'dzugs skrun /60

skam zhig yin na/ gangs rgyan padma zer ba de yang lo mang skyes pa'i rtswa ldum zhig las gzhan ci//derang gi pha yul la dga' zhen med pa'i mi zhig yin na/ pha yul la lag rjes 'jog nus pa'i skye bo de dag kyang rang bzhin gyi skye bo phal ba zhig las gzhan ci/ ④rtswa thang chen po la dga' 'os pa dang gangs rgyan padma la de bas kyang dga' 'os pa'i rgyu mtshan ngag gi lam nas bsnyad tshe khyod kyang rtswa thang chen po la dga' ba dang gangs rgyan padma la de bas kyang dga' nges red/ /dengs pha yul gyi lo rgyus dang skye bo dam pa dag gi phyag rjes ji ma ji bzhin du brjod na khyod kyang de dag la dga' zhen che nges red/4 gangs rgyan padma'i gnas yul shes sam/lan/ dgung sngon dbyings su bsnyegs pa'i gangs ri mthon po dang / na bun gtsug tu bcings pa'i dkan gzar gyi brag ri/ grang ngar rus par zug pa'i gangs 'khyags dang rdo zegs sogs yin no/ /5 slob tshan du gangs rgyan padma'i snying stobs la ji ltar bsngags brjod gnang yod/lan/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang bdag las gzhan gces pa'i gshis rgyud bzang bo dang / mi rnams la dreg grum dang sa mtho sar sdod mi tshugs pa'i nad thang tshe de'i rang lus dum bu mang por gtong bar dga' mgu yi rang chen po byed pa dang / de'i ro nus dang yon tan gyis mi rnams 'byung 'khrugs nad las thar bar mdzad cing dga' bde mi zad pa'i dpal la dbugs dbyung bar byed do/ //62

bcu drug pa/ sgyur rtsom skor/hphan kha/1 〈phen kha〉/ zhes pa'i sgrung gtam 'di gang las bdams/ rtsom pa bo su yin/lan/ 〈chi kho hphu'i sgrung thung gces bsdus// las bdams shing / rtsom pa bo ni u ru su'i ming du grags pa'i sgrung gtam rtsom pa po chi kho byu (1860—1904) yin/2 phon khas rang gi spo bo la 'phrin yig skur don dang / 'phrin yig gi nang don gtso bo ci zhig yin/lan/ hphan kha dka' sdug gi gnas de las thar 'dod pa dang / khong grong khyer du 'tsho thabs bral bas spo bo len du yong bar re zhu byas pa de'o/ /3 6na khas sbyin bdag tshang du sgrub pa'i bya ba gtso bo gang yin/ khos bya ba de sgrub 'dod med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ lham bzor lag g.yog dang / byis pa gnyor skyong / khyim las sna tshogs byed pa bcas yin/las ga lci ba dang mnar gcod kho na myong dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /4 glan khas 'phrin yig de spo bo'ilag tu 'byor thub bam/ rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ kho'i 'phrin yig spo bor 'byor mi thub ste/ rgyu mtshan ni khos spo bo yod sa'i sdod gnas gsal bo bris med pa dang / tha na spo bo'i ming yang gsal bo zhig bris med pa'i rkyen yin/5 khos sbyin bdag gi 'then sgam nas snag bum zhig dang smyug rtser btsa' chags pa'i lcaṭa sgyug cig blangs shing / lteb chags shor pa'i shog bu dkar po zhig snyom por gting ste/ 'phrin yig 'bri mgo martsams ’ zhes pas ci zhig gsal bshad byas yod/lan/ kho'i 'tsho bar ha cang dka' sdug che ba gsal bshad byas yod /6 rtsom 'di don tshan du yis grub pa dang so so'i nang don mdor bsdus su brjong thub bam//(3

lan/ don tshan gsum ste/ dang bo (rang grub tshan pa 1—2) rtsom pa pos zhib brjod kyi lam nas hphan khas ye shu 'khrungs skar gyi dgong mor/ sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa chos khang du phyag 'tshal bar song ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ lkog tu 'phrin yig 'bri bar gra sgrig byas pa'i skor brjod yod/ gnyis pa (rang grub tshan pa 3—15) phen kha'i 'phrin yig gi nang don dang / 'phrin yig 'bri skabs gyi 'char snang bye brag tu bris nas hphan kha'i ya nga ba'i las dbang gsal bshad byas yod/gsum pa (rang grub tshan pa 16—21) phon khas yig shubs steng du yi ge bris pa dang / 'phrin yig bskur ba/ 'phrin yig bskur rjes rmi lam rmis pa bcas brjod do/ /7 〈phen kha〉 zhes pa'i rtsom gyi brjod bya dang bstan don gang yin nam/lan/ bu chung hphan kha khyim tshang phyugapo zhig gi g.yog po byas te/ dka' sdug dang mnar gcod ma bzod par phyir pha yul la 'akro 'dod kye 'phrin yig gcig spo bor bris pa'i don dag brjod nas/skabs de'i u ru si'i spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo ther 'don byas pa dang / hra hong gong ma'i log spyod lam lugs la sun 'byin dang kha rdung btang ba'o/ /8 〈phen kha// zhes pa'i rtsom tshul thad khyad chos gang dang gang yod/lan/ 'phrin yig gi lam nas byis pa zhig gi bsam tshul ltar bris pas byis pa'i blo kha dang ha cang 'tsham pa dang / rtsom pa pos zhib brjod dang 'phrin yig gi nang don/ 'phrin yig 'bri skabs phyir dran byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams dkyus gcig tu spel mar brjod pa/ mi sna'i rnam 'gyur dang bya byed/ sems kyi 'char snang sogs zhib 'bri byas nas nang sems kyi 'dun pa dang dran tshul soṭa mngon par mtshon yod//64

bshu 'bri ba chung chung /1 〈bshu 'bri ba chung chung〉/ zhes pa'i sgrung gtam 'di gang las bdams pa dang / rtsom pa bo su yin/ lan/ spyi lo 2002 lor ha'ar pin dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun pa'i 〈brtse ba'i slob gso/〉las bdams shing / rtsom pa bo ni dbyi tha le'i ya mu chi si (18yo 1908) yin/2 〈bshu 'bri ba chung chung〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom gyi mi sna gtso bo zhi le'o yi a phas kho la yig byang bshu ru ma bcug pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gang yin/lan/ zhi le'o yis slob sbyong gi bar chad sel ba'i slad du'o/ /3 〈bshu 'bri ba chung chung〉/ zhes pa'i rtsom gyi brjod snying gang yin nam/lan/ bu chung zhi le'o lo na chung yang pha mar sha tsha zhing sems khur byed pa dang / khyim gyi las 'gan khur du len phod pa'i ya rabs kyi gshis shar bstod bsngags byas pa'o/4 〈bshu 'bri ba chung chung〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs kyi khyad chos gtso bo ni ci/lan/ mi sna'i sems khams zhib 'bri byas nas de'i bsam blo'i gshis yi mtshon par byas yod/sprin la bltas nas gnam gshis brtag pa/1 〈sprin la bltas nas gnam gshis brtag pa/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ bya dngos kyi gnas lugs gsal bshad byed pa'i rtsom zhig yin/8 slob tshan 'di'i brjod bya'i don gtso bo ci zhig red/lan/ sprin gyi dbyebs dang 'gyur ldog sprin mdangs kyi snang tshul dang gnam gshis bar gyi 'brel bcas gsal bshad byas yod//6kyi

3 slob tshan du dbyebs mi 'dra ba gang dag bkod yod/lan/ sprin dkar phang phung dang / sprin phung thor bu/ sprin phung mthon po/ sprin 'khyil bang rim can/ sprin mthon po bang rim can/ char sprin bang rim can/ char sprin phung po/ sprin dkar 'khyil ma bcas so/ /sa sprin dkar 'khyil ma dang sprin dkar phang phung ni ha cang mtho ba'i dbyings su gnas pa'i tshe/gnam gshis la 'gyur ldog ji 'dra byung ba red/lan/ brlan gsher de tsam mi 'dzin pa'i rkyen gyis spyir btang du kha char ser gsum mi 'bab pa red/5 pa nangs snga mo'i sprin dmar chu yin/ dgong phyi dro'i sprin dmar me yin zer pa'i gtam dpe de'i don ci yin/lan/ zhogs par mtshams sprin ldang na gnam 'thibs te char ba 'bab pa dang / dgong khar mtshams sprin ldang na nyin 'gar gnam thang ba'i rtags so/ /6 )ba tshan du sprin gyi kha dog mi 'dra ba gang dag bris yod/lan/ 'khyims dang 'khyims chung ba/ 'ja' dang mtshams sprin bcas so/ /7 gna' snga mor bod kyi dmangs khrod du sprin dang gnam gshis bar gyi 'brel ba brjod pa'i gtam dpe yod dam/lan/ dper na/ byang sprin lho la song na/ lho yi tsan dan dmar po me ru 'bar/ lho sprin byang la song na/ byang gi rgya mtsho chen po jagung du 'phyur/ zhes dang / ston dgung thang brgyab na/ lo 'breg gi zor ba brdar/ dpyid dgung thang brgyab na lug ji yi lham tshems lta bu sogs kyis mtshon nus pa mang ngo / //66

8 〈sprin la bltas nas gnam gshis brtag pa// zhes pa'i rtsom la gsal bshad byed pa'i thabs gang 'dra bkol yod/lan/ dbye ba dgar ba dang / mtshan nyid 'god pa/ dpe 'god pa'i thabs sogs bkol yod/( sprin la bltas nas gnam gshis brtag na dge mtshan ji 'dra yod/lan/ sprin gyis nga tshor gnam thang rub dang char rlung yod med ngos 'dzin dang / gnam gshis 'gyur ldog la sngon dpag byed par rogs ram byed thub pas/ bzo zhing las rigs kyi thon skyed thad don snying gal chen ldan no/ /rgya mtsho ni ma 'ongs pa'i 'bru mdzod yin/1 rgya mtsho ni ma 'ongs pa'i 'bru mdzod yin zhes pa'i 'bru mdzod gyi go don ji 'dra yin/lan/ de yang 'bru mdzod ni sgra dog 'jug gi 'bru rigs te/ 'bras dang kro/ ma rmos lo tog sogs min par/ sgra yangs 'jug gi 'bru rigs te/ mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho bcud kyi dgos mkho skong thub pa'i zas rigs la zer ba yin/2 da lta mi'i rigs la 'phrad pa'i khor yug gi gnad don gtso bo yin pa dang / gnad don de thag gcod ji ltar byed/lan/ mi grangs glo bur du 'phel ba dang bstun nas thon khungs gyi 'dang gi med pa de khor yug gi gnad don yin la/ mi'i rigs kyis ma 'ongs par bar snang dang sa 'og mtsho gter du phyin nas gnad don de thag gcod dgos pa dang sgos su rgya mtsho'i 'jings dang rgyang ring pa'i rgya mtsho'i nya ra dang skye dngos gsar spel dang bkol spyod bya dgos/3 〈rgya mtsho da ma 'ongs pa'i 'bru mdzod yin// zhes par don gtso bo ci zhig brjod yod/lan/ rgya mtsho ni mi'i rigs kyi ma 'ongs pa'i 'bru mdzod du 'gyur nges pa'i gnas lugs /67

brjod nas/ mtsho sngo dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho'i chu g.yeng skye dngos/ nya rigs sogs chan rig dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsar spel byas na/ mi'i rigs la spri dkar rdzas mkho sprod byed thub pas/rgya mtsho'i thon khungs gsar spel byed par don snyeng ldan pa'o/ /4 slob tshan 'dir gsal bshad byed pa'i thabs gang dag spyad 'dugalan/ 'grel bshad dang / dpe 'god pa/ grangs ga 'dren pa/ dbye ba dgar ba/ zhib bsdur byed pa sogs spyad yod/gong ma'i na bza' gsar ba/1 〈gong ma'i na bza' gsar ba)〉 zhes pa'i rtsom 'di gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa bo su yin/lan/ 〈an thu'u hrin gyi byes sgrung phyogs bsgrigs〉〉 las bdams shing / rtsom pa bo ni ten man rgyal khab kyi rtsom mkhan grags chen an thu'u hrin (1805—1875) zhes pa de yin/2 an thu'u hrin gyis nam nas bzung gsar rtsom gyi mgo tshugs shing / bsdoms pas byis sgrung ci tsam bris yod/lan/ spyi lo 1827 lo nas mgo tshugs pa yin la/ bsdoms pa'i byis sgrung brgya dang drug cu lhag brtsams skad/〈 〈gong ma'i na bza' gsar ba〉 zhes pa'i sgrung gtam 'dir mi sna gang dag yod/ mi sna gtso bo su red/lan/ gong ma dang khram pa/ blon po/ dpon po/ 'khor 'bangs/ grong khyer gyi mi sogs yod la/ de dag nang nas mi sna gtso bo ni gong ma red/4 gong ma'i rang gshis kyi khyad chos ni ji lta bu zhig red/168

lan/ rang rlom che zhing 'jon thang med pa/ g.yo sgyu che yang blun zhing rmongs pa/ gtum drag yin pa/ g.yo zol la mkhas pa bcas red/ 5 〈gong ma'i na bza' gsar ba// zhes pa'isgrung gtam gyi byung rim ngos zungs/lan/ thog mar gong ma gzab mchor spras par dga' ba mtshams sbyor byas pa ni sngon 'gro dang /khram pas gong ma'i dga' phyogs dang bstun nas mgo bskor ba ni mgo brtsams pa yin/ khram pas gos 'thag pa dang gong mas mi mngags nas lta ru bcug pa ni 'phel rgyas dang / gong mas na bza' gsar pa gyon nas khrom skor mdzad sgor zhugs pa ni gtam rgyun hril bo'i mtho rlabs dang mjug 'bras yin/ 6 〈gong ma'i na bza' gsar ba〉/ zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyi khungs sne gang yin/lan/ khram pa gnyis kyis 'thag pa'i tshan bza' gsar bas’ de'o/ /7 byis pa zhig la na bza' gsar ba'i gsang ba brtol du bcug nas khrom skor mdzad sgo mjug rdzogs su 'jug don ci yin/ lan/ byis pa 'dang rgyag ci yang med pa dang gtam drang mor smra bar bkag rgya ci yang med/ gong mas na bza' ci yang mnabs mi 'dug ces pa ni zol bral zhing spobs pa che la/ thad shar yin la gtan khel yang byas yod pas byis pa'i thob thang dang 'tsham pa'o/ /8 〈gong ma'i na bza' gsar ba)/ zhes pa'i brjod bya'i bstan don ci red/lan/ gong ma dang blon po/ 'khor 'bangs/ khram pa sogs kyis phan tshun la mgo bskor btang pa'i dgod bro pa'i bya sprod bris te/ bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin gyi dbang sgyur gral rim gyi g.yo sgyu dang blun rmongs/ rul sungs kyi ngo bo ther 'don byas yod/9 ma pa dang blon po/ gong ma tshang mas rdzun bshad pa'i bsam bya ci yin//69

lan/ khram pas dngul mang bo len pa dang / blon pos rang gi dpon gnas skyob pa dang / gong mas rang gi ches mtho ba'i dbang sgyur gyi gzi rngam srung ba'i ched du rdzun bshad pa'o/ /10 〈gong ma'i na bza' gsar ba// zhes pa'i rtsom stangs ji 'dra yin/lan/ rab btags dang bsam yan gyi 'bri thabs spyad pa'i byes sgrung zhig yin no/ /rgyab gzugs/1 〈rgyab gzugs〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de ji 'dra zhig yin nam/lan/ 'das don brjod pa'i lhug rtsom zhig yin/2 〈rgyab gzugs〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'di'i lo rgyus rgyab ljongs ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ spyi lo 1917 lo'i dgun khar/ rtsom pa bos rmo mo tshe las 'das pa shes rjes/ pe cin nas zhus kro'u la song ste a pha dang mnyam du dbyang kro'u ru 'das mchod bsgrub par song / 'das mchod bsgrubs rjes/ a pha nan cin la song nas las sha btsal dgos pa dang / rtsom pa bo pe cin la slob sbyong byed du 'akro dgos pas/ pha bu gnyis ga phu'u khug nas kha gyes pa de'o/ /3 rtsom yig 'dir don tshan du yis grub pa dang / so so gang dag yin/lan/ don tshan gsum gyis grub pa ste/ dang bo (rang grub tshan pa dang bo) rtsom pa bos a pha dran pa dang / ches brjod par dka' ba ni khong gi rgyab gzugs’ nyid yin pa bris pa dang / gnyis pa (rang grub tshan pa gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar) phu'u khug me 'khor 'bab tshigs su a pha dang kha gyes pa'i skabs kyi 'das don rnams phyir dran gyi tshul du bris pa/ gsum pa (rang grub tshan pa bdun pa) rtsom pa po yab dang gyes rjes a pha dran tshul bris pa'o/ /4 〈rgyab gzugs〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig tu thog mtha' bar gsum du rgyab gzugs / thengs ci tsam zhib 'bri byas yod//70

ni gang yin/ de'i nang nas ches 'bur du thon pa dang de'i skabs kyi snang brnyan ni ji 'dra yin/lan/ rgyab gzugs thengs gnyis pa bris pa de yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang lcags lam brgyud nas tsha lu ma nyo ru song ba'i brgyud rim khrod du 'bab tshigs stegs bu'i steng du bskyod skabs kyi rgyab gzugs de ches 'bur du thon par byas shing / 'bab tshigs stegs bu'i steng du bskyod skabs ‘khong gis phyag zung la brten nas yar 'gos shing zhabs gnyis yar bskums pa na/ khong gi shin tu rgyags pa'i sku g.yon du cung zad gseg 'dug tsha lu ma nyos nas slar yang khong phyir log skabs/ khong gis thog mar tsha lu ma rnams sar bzhag pa dang / de nas rang nyid dal gyis mar babs rjes/ tsha lu ma rnams bsgrugs nas tshur yong / zhes pa de'i skabs kyi rtsom pa pos mi sna'i bya 'gul bris pa brgyud nas snang brnyan bris pa yin/10 yab kyes bu la skyel ma byed pa'i bya rim khrod snga rjes skad cha tshig bzhi bshad pa gang yin/lan/ dang po/ ra skyon med kho tsho song na mi legs ’ gnyis pa khyod gnas 'di ru ma 'gul bar sdod dang / nga shing tog tsha lu ma 'ga' nyo bar 'gro gsum pa/ pa nga 'gro rgyu yin/ sa nger slebs rjes 'phrin yig skur// bzhi ba/ ra da nang la song dang / nang du mi med/ // ces pa rnams so/11 〈rgyab gzugs〉 zhes pa'i rtsom gyi brjod bya'i don gang yin nam/lan/ rtsom pa pos me 'khor 'bab tshigs su a pha dang / kha gyes pa'i skabs kyi gnas tshul zhib brjod byas te/ a phas bu la gces skyong tshad med gnang ba'i brtse dung mtshon par ma zad/ rtsom pa bos 'tsho ba dka' tshegs che zhing sems sdug gis mnar ba'i gnas tshul 'og tu a pha lhag par dran pa'i brtse sems kyang mtshon par byas yod/

mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig 1 〈mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig〉/ ces pa'i sgrung gtam 'di gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa bo su yin pa shod/lan/ spyi lo1982lo'i 〈zang char〉 deb gnyis pa las bdams pa dang / rtsom pa bo ni hpha ran si'i rtsom mkhan grags can tu'u te (1840—1897) zhes pa de yin/2 〈mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig〉 ces pa'i rtsom gyi lo rgyus rgyab ljongs gang yin nam/lan/ spyi lo1870lo'i zla7pa'i tshes 19nyin la bslangs pa'i phu hpha dmag 'khrug ste/ mthar hpha ran si pham nas phu ru sen la mgo btags shing / de nas bzung ste ar sa si dang lo lin shar khul gyi byu ran si'i mi dmangs ni dbang shor rgyal phung gi gnas su lhung / de bas phu ru sen gyi btsan 'dzul bas btsan shed kyis hpha ran si'i skad yig khrid du ma bcug pa red/ rtsom 'di ni rtsom pa bos phu hpha dmag 'khrug mtshams bzhag nas lo gnyis 'gor ba'i rjes su spyi lo1873lor bris pa yin/2 〈mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig〉〉 zhes pa'i gtam rgyud kyi mi sna gtso bo su red/lan/ bu chung hphu lang hri dang dge rgan han mer gnyis yin/4 dge rgan han mer gyis 'di ni ngas khyod tshor 'khrid pa'i mjug mtha'i slob thun yin ’ zhes bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ de'i phyi nyin nas bzung pa lin nas ar sa si dang lo lin gyi slob grwar deng phyin 'jar man gyi skad yig kho na ma gtogs hpha ran si'i skad yig slob mi chog pa'i bka' brda babs pas de ltar bshad pa red/5 dge rgan han mer gyis nus shugs yod dgus sgo sam steng du hpha ran si khri lor brtan pa /73

shog’’ ces bris pa des ci zhig mtshon/lan/ khong nyed mes rgyal la dga' zhen che ba dang dgra bor sdang sems che ba'i bsam pa'i brtse dung mtshon yod/6 nyin der dge rgan han mer gyis gzab 'chor spras nas slob khrid byed du yong don gang yin/lan/ pa mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig’’ la rjes dran gyi ched du'o//7 dge rgan han mer gyis rgyal khab phung nas bran du gyur pa'i mi dmangs la cha mtshon na/ rang nyid kyi skad yig snying khong du bsres bar byas na ni/ btson sgo 'byed pa'i sde mig lag tu 'byor ba dang mtshungs/ ’ zhes pa'i pa btson sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig de'i go ba ji ltar len/lan/ pa btson sgo zhes pas phu ru sen gyis hpha ran si'i skad cha mtshon pa yin/8 2 yi ge ma phyi 'khod 'dug pa rnams nga tsho'i mdun cog lcags dbyug steng bkal bas/ rgyal dar chung chung mang bo slob khang du lhab lhub bskyod pa dang mtshungs zhes pa'i tshig 'di'i bsam pa'i nang don ci yin/lan/ tsa ar sa si’’ ni byu ran si'i mnga' khongs 'bral thabs med pa zhig yin pas/ dgra bos btsan bzung byed mi chog pa sems su nges par byas/9 〈mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig〉 ces pa'i gtam rgyud kyi mtshon bya ci yin/lan/ ar sa sa'i dbang cha shor rjes/ sa de ga'i mi dmangs kyis phu lu hri btsan 'dzul bas btsan shed kyis hpha ran si'i skad yig khrid du mi 'jug pa'i skabs su mtshon par byas pa'i yid skyo zhe 'khon dang rgyal gces 'du shes yin/10 chos khang gi cong brda dang dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i dung brda brgyab pa des nang don ci zhig mtshon pa yin//74

lan/ ar sa si'i mi rnams hpha ran sa'i skad yig slob gso dang 'bral dgos pa'i brda gtong ba de mtshon/11 〈mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig// ni ci zhig gi nang don mtshon pa'i brtsams chos shig yin/lan/ rgyal gces ring lugs kyi brjod bya mtshon pa'i brtsams chos shig go /dpyid/1 〈dpyid// ces pa'i rtsom yig gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa bo su yin/lan/ 〈zang char〉 spyi lo1993lo'i deb gnyis pa las bdams shing / rtsom pa bo ni deng rabs kyi ming du grags pa'i snyan ngag pa dang / lhug rtsom snyan ngag pa/ mkhas pa/ dmangs gtso'i 'thab mo ba kru'u tsi ching zhes pa de'o/ /2 〈dpyid〉 ces pa'i rtsom 'di ji lta bu'i rtsom tshul zhig red/lan/ phyi yul gyi ngo mtshar snang tshul brjod pa la brten nas nang yul can gyi tshor 'du mtshon par byed pa'i rtsom zhig go /2 〈dpyid/〉 ces pa'i rtsom yig 'di phyogs gang dag brgyud nas dpyid dpal gsal bor bris yod pa dang / rtsom pa bos bsam pa'i brtse dung ji 'dra zhig mtshon yod/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ngo mtshar dpe ris lnga yis gzhogs dang ngos du ma brgyud nas dpyid dpal bris yod pa dang / rtsom pa bos dpyid dpal gyi mtshar sdug la dga' zhing zhen pa'i brtse dung mtshon pa dang / dpyid dpal gyis skye dngos yod rgu skyed du sring zhing / mi la re ba stob pa las kun nas skyed pa'i rtsom pa po'i brtse dung mtshon 'dug4 dpyid lnga'i rtswa'i khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i tshig gtso bo gang dag 'dugalan/ pa sa shun brtol’ pa 'jam mnyen mnyen pa nem lhod lhod ’ pa gang sar skyes ’/73

sogs so/5 dpyid ga'i me tog gi khyad chos mtshon thub pa'i tshig gang dag yod/lan/ dang bo rnam pa'i thad nas mtshar nyams 'gran pa dang / gnyis pa kha dog gi thad nas dmar bo me dpung dang glo kha mtshams sprin/ dkar po kha ba dang 'dra ba/ gsum pa bro ba'i thad nas dri bsung mngar mo tshal tshal du spro ba/ bzhi ba bzhad pa'i dbyibs tshugs kyi thad nas thor ba 'dren byed dang / skar phran/ kem kem du g.yo/ lhem lhem du 'tsher bcas so /6 dpyid char gyi tshugs yi mtshon thub pa'i tshig gang dag yod/lan/ zhol rtsid kyi nyag ma dang / 'tsheb 'drub kyi rgya khab/ dar zab kyi skud pa bcas so/ /7 4 ri bo mdangs rgyas/ chu bor bags thon pa/ nyin byed kye bzhin ras dmar bo mngon’/ zhes pa'i tshig gi bstan don gang yin/lan/ pa mdangs rgyas / zhes pa ljang mdog tu gyur pa dang / ra bags thon pa’ zhes pa dpyid chu mang zhing gtsang chu'i chu mtshams yar mtho ru phyin pa/ ((dmar po mngon’’ zhes pa nyi ma je dror song bar go dgos/8 dpyid ga ni pagasar skyes kyi bus pa ’ zhig dang / pa na chung gi bu mo ’ pa‘dar bab kyi gzhon nus sogs dang 'dra bar bkod de gang la bsngags brjod byas yod/lan/ dang bo thams cad gsar ba yin pa dang / gnyis pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba dang /gsum pa skyes stobs kyi khengs pa rgyas pa bcas kyi dpyid dpal kyi khyad chos la bsngags pa'o/ /9 lo jus legs nyes dpyid la rag las phyir / zhes pa'i don ci yin/lan/ dpyid kyis mi rnams kyi sems kyi zhing sar re ltos kyi sa bon sbyin pa bstan yod/10 〈dpyid〉 ces pa'i rtsom stangs thad nas khyad chos ci zhig yod//76

dag gi 'dab ma'i nang du 'dus pa'i tshos rgyu la tshal ser gyi tshos rgyu zer/6 me tog dkar po la tshos rgyu ci yang med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ me tog de'i 'dab ma'i nang du wu ba chung ngus khengs yod pa'i rkyen gyis yin te/ me tog dkar bo zhig khyer yong ste/ lag pas 'dab ma'i nang gi wu ba brtsir na/ kha dog med par dwangs gsal du 'gyur ba yin/7 me tog rigs 4187 gyi kha dog la sdom rtsis byas pa ltar na/ me tog gi kha dog shin tu mang ba'i mdog ni gang red/lan/ dkar po dang / ser bo/ dmar bo bcas red// rtsom yig tu 'bu srin dang me tog bar gyi 'brel ba ste/ phan tshun gdam ga byed pa'i 'brel ba 'bri dus gang zhig gnad du bzang nas bris yod/lan/ rtsom pa bos me tog gis 'bu srin gdam ga byed pa gnad du bzung nas bris yod/9 shin tu ya mtshan pa ni mdog 'gyur shing pad ma yin te/ thog mar me tog bzhad pa'i skabs su/kha dog dkar po yin zhing / nyin gnyis par dmar skyar 'gyur ba dang / de nas dmar nag tu 'gyur zhing / 'dab ma lhung ba'i dus su yang rgya smug tu 'gyur ba red/ ces pa'i tshig 'dis rtsom yig khrod du nus pa ji 'dra zhig thon pa dang 'bri thabs ci zhig spyad yod/lan/ 'dir dpe 'dren pa'i 'bri thabs spyad de/ me tog gi kha dog 'gyur stangs sna tshogs yin pa bye brag tu gsal bshad byas pas/ rtsom yig gi brjod stobs kyi nus pa je drag tu btang yod/10 dbyi tha le'i snyan ngag pa tan tha'i 〈lha'i rol dbyangs〉〉 las/ nga mdun du skyod bzhin yod kyang / me tog mthong bas/ gom kha de mur je dal du song / zhes pa ni 'bri thabs gang spyad nas ci zhig gsal bshad byas yod//72

lan/ lung 'dren pa'i 'bri thabs spyad de mi rnams me tog la dga' ba'i tshor 'du zab mo de gsal bshad byas yod/nyi ma'i 'od zer/ 1 〈nyi ma'i 'od zer/〉 zhes pa'i rtsom 'di gang nas bdams pa dang rtsom pa bo su yin/lan/ rtsom yig de ni dma' 'bring gi rgya'i 〈skad yig〉 deb drug pa las bdams nas bsgyur ba dang / rtsom pa bo ni tho kru'u yin/2 〈nyi ma'i 'od zer〉 zhes pa 'di rtsom stangs gang gi khongs su gtogs pa dang / brjod bya'i snying bo gang yin/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ni dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi rtsom stangs khongs su gtogs pa dang / de'i brjod bya'i snyeng bo ni rtsom pa bos dgag sgrub zung 'brel dang dpe'i sgrub thabs la brten nas tang nang gi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul la lta tshul ji 'dra zhig 'dzin dgos pa'i gnad don bshad yod/3 pa nyi ma'i 'od zer / zhes pa de gang gi dpe ru bzhag pa yin/lan/ tang gis mgo khrid byed pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rlabs che ba'i las don gyi dper bzhag pa yin/4 nyi ma'i 'od zer / zhes pa'i mtshon don/ pa nyi ma'i nag thig ’ gis ci zhig mtshon pa yin/lan/ des rang re'i rlabs che ba'i las don dang gung khran tang mi'i yangs shing rgya che ba'i blo rgya mtshon yod/ nyi ma'i nag thig gis nga tsho'i las lnga'i khrod kyi skyon dang nor 'khrul mtshon pa yin/5 ji 'dra zhig la mtshungs dpe'i sgo nas sgrub thabs zer/lan/ lkog gyur gyi gnas lugs gang zhig mtshungs dpe yi sgo nas bsgrub par byed pa la mtshungs dpe'i sgo nas sgrub thabs zer//79

6 dpe'i sgrub thabs dang rigs 'gre'i sgrub thabs/ bsdur ba'i thabs gsum gyi khyad par ci/lan/ dpe'i sgo nas sgrub thabs la thog mar dpe dpe can la 'os shing 'tsham pa dang / bar du dpe de kun la rgyus che zhing kha gsal ba/ mjug tu nyams stobs mnga' zhing spro ba 'phel ba zhig yin pa dang / rigs 'gre'i sgrub thabs ni rigs 'gre bya'i phyogs gnyis nges par du ngo bo'i thog mtshungs dgos/ bsdur ba'i thabs ni bsdur bya'i phyogs gnyis nges par du ngo bo'i thog mtshungs dgos/ bsdur ba'i thabs ni bsdur bya'i phyogs gnyis nges par du rang bzhin thad nas kha gtad sa yod dgos so/ /7 〈nyi ma'i 'od zer〉 zhes pa'i nang cung zhib gsal gyi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul la bzung ba'i 'khrul lta rigs bzhir dpyad cing dgag yod pa ci/lan/ skyon cha dang nor 'khrul gleng tshe/ rang res sgrub pa'i las don gyi rlabs che tshul la rkyen ngan thebs par skrag pa'i lta tshul la dgag pa dang / mi gzhan pas rang gi skyon cha dang nor 'khrul brjod par nyan mi 'dod pa'i lta tshul la dpyad cing dgag yod pa/ sus skyon cha dang nor 'khrul gleng na log spyod phyogs khag gis bed spyod par skrag pa'i lta bar dpyad cing dgag pa bcas so/ /8 4 sor mo dgu dang sor mo gcig / ces pa las/ sor mo dgu yis ci zhig mtshon pa dang / sor mo gcig gis ci zhig mtshonapa yin/lan/ sor mo dgu yis nga tsho'i las ga'i grub 'bras ni gtso bo yin pa mtshon pa dang / sor mo gcig gis nga tsho'i las ga'i skyon dang nor 'khrul ni phal ba yin pa mtshon pa'o/ /9 6ma 'di'i kha byang du 〈skyon cha dang nor 'khrul la lta tshul ji 'dra zhig 'dzin dgos pa'i gnad don bshad pa/〉 zhes ma bkod par 〈nyi ma'i 'od zer〉 zhes bkod par dge mtshan gang dang gang zhig ldan pa yin// (/

lan/ rtsom pa pos mgyogs 'akro rta yi bzo lta dang bya byed/ rnam 'gyur sogs zhib 'bri byas nas/rang dbang gi 'tsho bar re snyegs dang rang dgar gnod mi skyel ba/ 'dod chung chog shes yin pa/'grogs bde gshib bde yin pa/ bdag bas gzhan gces kyi bsam blo dang snyeng stobs la bsngags brjod byas yod/7 〈rta〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs thad khyad chos ji 'dra yod/lan/ zhib 'bri dang dper 'god pa'i thabs spyad pa dang sems ldan rab btags kyi 'bri thabs bkol ba/ bya dngos zhib brjod byas pa gson nyams ldan zhing mtshon bya rgya che ba sogs khyad chos mang ngo/ /krung go'i rdo zam gzhu dbyibs can/1 〈krung go'i rdo zam gzhu dbyibs can〉 zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa bo su yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni dma' 'bring gi 〈rgya'i skad yig〉〉 deb bzhi ba nas bdams de bsgyur/ rtsom pa po ni dbyi hrin (1895—1989) yin/2 〈krung go'i rdo zam gzhu dbyibs can// zhes pa 'di rtsom stangs gang gi khongs su gtoṭa pa dang /nang don gtso bo gang bshad yod/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ni gsal bshad rtsom yig gi rtsom stangs khongs su gtogs pa dang / go sla ba'i tshig sbyor la brten nas klog pa bor krung go'i rdo zam gzhu dbyibs can de dus nam zhig nas bskrun 'go tshugs pa dang / de'i khyad chos/ lo rgyus thog gi 'od stong 'bar ba'i grub 'bras/ krung go gsar ba dbu brnyes rjes kyi 'phel rgyas soṭa mtshams sbyor byas te/ rang rgyal ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi spyang grung 'dzoms pa'i blo rig dang spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin la bstod bsngags byas yod//82

3 rtsom yig 'dir gang dag gsal bshad byas yod la/ gsal bshad byed thabs gang dag bkol yod/lan/ rtsom yig 'dir thog mar krung go'i rdo zam gzhu dbyibs can gyi khyad chos spyi bsdoms byas shing / de nas /'o kro'u zam pa dang lu'u kug zam pa gnyis kyi gsar gtod rang bzhin dang tshan rig rang bzhin gsal bshad byas yod par ma zad/ grub 'bras de dag la dbye zhib kyang byas yod/gsal bshad byed thabs kyi thad du dpe brjod 'jog pa dang grangs ga 'god pa/ thag gcod pa/lung 'dren pa/ dpe 'god pa/ dbye zhib byed pa'i thabs sogs bkol yod/4 rtsom pa bos phyogs gang dag nas kra'o kro'u zam pa phra zhib kyis gsal bshad byas yod/lan/ rtsom pa bos kra'o gro'u zam pa'i phyi'i dbyibs rnam gyi khyad chos dang jus 'god kyi rtsa ba'i rig pa/ bzo sgrun gyi lag rtsal/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos sogs phyogs mang bo nas phra zhib kyes mtshams sbyor byas yod/5 krung go'i rdo zam gzhu dbyibs can gyi khyad chos ci/lan/ yun ring bo'i lo rgyus ldan pa dang sa phyogs kun tu yod pa/ dbyibs sna tshogs yod la mang che ba ni ngo mtshar che ba'i bzo bkod phul byung sha stag yin/kho phan nyi khe/1 〈kho phan nyi khe'i zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa dang rtsom pa bo su yin/lan/ rtsom yig 'di ni dma' 'bring gi 〈rgya'i skad yig〉 deb bzhi ba nas bdams te bsgyur ba yin/ rtsom pa bo ni rang rgyal gyi ming du grags pa'i gnam dpyad rig pa ba dang sa khams rig pa ba kru'u khe kren (1890—1974) yin/ 2 kho phan nyi khe yis gnam dpyad rig par slob gnyer mdzad sa'i slob grwa dang dus nam yin//83

lan/ 1495 lor/ dbyi tha le'i po lun nyi ya slob grwa ru gnam dpyad rig par slob gnyer mdzad pa red/3 kho phan nyi khe yis 〈go la'i 'khor skyod/〉 ces pa dus nam zhig la bris tshar ba dang / dus nam zhig gi tshe dpe cha de par du bskrun pa red/lan/ 1509 lor/ khong gis 〈go la'i 'khor skyod〉〉 ces pa'i rtsa gnad bris tshar ba red/ 1543lor ste/ khong nyed sku gshegs khar grogs pos yang yang skul mthar da gzod 〈go la'i 'khor skyod〉/ ces pa'i dpe cha de par du bskrun pa red/4 kho phan nyi khe yi 〈go la'i 'khor skyod〉/ ces pa 'di lo ngo bzhi bcu lhag la par du bskrun ma thub pa'i rgyu rkyen ci/lan/ khong gis bton pa'i lta ba dang ya li so to tes bton pa'i lta ba gnam 'gul smra ba'i bar du lo1800lhag gi lo rgyus mchis shing / chos tshogs kyis kyang gong bkur byed pas/ gal te gnam 'gul smra ba dang kha gtad du langs pa'i sa 'gul smra ba'i lta ba bton tshe/ skyon 'dzugs pa dang ngo rgol byed par rtogs pas/ khong gis gzab nan dang sems chung byas pa red/5 dus nam zhig la sa 'gul smra ba'i bzhed srol de bden don bsnyon med cig tu gyur pa red /lan/ 1757 lor/ nyi'u tun gyi kun ldan 'then shugs kyi bzhed srol byung nas yun ring 'gor ba na/ sa 'gul smra ba'i bzhed srol de bden don bsnyon med du grub pas da gzod bkag brgya las thar thub pa byung /6 kho phan nyi khe'i sa 'gul smra ba'i bzhed srol gyi gzhi 'dzin sa ni gang red/lan/ sa 'gul smra ba'i bzhed srol gyi gzhi 'dzin sa ni/ sngon rabs pa'i zhib 'jug gi grub 'bras dang rang nyid kyi lo ngo sum cu lhag gi tshod lta dang lag len gyi 'bras bu de yin//84

7 kho phan nyi khes sa 'gul smra ba'i bzhed srol spel ba de'i mdzad rjes gtso bo gang yin/lan/ kho phan nyi khes sa 'gul smra ba'i bzhed srol spel ba des/ gnam dpyad rig pa'i thad la gsar brje byas par ma zad/ da dung rig tshan so so'i tshan rig mdun du skyod pa'i dus rabs gsar ba zhig gi srol btod pa red/8 〈kho phan nyi khe〉/ zhes pa'i slob tshan 'di'i rtsom stangs dang brjod don ji 'dra yin/lan/ slob tshan 'di ni zhib brjod dang dpyad brjod spel mar bris pa'i mi sna'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i rtsom yig cig red/ 'di'i nang du rtsom pa pos kho phan nyi khe'i sku tshe gang bo'i mdzad rjes te sa 'gul smra ba'i lta ba bton pa ma zad/ da dung khong gis gnam dpyad rig pa'i thad nas srol rgyun gyi 'du shes rnying ba gtor te/ tshan rig gi dbu brnyes par byas rjes rlabs chen bzhag par ma zad/mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs su bcug pa dang / bden don la brtson len byed pa'i snyeng stobs la bsngags brjod byas yod/mchil ba chung chung /1 〈mchil ba chung chung/〉 zhes pa de gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ rtsom yig de ni dma' 'bring gi rgya'i 〈skad yig〉 deb gnyis pa las bdams te bsgyur ba yin/ rtsom pa po la'o hre ni (1899—1966) deng rabs kyi rtsom pa po grags can zhig yin zhing / pe cing gi mi yin/ brtsams chos grags chen ni 〈lo tho zhang tsi/) dang 〈long zhus chu rka)/ 〈ja khang/〉sogs yod/2 khong gis 〈mchil ba chung chung// zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'dir 'bri thabs gang spyad yod pa red/lan/ byis sgrung gi 'bri thabs spyad yod pa red/2 〈mchil ba chung chung)/ zhes pa'i rtsom yig 'dir byis sgrung gi 'bri thabs spyad nas ji ltar bris /83

yod pa red/lan/ gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas byi'u mi'i gzugs su bkod cing / de'i phyi'i rnam pa dang bya byed zhib 'bri byas yod pa ma zad/ de'i nyams 'gyur dang yid kyi 'gyur ba phra zhib kyes mtshon par byas yod/4 rtsom pa bos thengs bcu lhag tsam la byi'u chung gi mig zung zhib 'bri byas pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ de ni bye'u de'i yid kyi 'gyur ba mtshon pa'i slad du red/5 rtsom pa bos srog chags byi'u zhig gi nyams 'gyur dang yid kyi 'gyur ba bris pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin/ lan/ gnod skyon thebs pa'i nyam thag pa rnams kyi sems kyi sdug bsngal mtshon pa'i ched du bris/6 〈mchil ba chung chung〉〉 zhes pa'i gtam rgyud 'di'i khungs sne gtso bo gang yin pa red/lan/ rmas skyon phog pa'i byi'u chung gi yid kyi 'gyur ba de dag gis rtsom pa po'i yid sems g.yo bar byed pa de yin/7 〈mchil ba chung chung〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig de'i mtshon bya gang red/lan/ rtsom pa bos nyams chung bar snying rje skyes pa dang gnod 'tshe myong mkhan la sems khur byed pa'i bsam pa'i brtse dung de yin/ 8 6ma pa bos rab btags kyi 'bri thabs spyad nas mchil ba chung chung de bris par legs cha ci zhig yod/lan/ phyi'i rnam pa'i thog nas yid kyi 'gyur ba 'bri tshul sbyong bar phan khe yod/9 〈mchil ba chung chung〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig tu sran ril nag chung lta bu'i mig zung las nga la /86

snying nye bar byed 'dod kyang de 'dra yid rton mi phod pa'i dogs nyams shig shar 'dug’’ ces pa'i tshig 'dis byi'u'i sems khams gang 'dra zhig rtogs thub/lan/ sems khong du sdug yus dang skra ga snang gis khyab pa dang gson pa'i 'dun pa yod na'ang mi la yid rton med pa red/ nga ni mis bsnad pa red de/ mig mdun gyi mi 'dis nga la rogs byed dam zhes 'dod pa red/10 ((mig 'bras nag po zung sngar las che zhing nag gzhan gang la'ang mi lta ba dang 'dra bar nag ril ler che cher bgrad 'dug / ces pa'i tshig 'dis byi'u'i sems khams gang 'dra zhig rtogs thub bam/lan/ re thag chad pa'i bsam pa rtogs thub/11 rtsom pa bos mchil ba chung chung des da lam don ga ge mo zhig rtogs song ba 'dra ’ zhes bris yod pas/ khyod kyis bltas na don ci zhig rtogs pa red/lan/ gshog zung nyams pa'i sdug bsngal rtogs pa dang mi la bzang ngan gyi dbye ba yod de/pa nga la yid ches chog pa rtogs pa 'dra zhes gnyis lnga'i gang yang bris chog12 〈mchil ba chung chung〉 zhes pa'i rtsom yig gi shugs nas ci zhig bstan pa red/lan/ mug nag ge lo rabs sum cu b.ri dma' rim du gnas pa'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs la skyes pa'i khong gi snying rje bstan pa red/12 〈mchil ba chung chung〉/ zhes pa 'di'i brjod bya'i snying bong gang yin/lan/ rtsom pa bos mchil ba chung chung la 'phrad pa'i gegs bar zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud de/brnyas bcos dang gnod 'tshe phog pa'i nyam chung nus med kyi las dbang la gdung sems mnyam skye byed pa dang lhan/ nyam chung tshos phar rgol byas te 'tsho gnas thub rgyu'i 'dun pa 'chang dgos par /87

skul lcag byas yod/mdog 'gyur da byid/1 〈mdog 'gyur da byed〉 ces pa'i rtsom yig 'di gang nas bdams pa yin/ rtsom pa po su yin/lan/ 'di ni 1987 lo'i 〈sbrang char// deb gnyis pa las bdams/ sgyur pa bo lha mchog rgyal yin/ rtsom pa bo chi khi pho (1860—1904) ni dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i dus mjug tu 'dzam gling du skad grags yod pa'i u ru su'i rtsom mkhan zhig yin/2 〈mdog 'gyur da byid〉 ces pa'i brtsams sgrung ni ci 'dra'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i brtsams sgrung zhig red/lan/ de bee zur za'i rang bzhin can gyi brtsams sgrung zhig red/2 〈mdog 'gyur da byid〉/ ces pa'i brtsams sgrung 'di'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo su yin/lan/ o khru'u mor hphu yin/4 da byed ni ci zhig yin/lan/ srog chags shig yin/5 〈mdog 'gyur da byed〉 ces pa'i brtsams sgrung de'i don gyi byung rim ji 'dra yin/lan/ o khru'u mo hphus srang lam du khyi zhig gis mi zhig gi mdzub gu la rmugs pa'i gyod don khrun thag gcod pa'i lo rgyus yin/6 o khru'u mo byu la mdog 'gyur’ ba'i rnam pa ci tsam byung ba dang / de kho'i ci zhig mtshon yod/lan/ thengs drug la mdog 'gyur’’ ba'i rnam pa bris pa des mi sna'i skyug bro ba'i gshis rgyud kye khyad chos ther 'don dang / tha shal gyi yid byed ji bzhin mtshon par byas yod/7 〈mdog 'gyur da byed〉 ces pa'i rtsom 'di'i zhib 'bri byed thabs gtso bo ci yin//88

lan/ gtam gleng la brten nas mi sna'i bsam blo dang gshis rgyud mtshon par byed pa de yin/8 〈mdog 'gyur da byid)/ nang thog mar rtsom pa bos dmag lwa ring bo’ la brten nas o khru'u mor hphu'i ci zhig ngo sprod byas yod/lan/ khong gi thob thang ngo sprod byas yod/9 o khru'u mor hphu la mdog 'gyur da byid’/ ces btags pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/lan/ khong gis lwa ring gyon nas phud pa dang / phud nas gyon pa sogs las bye brag bzhi byas pa de yin no//10 thog mar khyis mgar ba hi li cin la rmugs pa'i don rkyen de ji ltar thag gcod pa dang /mjug mthar ji 'dra zhig tu 'gyur ba red/ lan/ thog mar khyi gsod pa dang khyi'i bdag por chad pa gcod par thag bcad pa dang / mjug mthar khyi gu de snyeng rje bo dang rnam rig can zhig yin la/ mi la rmugs pa de mi 'grig pa med pa ji 'dra'i khyi rgyud pa can zhig red ang ’ ces khyi gu la nyes med dang / mgar ba hi li cin la gshe gshe btang ngo / / 11 rtsom pa bos mdog 'gyur da byid ’ de o khru'u mor hphu bya ba dpe mtshon can du bzhag nas zhib 'bri byas pa la spyi tshogs kyi don snying ci yod/lan/ gong la ngo dga' dang 'og la brnyas bcos 'dzem med byas pa'i skyug bro ba'i rnam pa sun 'byin byas yod/12 〈mdog 'gyur da byed// ces pa'i rtsom yig 'di'i brjod bya gang yin pa dang / rtsom stangs thad khyad chos ci zhig yod/lan/ rtsom yig 'di'i nang spyir btang ba'i nyen rtog pa dang / dpon gnas dang cho lo gtsug tu /89

bkur ba'i u ru su'i spyi tshogs/ rtsub spyod thal che ba'i hra hong sger gcod ring lugs kyi ngan spyod ther 'don byas yod/ rtsom stangs thad nas/ byung don gcig las bris med pas/ don gyi byung ba gcig sdud yin zhing / bsgrigs tshul tshags dam pa/ byung rim gyi bar du 'gyur ldog mi thung ba bcug nas klog pa po'i yid dbang 'gugs pa ma zad/ mi sna zhib 'bri dang khyad chos 'bur du thon pa bcas yin/dogs slong gi snying stobs/1 〈dogs slong gi snying stobs/〉 zhes pa 'di gang nas bdams pa dang / rtsom pa po su yin pa dang /rtsom yig de ji 'dra zhig yin/lan/ rtsom 'di ni dma' 'bring gi rgya'i 〈skad yig/〉 deb bzhi ba (2༅1 lo'i) par las bdams nas bsgyur/ rtsom pa po chi hphan (1913—1986) chin po tha'o yi smyug ming yin zhing / de ni dogs slong gis gnad don rnyed pa sogs dogs slong gi khyad chos dang nus pa gang yin sgrub pa'i dgag sgrub rtsom yig cig red/2 dogs slong bee ci zhig yin pa dang / dogs slong la phan 'bras ji 'dra yod/lan/ dogs slong da bsam gzhig gi thog ma dang zhib 'jug gi kun slong yin/ shes bya mang che ba bee dogs slong las thob pa ste/ gsar btod dang gsar skrun byed pa'ang dogs slong las mgo brtsams pa yin/ dogs slong byed nus pa dang byed par dga' ba'i mi'i klad pa nyin bzhin phun sum tshogs par 'akro ba dang mig dbang nyin bzhin je rdo ru 'akro ba yin/2 〈dogs slong gi snying stobs〉 zhes pa'i rtsom stangs kyi khyad chos gtso bo ci yin pa dang / sgrub thabs ci zhig spyad yod/lan/ drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi sgrub thabs rigs gnyis zung du 'brel ba de yin la/ drang /90

2 bza' chas ni ji 'dra zhig la zer/lan/ bza' chas ni phung bo 'grub byed dang nus tshad 'don byed kyi dngos po la zer/3 bza' chas 'thob pa'i thabs lam la gang dag yod/ lan/ rang gso dang gzhan gso gnyis yod/4 ci zhig rang gso dang ci zhig gzhan gso zer/lan/ rang gso zer ba ni/ sngo ljang gi rtsi shing thams cad 'di'i rigs su gtogs pa dang / dedag so sos skye med rdzas de skye ldan gyi bza' chas su bsgyur nas skye 'phel kyi dgos mkho skong b.rabyed kyin yod/ gzhan gso zer ba ni/ srog chaṭa thams cad dang skye dngos phra rab mang shas shigarigs 'dir gtogs pa dang / de dag so sos bza' chas skrun mi thub pas rtsi shing la brten nasa'atsho dgos/5 ji 'dra zhig la mtshan nyid 'god pa'i thabs zer ba yin/lan/ bya dngos kyi ngo bo dang rang bzhin/ khyad chos sogs gzhir bzung nas de nyid bya dngos gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i nang don dang gnad don gal chen 'bur du thon par byas te/ tshig nyung zhing don gsal ba'i sgo nas gsal bshad byas pa la zer/ma'e ji'i legs skyes/1 rtsom pa po su yin pa phris/lan/ slob tshan 'di'i rtsom pa po o hin res (1862—1910) ni a ri'i sgrung gtam thung gras rtsom mkhan grags can zhig yin/ khong gi mtshon byed sgrung gtam la 〈ma'e ji'i legs skyes〉 dang〈nyer rtog pa dang ye shu'i bstod dbyangs/〉 〈mtha' 'jug gi sba shing lo ma〉 sogs yod/2 6ma 'di'i kha byang ji ltar 'grel/lan/ ma'e ji ni 〈dam pa'i gsung rab// (za༅༵2las/ ye shu ma shu ga sku bltams pa'i dus su shar

phyogs nas ce ru sa lem du yong ste khong la legs skyes phul ba'i mi shes pa can gsum la zer te/pa 'od gsal gyi rgyal bo mer ci or gyis gser ser po phul nas so skyes las 'phags pa’ mtshon par byas/ 'bar sa rtsi yis sman shel ta phul nas ye shu la ma 'ongs par sku bgegs byung nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i snga ltas bstan/ ma'e ji yis ye shu sku bltams par thog mar legs skyes 'bul ba'i srol btod pa yin la/ sgrung gtam nang ma'e ji'i legs skyes zer ba bee lde la dang jem gnyis kyis ye shu'i 'khrungs skar dus chen skabs phan tshun la legs skyes sprod res byas pa dpe bzhag pa yin/3 rtsom 'di'i brjod bya'i snying bo shes sam/ lan/ sgrung gtam 'dir rtsom pa pos 'tsho ba dbul zhing phongs pa'i gzhon nu bza' zla gnyis kyis so so'i snying ltar gces pa'i dngos po blos btang nas phan tshun la legs skyes nyos te ye shu'i 'khrungs skar du sprod res byas pa'i byung rim bris pa brgyud/ skabs de'i a me ri lnga'i mi ser dkyus ma'i 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug mngon par mtshon pa dang sbrags kho tsho'i lhan med kyi rang gshis dang nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i brtse dung la bsngags brjod mdzad pa'o/ /4 rtsom 'di'i rtsom stangs kyi khyad chos brjod dgos/ lan/ sgrung gtam 'dir lde la'i bya byed dngos su bkod pa dang jem gyi bya byed shugs nas mtshon par byas pa ste dngos shugs mnyam sgrub kyi blos bslangs khyad mtshar des sgrung gtam gyi byung rim bskyar zlos med la/ byung rim de las mjug 'bras shes 'dod je cher 'akro ba'i blo kha ngang gis 'phel ba dang bsam bkod phra zhing zhib la/ bya byed dang rnam 'gyur zhib 'bri byas pa las mi sna'i sems kyi 'gyur ba mngon thub cing sgrung gtam gyi mjug 'bras bsam yul las 'das pa ste/ dga' skyo zung 'brel gyi rnam par 'god pa bee o hin res kyi sgrung gtam gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin no/ //93

5 dus rabs nyi shu ba'i stod kyi sgrung thung jom mkhan grags can bzhi ru grags pa rnams ni gang dag yin/lan/ a ri'i sgrung gtam rtsom mkhan grags can o hin res (༅ sko//) dang je khi lon tung ( nga zakhyaza) pho ran si'i mo po sang dang u ru su'i chi kho byu (༅yo ma) bcas yin/khung dbye ci/1 〈khung dbyi ci// rtsom pa bo su yin/lan/ krung go'i deng rabs rlabs che ba'i rtsom rig pa dang / bsam blo ba/ gsar brje ba/ rtsom rig gsar ba'i srol 'byed pa po sku zhabs lu'u zhun (1881—1936) gyis brtsams pa'i sgru nga btam zhig yin/2 〈khung dbyi byu〉 zhes pa'i brjod snying gang yin nam/lan/ de bee bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ring lhags la ngo rgol byed pa'i brtsams chos shig yin la/bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin ring lugs kyi rig gnas slob gsos dma' rim sheng lda na mi ni ra ba/nod skyon tshabs chen btang ba tshur snang byas shing / dpon rgyugs lam lugs kyi nag nyes sogs ther 'don byas yod/〈 〈khung dbyi ci'i〉 rtsom yig las lwa thung gyon mkhan// dang lha ring gyon pa'i masan po’’gnyis gang la ngos 'dzin pa red/lan/ lwa thung gyon mkhan ni 'byor ba zhan pa'i ngal rtsol ba dang / lwa ring gyon mkhan ni sa bdag dang tshong dpon/ dpe cha ba ste mi 'byor ba can la ngos 'dzin pa yin/4 mi sna'i bya spyod dang rnam 'gyur zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud nas khung dbyi cis ci zhig mtshon par byas/lan/ khung dbyi cis khe grags la brtson len byed pa'i bsam blo dang yid sems mtshon par byas yod//94

le'u bdun pa/ rtsom gyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya'i sgor/dang po/ rtsom 'bri'i shes bya/1 spyir rtsom yig la rtsa ba'i 'bri tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na gsum ste/lan/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig dang gsal bshad rtsom yig/ dgag sgrub rtsom yig bcas so/ /2 ci zhig la ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig zer/lan/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom zhes pa ni brjod bya mi dang bya ba la sogs pa rnams gnas dus rang bzhin yul la ji lta ji ltar yod pa de lta de ltar tshul bzhin rtsom thog tu 'god par byed pa'i rtsom tshul la bya/ yang na/ mi dang bya ba brjod byar bkod nas bris pa zhig ste/ des mi dang bya ba ji bzhin brjod pa la brten nas spyi tshogs 'tsho ba tshur snang byas te rtsom pa bo'i bsam blo'i brtse dung mtshon par byed pa zhig la zer/ rtsom 'di'i khyab khongs ha cang rgya che ste/ mi sna gtsor byas nas don brjod pa thams cad la go rigs shing / dper na/ gsar 'gyur dang / ljongs rgyud zin tho/ dran tho/mi sna'i lo rgyus/ gzhan yang lhug rtsom dang reg zig brtag dpyad snyan zhu sogs la ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig zer/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom rnyog 'dzing yin min gyi khyad par ni/ stabs bde'i ji bzhin brjod pa ni/ mi sna nyung ba dang bya ba rnyog 'dzing min pa/ go rim gsal ba/ bsam blo'i brtse dung mtshon pa thad gar yin pa bcas dang / rnyog 'dzing can gyi ji bzhin brjod pa ni bltos sa bltos 'jog gis bshad na bya ba'i brgyud rim cung kyag kyog ldan pa/ mi sna mang ba dang mi sna'i 'brel ba rnyog 'dzing che ba/ bsam blo'i brtse dung dang dgongs don ha cang gting zab bcas yin/2 brjod bya dang rgyu rkyen/lan/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom gyi brjod bya ni mi dang bya ba dang / rgyu rkyen bee dus tshod dang sa gnas/ mi sna/ don dag gi 'byung rkyen dang brgyud rim/ phyis 'byung bcas dang / de dag gi 'brel ba /9

ni gang brjod par de nyid la 'jug pa'i byed pa po mi su yin pa dang / mi des brtsams pa'i bya ba de gang zhig yin pa dang / de dang 'brel ba'i dus dang gnas gang dang yin pa dang / de 'byung ba'i rkyen dang brgyud rim dang 'bras bu ji lta bu yin pa bcas so//3 rnam pa'am nang don gyi cha nas dbye ba/lan/ mi sna dang don dag ljongs rnam/ dngos rnam bcas 'bri ba'i ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom bcas rigs bzhi'o//(1)mi sna gtsor 'bri byed pa'i ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom ni/ mi sna'i phyi'i rnam pa dang skad cha/ bya spyod/ sems khams bcas gtsor bzung nas 'bri dgos/ (2)don dag gtsor bzung nas bris pa'i ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom ni/ bya ba'i slong rkyen dang 'phel rgyas/ brgyud rim/ mjug 'bras bcas gnad du bzung nas 'bri dgos/ (3)ljongs rnam gtsor 'bri byed pa'i ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom ni/yul ljongs kyi rnam pa dang khyad chos 'bri ba la brten nas brtse dung mtshon dgos/ (4)dngos rnam gtsor bzung nas bris pa'i ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig ni/ dngos gzugs bri bya gtsor byas nas rtsom pa bo'i yid 'gyur mtshon thub dgos/4 ja bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom gyi 'bri tshul thad kyi dbye stangs gang dag yin /lan/ go rim ji bzhin brjod pa dang / go rim ldog ste brjod pa/ bar bcug gi brjod pa/ kha gsab kyi brjod pa bcas ste/ (1)go rim ji bzhin brjod pa ni/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig kyang phal che ba gnas tshul gyi thog ma'i byung tshul bar gyi 'phel stangs/ mtha' ma'i mjug bsgril tshul bcas dus tshod snga phyi'i go rim ltar 'bri dgos pa red/ (2)go rim ldog ste ji bzhin brjod pa ni/brjod bya'i dngos po gang zhig gi rjes su byung ba'i gnas tshul sngon la bris te/ sngon la byung ba'i gnas tshul rjes su bris nas rgyu 'bras go ldog gi tshul du bris pa zhig yin/ (3)kha gsab kyi ji bzhin /96
