brjod pa ni/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig 'bri skabs/ brjod bya'i snying bor dmigs te dgos pa'i mi'am bya ba de la kha gsab mdor bsdus shig 'bri dgos pa zhig yin/ (4)bar bcug gi ji bzhin brjod pa ni/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig 'bri skabs brjod bya'i don snying dang 'brel yod kye nang don kha shas yig dkyus su bcug ste 'bri ba zhig yin/5 ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom gyi go rim sgrig stangs gang yin/lan/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig 'bri skabs sngon la gang zhig 'bri ba dang rjes su gang zhig 'bri ba'am yang na mgo ji ltar brtsam pa dang mjug ji ltar bsdu bar bsam blo legs par btang ste sngon la 'di dang rjes la de 'bri ba'i bkod sgrig 'os 'tsham gang legs kyis 'bri ba zhig yin/6 ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig gi 'bri thabs sam mtshon thabs la zhib 'bri dang dpyad gtam/brtse dung / gsal bshad bcas ste/lan/ (1)zhib brjod ni/ mi sna'i myong rgyus dang bya dngos 'phel ba'i 'gyur ldog gi rgyud rim thon par mtshon thub pa'o/ / (2)zhib 'bri ni/ gson nyams ldan pa'i skad chas mi sna dang ljongs dngos zhib phra'i ngang nas zhib 'bri byed pa/ de la khor yug dang mi sna gnyis te/ khor yug zhib 'bri la spyi tshogs khor yug dang rang byung khor yug mi sna zhib 'bri la gzugs ris dang skad cha/ bya spyod/sems khams bcas so/ /(3)dpyad gtam ni/ rtsom pa pos bri bya'i khrod du bkod pa'i mi dang bya bar bton pa'i bsam pa'i 'char snang de la zer/ ④sngon zhib brjod byas nas rjes su dpyad pa gtong pa dang / ④sngon dpyad rjes brjod/ ④dpyad brjod spel ma/ (4)brtse dung ni/ rtsom pa bos bri bya'i khrod du bkod pa'i mi dang don byar rang nyid kyi myong tshor brjod pa de la zer/ ④brgyud nas brtse dung mtshon pa/ ④thad shar brtse dung mtshon pa/ (5)gsal bshad ni/ bya ba gsal bor brjod pa'i phyir bar bcug gi mi de dag nges par du stabs bdes gsal bshad byed pa zhig yin//97

7 ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom gyi brjod bya'i snyeng bo/lan/ gnad don dang gnas lugs shig gsal bor brjod pa de rtsom gyi brjod pa de rtsom gyi brjod bya'i snying bo zer/8 4ma gyi rgyu cha gdam bsal byed tshul/lan/brjod snying gtan 'khel byas rjes snyeng bo de nyid gsal bar byed pa'i dgos mkhor gzhigs te rtsom gyi snying bo dang 'bral med kyi rgyu cha rnams 'dor dgos la/ snying bo dang 'brel yod du gyur pa'i rgyu cha de dag kyang gtso phal gyi khyad par gsal bor 'byed dgos pa'o/ /9 ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom gyi khyad chos gang dag yin/lan/ (1)ji bzhin brjod pa'i zhor du rab btags dang dpe rgyan sogs kyi mtshon thabs spyad pa/(3)mi dang don dag dngos po/ yul ljongs bcas kyi nang don gtso bor byed pa/ (3)brjod rnying gtan khel byas te mi dang / don dag dngos rnam/ ljongs rnam zhib 'bri byed pa/gsal bshad rtsom yig1 ci zhig la gsal bshad rtsom yig zer/lan/ gsal bshad rtsom yig ces pa ni/ bya dngos dang bya dngos kyi gnas lugs brjod pa'i las ci rigs shig rtsom pa bo'i zhib gsal dag gsum thon pa'i tshig gi phreng bas don 'dus shing go sla ba dang rim pa ma 'khrugs par tshags dam pa'i sgo nas zhib brjod dang 'grel bshad kyi tshul du ngo sprod gtsor 'dzin pa dang / yang na gsal bshad byed pa gtsor bzung ste bya dngos dang gnas lugs kyi shes bya mi rnams la ngo sprod pa'i rtsom yig cig la bya'o/ / gsal bshad rtsom yig gi khyab khongs ni lo rgyus dang dngos lugs/ skye dngos skor gyi shes bya'i rang bzhin can gyi dpe deb dang /dpe skrun gyi jus gzhi dang thon rdzas kyi sgrig gzhi'i gsal bshad/ brtsams chos kyi nang don gnad /98

bsdus/ glog brnyan dang zlos gar gyi gnas tshul mtshams sbyor/ tshong zog khyab bsgraṭa soṭa yod do/ /2 gsal byed rtsom yig gi khyad chos ni gang yin/lan/ (1)gsal bshad byed pa gtsor bzung ste zhib brjod dang zhib 'bri/ dpyad gtam bcas mtshon par byed pa/ (2)dngos po'i gzugs dbyibapo dang ngo bo/ 'byung rkyen/ grub tshul/ spyod sgo/phan nus/ rigs dbye sogs ngo sprod kha gsal byed pa/ (3)gnas lugs kye go don dang khyad chos/'gyur ldog bcas kyi nang don gtso bor byed pa/ (4)phyi rol yul gyi bden don rmang gzhi byed pa las rang gi 'dod blo'am yid 'gyur mtshon mi rung ba/ yang na/ dngos po'i rang bzhin dang shes bya'i rang bzhin/ gsal bshad rang bzhin bcas ldan dgos pa/3 gsal byed rtsom yig gi dbye ba gang yin/lan/ gsal bshad rtsom yig la rnam grangs ha cang mang bas/ dbye 'byed kyi tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rigs kyang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs su dgar chog nga tshos rgyun du mthong ba ni 'di dag ste/(1)gsal bshad bya yul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ bya dngos zhib brjod kyi gsal bshad rtsom yig dang gnas lugs gsal 'grel gyi gsal bshad rtsom yig rigs gnyis so/ / (2)rtsom yig gi nang don dang mtshon thabs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mtshams sbyor rang bzhin gyi gsal bshad rtsom yig dang / zhib 'bri rang bzhin gyi gsal bshad rtsom yig zhib brjod rang bzhin gyi gsal bshad rtsom yig gsal 'grel rang bzhin gyi gsal bshad rtsom yig bcas rigs bzhi'o/ / (3)rtsom 'bri'i spyod sgo dang khyab khongs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ spyir btang gi gsal bshad rtsom yig dang /rig rtsal gyi gsal bshad rtsom yig nyer spyod kyi gsal bshad rtsom yig bcas gsum mo/ /4 gsal bshad rtsom yig gi byed thabs gang dag yod/lan/ spyir gsal bshad rtsom yig la phyi rol yul gyi dngos po'i rnam pa dang chos nyid/ gsal /99

bshad bya yul du gyur pa'i nang don sna tshogs su 'dug kyang 'dir rgyun du mthong ba'i gsal bshad bya thabs gtso bo 'di dag ste/ (1)nges tshig 'dren pa'i thabs/ skad cha la brten nas yang dag cing go sla ba'i bya dngos kyi khyad chos dang rang bzhin/ go don gsal bor bkral nas klog pa por nges don rtogs par byed pa zhig yin/ (2)dpe 'god pa'i thabs/ brjod 'dod kyi don de kha gsal 'byung ba'i ched de dang 'dra ba'i bya dngos gang zhig dper drangs te gsal bar byed pa zhig yin/ (3)rigs dgar ba'i thabs/ yang dag pa'i tshad gzhi zhig gzhir bzung ste rnyog 'dzing can gyi bya dngos rnams so sor dgar ba zhig yin/ (4)bsdur ba'i thabs/ rigs 'dra ba'am mi 'dra ba'i dngos po gnyis phan tshun bsdur nas brjod don gsal bor ston pa zhig ste/ dper na drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs/ sngon dang deng gi khyad par bsdur ba lta bu'o/ / (5)lung 'dren pa'i thabs/gsal bshad byed par 'brel ba yod pa'i bstan bcos dang gtam rgyud/ legs bshad/ snyan tshig sogs drangs te brjod don gsal bor ston pa zhig yin/ (6)grangs ga 'god pa'i thabs/ bya dngos kyi ngo bo dang khyad chos gsal ston byed pa'i ched du mang nyung dang che chung sogs kyi grangs ga bkod pa zhig yin/ (7)re'u mig 'god pa'i thabs/ dpe rus dang grangs sha sogs kyi rnam pa re'u mig tu bkod de bya dngos gsal bshad byed pa zhig yin/ (8)dpe bsdur pa'i thabs/ bya dngos dang gnas lugs kyi snang tshul dpe'i steng nas bsdur te gsal bor ston pa zhig yin/ (9)lad mo byed pa'i thabs/ gsal bshad bya yul gyi dngos po'i dbyibs gzugs lad 'bri byas te gsal bshad byed pa zhig yin/ (10) 'grel bshad byed pa'i thabs/ bya dngos gang rung zhig gi ngo bo'am khyad chos nges tshig sogs la brten nas zhib phra'i sgo nas 'grel bshad byed pa zhig yin/5 gsal bshad rtsom yig gi skad cha'i khyad chos/lan/ gsal bshad rtsom yig ni klog pa bor bya dngos kyi khyad chos dang ngo bo/ grub tshul/ phan 200

nus sogs ngo sprod pa dang gnas lugs shig 'grel bshad byed pa'i ched du yin pas/ skad cha'am tshig gi phreng ba spel bar mdor bsdus shing gnad la khel ba dang / tshags dam zhing kha gsal go bde'i nus pa thon dgos pa las brda rnying / mngon brjod sogs bkol nas tshig rgyan spel ba'i rigs spangs te bya dngos dang gnas lugs gsal bshad byed pa'i thebs su 'gro bar bya dgos/6 gsal bshad rtsom yig gi go rim sgrig stangs/lan/ gsal bshad byed yul mi 'dra ba gzhir bzung nas gsal bshad byed pa'i go rim sgrig pa la byed thabs gtso bo gsum ste/ gcig gnas kyi go rim ltar gsal bshad byed stangs ni gong nas zhol dang / nye sa nas ring sa/ sngon nas rjes/ phyi nas nang / g.yas nas g.yon/ khag gcig nas hril bo bcas dang / gnyis dus kyi go rim ltar gsal bshad byed stangs ni bya dngos 'phel rgyas kyi byung rim dang / bzo rtsal gyi bzo rim/ ngos 'dzin gyi brgyud rim dang / gtan tshigs kyi go rim ltar gsal bshad byed stangs ni spyi nas bye brag go sla ba nas don zab pa/ grangs tshad nas spus tshad/ rgyu nas 'bras bu bcas bya dngos dang gnas lugs kyi phyogs gtso phal gang yin rung rim pa ltar gsal bshad byas pa ni mi rnams la shes rtogs gsal bo zhig yong ba'i phyir ro/ /dgag sgrub rtsom yig1 dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi go do na/lan/ dgag sgrub ces pa ni gzhan lugs kyi nor 'khrul lta ba dgag ste rang lugs kyi yang dag lta tshul thad ldan du sgrub pa zhig ste/ gang brjod par bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yang dag rtags su bkod nas rang gi lta tshul bden no zhes legs par sgrub cing pha rol pa'i nor 'khrul la dgag pa rgyag pa'i rtsom zhig la zer/2 dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi khyad chos/20/

lan/ lta ba gang zhig sgrub pa'am dgag pa gtso bor byed pa'i cha nas rtsom rigs de la rigs pa'i gzhung lugs nges can zhig yod pa dang / gtan tshigs tshad ldan la bstun pa/ gnad don dngos la dmigs nas don dngos dang zung du 'brel ba bcas so/ /3 dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi grub cha/lan/ dgag sgrub rtsom yig la rang lugs sgrub pa'i phyogs nas bsgrub bya dang / sgrub byed/ sgrub rim bcas gsum dang / gzhan lugs dgag pa'i phyogs nas dgag bya dang / dgag byed/ dgag rim bcas gsum ste/ mthar gtugs kyis 'bab sa ni bsgrub bya dang / sgrub byed/ sgrub rim bcas kyi grub cha gsum mo/ /(1) bsgrub bya/④bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid/ bsgrub bya ni rtsom pa bos rgyu mtshan ci rigs bkod pa'i sgo nas gang ra sprod par bya ba'i rang gi lta ba dang 'dod tshul de la zer/ ①bsgrub bya'i re 'dun/ bsgrub bya la rtsa ba'i re 'dun gnyis te/ gcig yang dag pa dang gnyis gsal bo yin dgos/ yang dag pa ni mar khe si ring lugs dang / ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa/ tung zha'o phing gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kye tshan rig ge bden don dang phyi rol yul gyi don dngos dang mthun dgos pa/ gsal bo ni rtsom pa bo'i langs phyogs dang rnam 'gyur/ der spyad pa'i skad cha bcas gsal bo yin dgos/ ④bsgrub bya'i dbye ba/ snyeng bor gyur pa'i bsgrub bya dang bye brag gi bsgrub bya gnyis te/ bsgrub bya'i snying bo ni/ rtsom hril bor bsgrub bya gcig ma gtogs med na bsgrub bya de ni rtsom de'i bsgrub bya'i snyeng bo yin zhing /gal te rtsom yig cig la bsgrub bya 'ga' re yod na/ de'i khrod du gtso bor gyur ba'i bsgrub bya ni rtsom de'i bsgrub bya'i snying bo'o/ / bsgrub bya bye brag pa ni/ bsgrub bya'i snyeng bo la ram 'degs byed pa'i bsgrub bya gzhan dag la bsgrub bya bye brag pa zer ro/ / ④bsgrub bya 'god tshul/ bsgrub bya de nyid tshig 202

gi phreng bar bstar tshe dgos mkhor gzhigs nas rtsom gyi kha byang du 'god pa'am/ yang na dkyil du ston pa dang / de bzhin rtsom yig gi mjug tu phyogs sdom gyi tshul du dgod pa sogs thabs sna tshogs kyis bstan chog go/ /(2)sgrub byed/④sgrub byed mtshan nyid/sgrub byed ni rtsom pa bos rang gi bsgrub bya de yang dag yin pa bden dbang byed par drangs pa'i rgyu mtshan dang khungs lung yin/①sgrub byed kyi dbye ba/'di la dbye na gnyis te don dngos dang gnas lugs yin/ don dngos ni mngon sum gyi sgrub byed yin la/ lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang mtshon dpe/ grangs kyi sdom rtsis sogs 'dir gtogs pa dang / gnas lugs ni rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi sgrub byed yin zhing / gsung rab kyi tshig tshan rig gi rtsa ba'i rig pa/ legs bshad/ bslab bya/ gtam dpe/ dpe mtshon gtam sogs 'dir gtogs pa'o/ / ④sgrub byed gdam gsal byed pa'i rtsa ba'i re 'dun/dang bo bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed gnyis gcig mthun yin dgos/ gnyis pa/ sgrub byed kyi khungs btsun zhing yang dag pa yin dgos/ gsum pa/ sgrub byed la dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan dgos/ bzhi ba sgrub byed gsal bo yin dgos pa bcas so /(3)sgrub rim/༷sgrub rim gyi mtshan nyid/sgrub rim ni sgrub byed la brten nas bsgrub bya bden dpang byed pa'i go rim dang byed thabs 203

yin/④sgrub rim gyi dbye ba/ sgrub rim la rang lugs 'jog pa dang gzhan lugs dgag pa gnyis te/rang lugs 'jog pa ni drang phyogs nas dri ba 'don pa dang rtsom pa po'i lta tshul lam 'dod tshul zhib par bshad pa de yin/ gzhan lugs dgag pa ni ldog phyo gas kyi lta tshul sun 'byin pa dang dgag nas rtsom pa po'i rang gi yang dag pa'i lta tshul lam nadod tshul zhib par bshad pa de yin/'di gnyis la 'brel ba dam po mchis te dgag pa dang ga'/ga pa gnyis ni rtsod sgrub kyi gcig 'du yin pas/ rang lugs 'jog pa'i rtsom du bsgrub bya yang dag de gsal bshad gang zab yong ched/skabs 'gar gzhan gyi nor 'khrul la dgag pa rgyag degos pa'ang yod la/ yang gzhan lugs dgag pa'i rtsom du gzhan gyi nor 'khrul la dgag pa rgyags pa dang mnyam du rang gi lta tshul yang dag ste gsal bshad byed dgos pa'ang yod do/ /4 dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi rgyun mthong gi sgrub rim sgrig gzhi/lan/ rjodo mnyam gyi rnam pa ni/ sgrub rim gyi khrod du rtsom gyi rim pa kha shas dang / tshan pa kha shas bar gyi 'brel ba ni mnyam gshib yin pas de la do mnyam gye rnam pa zer/ ①bsdur thabs kyi rnam pa ni/ sgrub rim gyi khrod du bya dngos rigs gnyis phan tshu na bsdur ba byed pa'am/ yang na bya dngos rigs gzhan la brten nas bya dngos che ge mo zhig gzhogs spros byed pa zhig la zer/ ④rim 'jug gi rnam pa ni/ rtsom gyi go rim so so'i bar ni rim pa bar gting je zab tu 'gro zhing / gom pa rim 'gros kyis rigs 'ded byed pa'i 'brel ba zhig yin la/ rim pa so so'i snga phyi'i go rim 'jog stangs thad re ba nan mo zhig yod pas gang byung du bzo bcos byed mi chog pa zhig la zer/ ④spyi bye brag gi rnam pa ni/ sgrub rim gyi rim pa phan tshun bar spyi dang bye brag bshad pa'i 'brel ba de la zer/ ⑤sgrub rim gyi rigs 'ded thabs ni/ sgrub rim nang rgyun du bkol ba'i rigs 'ded thabs ni phyogs bsdus rigs 'ded dang rnam 'byed rigs 'ded gnyis te/ ④phyogs bsdus 204

rigs 'ded ni/ bye brag nas spyir btang la rigs 'ded thabs te/ dpe don bye brag pa mang bo'i dbye zhib las spyir btang gi sdom tshig phyogs bsdus byed pa la zer/ khyarnam 'byed rigs 'ded ni/spyir btang nas bye brag tu rigs 'ded thabs shig ste/ shes zin pa'i spyir btang gi rtsa ba'i rigs pa gzhir bzung nas bya dngos bye brag pa'i sdom tshig rigs 'ded byed pa la zer/ ①rigs 'ded thabs ni/ spyir btang du gnas lugs sgrub byed du drangs te bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i skabs su spyod pa yin/ der spyir btang du sgrub byed snga ma dang sgrub byed phyi ma/ sdom tshig bcas ste/ sgrub byed snga ma ni spyir btang gi rtsa don zhig sngon du btang ba la zer ba dang / sgrub byed phyi ma ni bsgrub bya'i bya dngos bye brag pa gang de gsal bar bstan pa la zer/ sdom tshig bee sgrub byed snga phyi'i nang nas rigs pas bsgrub nas grub pa'i lta ba la zer ba'o/ /5 dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi rtsa ba'i sgrig gzhi/ lan/sgrig gzhi bkod sgrig byed pa ni/ bsgrub bya'i snying bo gsal bshad byed pa'i dgos dbang ltar gcig gyur byed pa'i nges pa med/ yin na'ang dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi sgrig gzhi'i rtsa ba'i rnam pa ni spyir btang du gnad don 'don pa dang / gnad don dbye zhib byed pa/ gnad don thag gcod pa'i rtsa don ltar rtsom gyi mgo 'dzin pa dang / gzhung dngos/ mjug bsdu ba bcas khag gsum du dbye yod/ ①mgo 'dzin pa ni gnad don 'don pa dang bsgrub bya gsal ston byed pa/ brjod don 'don pa bcas yin la/ de'i las 'gan ni gnad don 'don pa dang brjod don phyi mar rmang gzhi 'ding rgyu de yin/ ①gzhung dngos ni rtsom gyi snying bo yin/ de'i las 'gan ni gnad don la dbye zhib byed pa yin/ rjomajug bsdu ba ni rtsom yig 'phel rgyas kyi rang byung gi mtha' 'bras yin/6 dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi sgrub thabs gang dag yin/lan/ ④dpe yis sgrub thabs da don ngangos sgrub byed du byas te jape yi sgo nas bsgrub bya bang khril 2(3

sgrub pa'i thabs la zer/ ④lung gis sgrub thabs ni mkhas pa'i gsung dang gtam dpe sogs sgrub byed du drangs nas bsgrub bya ra sprod pa la zer/ ④dpe mtshon gyi sgrub thabs ni dpe mtshonagyi bya dngos sgrub byed du bkol nas bsgrub bya sgrub par byed pa'i thabs la zer/④rigs 'gres sgrub thabs ni shes zin pa'i dpe mtshon nas de dang 'dra ba'i dpe mtshon gzhan la rigs 'gres nas bsgrub bya ra sprod byed thabs shig la zer/ ①bsdur ba'i sgrub thabs ni ngo bo 'gal zlar gyur pa'am khyad par yod pa'i bya dngos rigs gnyis phan tshun bsdur ba zhig la zer/ ④ldog pa'i sgrub thabs ni ldog phyogs kyi bsgrub bya zhig gis sdom tshig nor 'khrul can zhig drangs te rgyu mtshan gsal bshad byed pa'i thabs shig la zer/7 dgag sgrub rtsom yig gi skad cha'i khyad chos gang yin/lan/ gnad du khel ba'i rang bzhin ldan dgos/ kha gsal gyi rang bzhin ldan dgos/ mdor bsdus kyi rang bzhin ldan dgos/ gson nyams kyi rang bzhin ldan dgos/ 8 dgag sgrub dang gsal bshad dang ji bzhin brdzod pa'i rtsom yig bar gyi 'brel ba dang khyad par/lan/ rtsom 'bri pa'i dmigs yul dang rgyu cha/ mtshon thabs mi 'dra ba la brten nas rtsom gyi rigs 'di dag byung ste/ dgag sgrub rtsom yig ni rtsom pa bo rang gi lta ba dang 'dod tshul gzhan la ra sprod byed pa dang / gsal bshad rtsom yig ni bya dngos kyi khyad chos dang ngo bo/ phan nus/ spyod sgo gzhan la gsal bor ston pa/ ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig ni mi sna'i skad cha dang bya spyod/ bya ba'i brgyud rim la brten nas rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i brtse dung mtshon par byed pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang de dag rang rkya thub par gnas pa zhig ma yin par gcig la gcig rten gyi rtsod sgrub 'brel ba 206

mchis te/ dgag sgrub rtsom yig nang du ji bzhin brjod pa dang gsal bshad rtsom yig 'dres pa dang / gsal bshad rtsom yig nang du dgag sgrub dang ji bzhin brjod pa 'dres pa dang / ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom yig nang du gsal bshad dang dgag sgrub 'dres pa'i rtsom yig kyang shin tu mang /gtso bo rtsom yig re re'i rang mtshan gsal byed kyi khyad chos steng nas thag sne'i mdud pa bkrol ba bzhin rang rang sa nas bshig par 'gyur ba de'o/ /gnyis pa/ rtsom rig shes bya/spyir rtsom rig la/ spyir btang gi rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal rtsom rig ste/ de gnyis kyi khyad par rtog rigs dang / brjod bya'i don bden rdzun dang / rjod byed tshig gi nyams 'don tshul sogs kyi steng nas phye ba yin zhes dang / mtshan nyid rig pa'i gzhung dang 'grel bshad/ tshan rig rig gnas kyi gzhung / lo rgyus/ deb ther/ chab srid kyi yig cha zin bris/ skur yig byas rjes drang por brjod pa'i rnam thar rtogs brjod sogs spyir btang gi rtsom rig khongs su gtogs shing / snyan tshig zlos gar/sgrung dang gtam rgyud/ glu gzhas sogs sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi khongs su gtogs pa yin zhes dor zhi rin po ches 〈rtsom rig gsar ba'i gnad don 'ga' zhig gleng ba〉 las gsungs pa bzhin 'dir brjod par bya ba ni sgyu rtsal rtsom rig yin te/ 'di la lhug rtsom dang / snyan ngag sgrung gtam/ zlos gar rtsom rig bcas bzhi ru dbye ba'o/ /207

lhug rtsom/1lhug rtsom gyi go don/ lhug rtsom ni snyan rtsom dang / brtsams sgrung / 'khrab gzhung rtsom rig ma yin pa/ gang zhig tshigs kyi rgang bas ma bcang pa'i rtsom rig mtha' dag la zer/2 lhug rtsom kyi dbye ba/mtshon thabs kyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba la brten nas lhug rtsom la don brjod lhug rtsom dang dung sems mtshon nga 'i lhug rtsom/ dpyad brjod lhug rtsom bcas dbye ba gsum byung ste/①don brjod lhug rtsom ni mi sna dang don bya 'bri rgyu gtsor byas nas rtsom pa pos 'tsho bar ngos 'dzen dang myong tshor mtshon par byed pa zhig la zer/ dper na/ 〈rkang lam phra mo〉 lta bu'o/ /dung sems mtshon nga/'i ldug rtsom ni rtsom pa bo'i nang bsam pa'i 'gyur ba mtshon pa gtso bor byas pa'i rtsom thabs shig la zer/ dper na 〈pad jing gi zla 'od〉〉 lta bu'o/ / ⑤dpyad brjod lhug rtsom ne sgrub byed dam rgyu mtshan cha tshang min la ma ltos par bsgrub bya'i chos gang zhig sgrub par byed pa'i chul gyi lhug rtsom gyi rnam pa zhig yin/ yang na gnas lugs brjod pa gtsor byas pa'i lhug rtsom gyi rnam pa zhig ste/ dper na ko ar ci'i 〈dus tshod)) lta bu'o/ /3 lhug rtsom gyi khyab chos/de brjong bya rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / khyertsom stangs rang dbang ldan la yul dus kyi tshad bkag med pa/ rjobarjod byed tshig sbyor rna bar snyan zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa bcas te/〈snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus〉〉 las/ /yul gyi don snang yid 'gul thebs pa'i gzhir/ /sems kyi 'char snang ci dgar spel ba'i ris /snyan ro ldan pa'i tshig gi mdangs bkra ba /mu tig bstar la brgyus 'dra'i lhug rtsom bsngags/ / zhes gsungs so/ /2()8

snyan ngag1snyan ngag gi go don/snyan ngag ni sgra dog 'jug gi dbang du byas nas brjod na/ dbyangs kyi 'degs 'jog mngon par gsal zhing ches gcig sdud kyi sgo nas don mtshon pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig yin/2 snyan ngag gi dbye ba/rtsom rig 'phel rgyas 'gro ba dang bstun nas snyan ngag dbye ba ha cang mang ste/ 'dir ngo bo dang rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye na gsham gsal ltar/du)nang don thad kyi dbye ba/dung sems mtshon pa'i snyan ngag dang don brjod snyan ngag gnyis te/ dung sems mtshon pa'i snyan ngag ni gtam rgyud kyi byung rim mi dgos par rtsom pa bo'i bsam pa'i brtse dung thad shar spyi tshogs 'tsho bar tshur snang byas te mtshon par byed pa zhig la zer/ dper na/ sartswa thang dran glu〉 lta bu'o/ /donabarjod snyan ngag ni mi sna dang don bya 'bri bar brten nas rtsom pa bo'i bsam blo'i brtse dung mtshon par byed pa zhig yin/ dper na 〈rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud〉 lta bu'o/ /0rnam pa'i thad kyi dbye ba/srol rgyun snyan ngag dang rang mos snyan ngag gnyis te/ srol rgyun snyan ngag ni tshig rkang bzhi rer sho lo sha gcig tu rtsis ba'i tshan pa las grub cing / sho lo ga gcig gi nang tshig rkang phan tshun bar tsheg khyim grangs mang nyung ma shor gcod mtshams gcig tu nges pa zhig la zer/ dper na 〈dpyid dus kyi bod ljongs〉/ lta bu'o/ /rang mos snyan ngag ni tsheg bar dang rkang ba'i grangs la nges pa med par rtsom pa bo'i bsam blo'i brtse dung ltar gang bder 'bri chog pa zhig la zer/ dper na 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉/ lta bu'o/ /2(9

3 snyan ngag gi khyad chos/④gcig sdud kyi rang bzhin ldan pa/snyan ngag cig yin phyir nges par du nang don thad tshad mtho gcig sdud kyis spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon dgos pa dang / rnam pa'i thad gnad la 'khel zhing don zab mo mtshon thub par ma zad tshig mdzes pa zhig dgos/ snyan rtsom la nang don dang rnam pa gnyis shar tshad mtho'i gcig sdud cig ma byung na/ gang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i lus kyi rnam pa'ang gzhi nas rtsom lus gzhan dang khyad med lta bur 'gyur nyen che'o/ /④'char sgo phun sum tshogs pa/rtsom pa po'i 'char sgo ni glog ltar myur zhing ro brgya'i zas ltar phun sum tshogs pas/ dper na ge sar gyi sgrung lta bu yin pa dang / snyan ngag la rtsom rig gzhan las kyang ches phun sum tshogs pa'i 'char sgo zhig dgos so/ /④brtse dung gis phyug dgos pa/snyan ngag la brtse dung gis phyug pa bee rtsom pa bo'i nang bsam pa'i dga' skyo chags sdang shugs drag las byung ba'i rnam rtog dang myong ba yin te/ rtsom mkhan rang nyid la bya dngos la 'dzin pa'i bsam pa'i brtse dung ngam myong ba gting zab cig med na/ nang don spyir btang ba zhig gzhan la ji ltar sgrog kyang mgu bar mi byed do/ /rjodabyangs kyi 'degs 'jog gsal ba/ snyan ngag ni klog pa'i tshe tshegs med bde blag tu ngag lam la lhang lhang du thon zhing tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs la gdangs kyi 'degs 'jog dang 'gyur khug gsal zhing dbyangs nyams kyis mdzes ba zhig yin dgos/ 〈 snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus 〉/ las/ dga' skyo chags sdang khong nas brdol ba'i 2/0

brten nas grub pa'i rang byung gi cha rkyen dang / rang byung gi nam zla/ rang byung gi snang yul bcas la bstan pa red/ spyi tshogs khor yug ni spyi tshogs kyi dus skabs dang lam lugs/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs dang gral rim gyi dbye ba/ spyi tshogs kyi tshogs pa dang rang gi 'byung khungs dang / sbyong stobs kyi yon tan dang 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang lo rgyus/ las rigs dang mi phan tshun bar gyi 'brel ba dang yul srol goms gshis la sogs pa'i rkyen sna tshogs la bya'o/ /na sgrung rtsom gyi dbye ba/①sgrung rtsom gyi ring thung dang nang don shong tshad kyi steng nas dbye na bzhi ste/ sgrung rtsom ring ba dang dper na 〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉 lta bu/ sgrung rtsom 'bring ba/ dper na 〈ā 9 yi rnam thar〉 lta bu/ sgrung rtsom thung pa/ dper na 〈mjug mtha'i slob thun gcig〉/ sgrung rtsom ches thung ba dper na 〈lham bzo〉 lta bu/ sgrung thung yig brgya ma ni sgrung rtsom ches thung ba'i gras su tshud do/ /④sgrung rtsom gyi nang don steng nas dbye na lo rgyus sgrung rtsom dang / tshan rig rtog 'gyu'i sgrung rtsom/gyod gzhi sgrung rtsom/ dregs rtsal sgrung rtsom/ yig skad sgrung rtsom/ rnam thar sgrung rtsom/ zur za'i sgrung rtsom/ lha 'dre'i sgrung rtsom sogs so/ / ④sgrung rtsom gyi mtshon thabs steng nas dbye na mtha' dpyod dngos yod ring lugs pa'i sgrung rtsom dang / rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs pa'i sgrung rtsom/ gsar brje dngos yod ring lugs pa'i sgrung rtsom bcas so/ /0sgrung rtsom gyi skad cha'i rnam pa'i steng nas dbye na yig skad kyi sgrung rtsom dang phal skad kyi sgrung rtsom gnyis so/ /4 sgrung rtsom gyi khyad chos/— 2

④mi sna'i snang brnyan phyogs yongs nas phra zhib rang mtshan can du bskrun pa/①gtam rgyud kyi byung rim gyi bkod pa bde blag tu sgrig cing sbyor ba/ ༷khor yug bkod 'bri zhib cing tshogs la gson nyams dang ldan pa bcas te 〈snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus〉 las/yul dus rang bzhin ma 'dres rang mtshan gyi/ /khyad chos ldan pa'i mi dang de 'brel don/ /bden bden 'dra ba rtog btags byas pa las/ /khyab che'i rang bzhin mthong thub sgrung gi gnad/ / ces gsungs pa'o/ /zlos gar rtsom rig1khros gar rtsom rig gi go don/rjozlos gar ni gar stegs su 'khrab ston byed pa'i sna 'dzoms rang bzhin can gyi sgyu rtsal zhig ste/rtsom rig dang rol dbyangs/ zhabs bro/ mdzes rtsal gyi sgyu rtsal thabs shes la brten nas gar stegs sgyu rtsal gyi gzugs brnyan gsar bzhengs byed pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba rjen par bton nas dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod mtshon par byas pa zhig yin/ zlos gar la 'khrab gzhung dang 'khrab mkhan/gar stegs kyi 'khrab chas dang / rol dbyangs dang zhabs bro sogs kyis grub la/ de'i nang gi 'khrab gzhung ni zlos gar 'khrab ston gyi gzhi 'dzin sa dang rmang gzhi yin/④zlos gar 'khrab gzhung ni gar stegs su 'khrab ston byed par dmigs nas brtsams pa'i rtsom rig gi khongs su gtogs pa'i zlos gar rtsom rig cig la bya'o/ /2 'khrab gzhung dang zlos gar gyi 'brel ba/'di gnyis ni thag pa rkya 'tham pa lta bu'i gcig la gcig rten gyi 'brel ba'i bdag nyid can zhig ste/ 'khrab gzhung ni 'khrab ston gyi brjod bya'i gzhung bye brag kho nar go ba dang de'ang ngag gi sbyor 2/3

ba'i bstan bcos kyi tshul du grub pa/ zlos gar ni spyi mtshan la nges te 'khrab ston dang 'khrab gzhung /mdzes rtsal ri mo bcas kyi 'khrab ston byed las la bya'o/ /3 bos gar rtsom rig la zlos gar gyi gdong thug dang zlos gar gyi skad cha gnyis mchis/rjozlos gar gyi gdong thug ni dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi 'gal 'du sna tshogs phyogs bsdus su ngar blud nas ltag sprod kyi tshul du mngon par sbyar zhing spel ba yin/ de ni zlos gar gyi grub cha gtso bo yin pas/ gdong thug med na zlos gar zhes pa'ang yod mi srid/ zlos gar khrod mi sna'i gral rim gyi langs phyogs dang chab srid kyi lta ba/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab/ rig gnas kyi blo sbyong / 'tsho ba'i khror yug sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ spyi tshogs kyi dngos yod gnas tshul gcig pa'i steng la rnam 'gyur mi gcig pa 'dzin srid pa de las/ 'gal ba dang gdong thug rnam pa sna tshogs byung ba red/④zlos gar gyi skad cha ni zlos gar gyi 'gal thub/ mtshon par byed pa'i thabs shes gal che zhig yin te/ de la dbye na mi sna'i skad cha dang gar stegs kyi skad cha gnyis yod/ gar stegs gsal byed ni gar stegs 'khrab tshan de'i mgo dang mjug gtam gleng gi bar bcas su bkod yod pa dang / nang don la mi sna ngo sprod dang dus tshod/ sa gnas/ rgyan gos/ 'khrab chas/ rgyab ljongs/ gzhan mi sna'i rnam pa'i 'gyur ba dang bya byed/ 'akro 'dug sogs 'dus so/ /4 zlos gar gyi skad cha'i khyad chos/lan/ (1)gar mi la bya byed rang bzhin gyi phyug dgos la/ 'khrab gzhung gi nang don gong spel du gtong thub dgos/(2)skad cha ni rang gshis dang mtshon shugs yod dgos/(3)skad cha ni tshig rdo zhing sdud che ba zhig yin dgos/(4)skad cha de snyan zhing 'jebs la ngag la bde ba/ go sla ba bcas yin dgos/2/4

(5)zlos gar rtsom rig gi dbye ba/①zlos gar gyi rnam pa dang mtshon thabs kyi sgo nas dbye na gtam brjod zlos gar dang glu gar/ bro gar sogs so/ / ④zlos gar gyi nang don dang sgrig gzhi'i steng nas dbye na 'khrab tshan rkyang ba dang 'khrab tshan du ma gnyis so/ / ④brjod bya'i dus rabs kyi dbang gi dbye na lo rgyus zlos gar dang deng rabs zlos gar gnyis te/ dper na 〈rgya bza' kong jo〉 dang 〈su ru'i me tog〉lta bu'o/ / ④'gal ba dang gdong thug gi ngo bo'i steng nas mya ngan skyed pa'i zlos gar dang / dga' zhing rgod bro ba'i zlos gar/ 'dres ma'i zlos gar du dbye ba'o/ /pa zlos gar rtsom rig gi khyad chos/lan/ (1)'khrab gzhung de nges par du gar stegs kyi 'khrab ston dang 'tsham dgos/(2)'khrab gzhung la nges par du gcig sdud dang dza drag che ba'i 'gal ba'i gdong thug yod dgos/ (3)mi sna'i skad cha dang bya byed de nges par du rang rang gi thob thang dang gshis sha'i khyad chos dang 'tsham dgos/〈snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus〉 las/mi dang don gyi 'gal 'brel lhu 'brel ba'i /byung rabs nang gi rtsa gnad re gnyis shig /khol bur bton te ston cing gnad che ba'i/ /nyung bsdus lab gleng rtsal thon 'khrab gzhung gnad/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /2/3

〈snyan ngag me long〉 gi gzhi rtsa'i shes bya/1snyan ngag me long gi mtshan thogs tshul/〈snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron// las/ de ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ brjod bya zab cing rgya che ba dang rjod tshig bcad lhug spel ma gsum du dbye ba lus dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pas bsdus pa'i rgyan gyi bye brag mtha' yas pa'i snyan ngag gang zhig bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi nang du gsal bar 'char bas me long ste/ 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 2 snyan ngag me long gi mdzad pa bo byung ba'i dus rabs/slob dpon dadhi'am dbyug pa can ni dus rabs bdun pa'i nang du byon pa ste srong btsan sgam po dang dus mtshungs par mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gsungs so/ /3 snyan ngag me long bod du dar ba'i dus rabs/dus rabs bcu gnyis pa dang bcu gsum pa'i nang du sa paṇa gyis mkhas mjug gi nang du thor re long nge ba zhig bsgyur/ rjes su 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i sku ring la sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du padhita la kim sha ra dang lo tsā ba shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis gzhung rdzogs par bsgyur/dpang lo tsā bas 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas rgya cher spel ba yin no/ /4 snyan ngag me long ma dar gong bod la snyan ngag yod pa/dmangs khrod kyi glu dang la gzhas/ thon mis rgyal bo srong btsan sgam por phul ba'i yig phud lta bu sogs dang / spyir bshad na snyan ngag me long bod la ma dar gong snyan ngag gi gzhung ma byung ba ma gtogs snyan ngag yod do/ /5 rgya gar gyi snyan ngag me long gi 'grel ba grags can gnyis ga2 6

parnyita ratna shris mdzad pa'i 'brel ba dang paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i 'grel ba gnyis yin par 〈tshangs sras bzhad sgra〉 las gsungs so/ /6 bod kyi snyan ngag me long gi 'grel ba grags can gyi dpe mtshon 'ga'/dbyangs can mgul rgyan dang / mi 'jigs seng ge nga ro/ dbyangs can pagyes pa'i rol mtsho/dbyangs can dgyes glu/ yang gsal snang mdzod/ tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed/ tshangs sras bzhad sgra sogs so/ /7 snyan ngag me long gi 'grel ba dbyangs can dgyes glu soṭa bod kyi snyan gzhung yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/〈snyan ngag la 'jug pa'i sgo// las/ bod kyi mkhas pa dag gis bod kyi skad yig steng brtsams pa'i rgyan 'di dag ni bod kyi skad yig dang / bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i brda sprod gzhir bzhag pa'i steng / tshig dang don gyi snyan pa'i ro phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan so so'i nyams ni rtsa ba'i rgya dpe dang 'dra bar brjod pa tsam yin pas na/ de la bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan ngag ces bshad pa yin/ zhes gsungs so/ // snyan ngag me long gi sho lo sa drug brgya dang nga drug po/ snyan ngag me long gi gzhung tshad la le'u dang bor sho lo ga brgya dang lnga/ le'u gnyis par sho lo ga sum brgya dang re lnga/ le'u gsum par sho lo ga brgya dang gya drug ste bsdoms pas sho lo ga drug brgya dang nga drug yod do/ /9 snyan ngag me long gi gzhung don nam brjod bya gtso bo/①lus srog rgyan gsum dang nyams 'gyur skyon sel bcas so/ / lus ni rtsom pa bos gang brjod nga/ra 'dod pa'i don gyi rnam par bcad pa'am khyad par du byas pa'i rjod byed tshig gi phreng ba'am ngag gi rgyun de nyid la lus zhes bya ste/ dbye na tshigs bcad dang / tshig lhug bcad lhug spel ma gsum mo/ /2/7

②srog ni snyan ngag gi brjod bya'am mtshon bya'i don gang yang rung ba de la snyan ngag gi srog ces zer te/ dbye na sngon byung gi gtam las gyur pa'i srog dang / da lta'i don can gyi srog gnyis so/ /①rgyan ni tshig don mdzes pa'i nyams dang ldan par mtshon byed kyi thabs la zer zhing / dbye na don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan bcas so /④nyams 'gyur ni 〈tshangs sras bzhad sgra〉 las/ spyir nyams dang 'gyur ba zhes pa da/ dga' ba dang khro ba sogs yid kyi rnam 'gyur phyi lus ngag tu ma shar ba ni 'gyur ba yin la/ de nyid stobs rgyas nas 'dzum pa'am khro gnyer bsdus pa lta bu phyi'i lus ngag tu shar ba ni nyams yin no/ / zhes gsungs te/ nyams la dbye na dga' bar gyur pa'i sgeg pa dang / /drag shul dpa' dang snying rje nyams/ / mi sdug bzhad gad rmad byung nyams/ / 'jigs su rung ba'i nyams te brgyad/ / zhes so/ /khya/skyon sel ni ci 'dra zhig la snyan ngag gi brtsams chos kyi skyon du brtsi ba dang / skyon de sel ba'i thabs tshul/ gnas skabs ci 'dra zhig la don nyams pa sogs skyon du mi 'gyur ba'i dmigs bsal la yong pa bcas don tshan bcur bsdus nas bstan pa la skyon sel zer la/ dbye na 〈snyan ngag me long〉/ las/ don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ / the tshom can dang rim pa nyams/ / sgra nyams gtsod mtshams nyams pa dang / / sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor bral/ / yul dus 'jig rten sgyu rtsal dang / / lung rigs dag dang 'gal ba ste/ / skyon bcu de dag snyan ngag la/ / snyan ngag mkhan gyis spang bar bya/ / zhes so/ /10 snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/〈snyan ngag me long〉 las/ rang bzhin gyis grub sbobs pa/ / mang du thos pa dri med dang / /mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa/ / snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ / zhes pa'o/ /11 snyan ngag mi shes pa'i skyon/2/8

〈tshangs sras bzhad sgra// las/ bstan bcos gang dang gang gi brjod bya'i don shin tu zab kyang /rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa ma byung na/ brjod bya'i don nyams shing / 'brel mi chags pa dang / rang tshig snga phyi'i go rim 'chol ba la sogs pa'i skyon dang ldan par ma zad/ rjod byed kyi ngag mi mdzes shing / rna ba'i lam du'ang mi snyan pas/ mkhas pa dag gi bzhad gad kyi yul du 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ /12 snyan ngag shes pa'i dge mtshan/〈snyan ngag la 'jug pa'i sgo〉 las/ brjod bya gang yin kyang / rjod byed kyi tshig mdzes shing snyan pa dang / yang na/ tshig brjid cing bab chags pa'i nyams dang ldan na/ mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa'i gnas su 'gyur bas/ mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung la sbyangs shing don rtogs par byas na snyan tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa'o/ /13 snyan me'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan/rgya gar lho phyogs bad rbha'i yul dang / shar phyogs go ṭa'i yul du zla med pa'i mkhas mang bo byon pa'i yul gru de gnyis kyi mkhas pa rnams nas me long ma'i le'u dang bo'i dngos bstan sgra gtso bor byas pa'i rgyan bcu yod pa las re gnyis ma gtogs/ 'gal ba ltag sprod du bzhed pas na/ 'dir lho shar thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan zhes btags pa yin la/ le'u gnyis pa dang tha ma'i dngos bsta na don gtso bor byas pa'i rgyan rnams ngo bo gzhi mthun du bzhed pas na 'dir lho shar thun mong ba'i rgyan zhes btags pa yin no/ / zhes 〈snyan ngag spyi don// las gsungs so/ /14 tshigs bcad sbyor tshul gyi dbye ba bzhi'i khyad par mtshon pa'i re'u mig2/9
tshigs bcade/—

kun 'dus me long / ('bring rgyugs man ngag)rtsom sgrig pa/ tshe ring don grub bcas kyis bsgrigs/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/mkha' 'gro skyabs/mdun shog mdzes ris pa/tshang 'dzoms kung si/dpe skrun/ gan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /'grems spel/ gan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /deb tshad/ ho smis 7 8 7༅hosmis1 0 9 2 1 ( 1 6nga ra thengs/2009lo'i 15par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ /2(309lo'i zla8par par thengs dang po dpar/ngapar grangs/ 2000dpe rtags/152rwa 978 — 7—5421—1477—8rin gong / sgor25(0
